title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Mangopay is a wallet-based payment infrastructure built specifically for organisations with complex, multi-party fund flows. A pioneer in multi-party payments.

Our solution optimises fund flows on behalf of the organisations we work with using wallets as programmable, composable building blocks.

Mangopay’s regulated platform collects payments, secures transactions and holds funds, splits money between the various parties in the funds flow, and ultimately manages the payout to service providers, sellers, and consumers.

Platforms and fintechs using Mangopay regain control and transparency over multi-party payment flows, generate additional revenue, and improve operational efficiency. They can stay compliant while innovating and scaling.

Job Description

Mangopay is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to strengthen its technical security capability and support Engineering and Platform teams in designing, building and operating secure services.
Reporting to the CISO, this is a hands-on role combining security engineering, technical ownership of security controls and close collaboration with Engineering.

The Security Engineer will act as the main technical bridge between Security and Engineering, helping teams assess security risks, resolve vulnerabilities, review architecture decisions and ensure that security controls are effectively integrated across Mangopay’s cloud, application and software-development environments.

The objective of the role is to enable secure delivery at scale through technical expertise, automation, practical guidance and effective operation of security controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Engineering and Platform teams to provide practical security guidance on applications, APIs, infrastructure and major technical changes.

  • Perform risk-based security reviews and support the integration of security throughout the SDLC.

  • Review complex security architecture topics and provide guidance on cloud security, identity and access management, network security, application security and cloud-native services.

  • Assess vulnerabilities and CVEs, determine technical impact and exploitability, support remediation decisions and validate fixes.

  • Own and operate the Security Engineering toolset and technical security controls, ensuring they are appropriately configured, maintained, integrated and continuously improved.

  • Design, implement and review cloud and network security controls, including firewall policies, access controls and preventative guardrails.

  • Automate repetitive security activities and integrate security controls into Engineering and Platform workflows.

  • Work with the SOC to translate technical security findings and alerts into actionable remediation for Engineering teams.

  • Contribute to technical remediation and assurance activities linked to audits, regulatory requirements and security assessments.



Qualifications

  • Strong experience in Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Application Security, Product Security or a similar hands-on technical security role.

  • Strong practical knowledge of cloud security and cloud-native architectures, ideally within AWS environments.

  • Good understanding of application and API security, including authentication, authorisation, access control and common security vulnerabilities.

  • Experience with CI/CD environments and integrating security controls into software-development workflows.

  • Experience assessing vulnerabilities and CVEs and providing practical remediation guidance to Engineering teams.

  • Good understanding of identity and access management, network security, encryption, secrets management and cloud security principles.

  • Ability to review technical architectures, identify security risks and recommend proportionate controls.

  • Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security and infrastructure security technologies.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with software engineers, Platform engineers and architects and translate security requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Experience securing large-scale API-based platforms.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, containers and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with threat modelling and secure design reviews.

  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, SOC 2, DORA or similar regulatory and assurance frameworks.

  • Relevant cloud or security certifications are beneficial but not required.

Additional information

  • Call HR

  • Interview with Senior Member

  • Interview with Head of Info Security

title: Senior Paid Campaign Specialist
description:
At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes.

Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat.

The work

As our Senior Paid Campaign Specialist, you'll run the digital engine behind one of Europe's leading deep-tech companies. You'll turn high-quality technical and strategic content into measurable reach, engagement, and pipeline impact. This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of brand execution and growth marketing, where you'll own our paid campaigns, create and manage efficient campaign distribution, and execute performance marketing by repurposing content, managing content performance, and optimizing campaign builds.

You'll work closely with content marketing, product marketing, sales, and business leaders across a global organization. You will support lead generation and campaign execution, ensuring that leads are accurately captured and routed in the CRM. You will also track performance across channels and produce clear reporting, insights, and recommendations.

Success in your first months means building a consistent digital rhythm, improving campaign performance, and creating measurable impact across our marketing funnel. In this role, you will work with AI tools, making sure that their usage supports your goals and performance.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in growth and/or paid marketing campaigns, preferably within B2B technology sector

  • Hands-on experience applying AI to streamline marketing operationsm, e.g. building lightweight automations or agents for campaign reporting, QA, or optimization workflows

  • Proven experience managing organic and paid social media, with strong LinkedIn expertise

  • Hands-on experience running and optimizing paid social campaigns, including analytics and reporting

  • Experience with marketing automation workflows

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently

  • A data-driven mindset, comfortable using metrics to guide decisions and improve performance

  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional, and international teams

  • A bias for action — able to launch, learn, and iterate quickly with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Considered as an advantage

  • Experience with additional digital advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads)

  • Familiarity with quantum computing, high-performance computing, or deep-tech markets

  • Expertise with technical SEO and GEO

Why IQM?

  • Full-stack quantum computing: From quantum hardware to software layers and beyond, we build across the full-stack.

  • High-performance playground: We aim high, and we know sustainable performance only works when life outside work does too—hybrid setups, flexible hours.

  • Never the smartest: Expect to learn constantly. You won't always be the smartest person in the room, and that's the point.

  • Bigger than IQM: Our people build know-how for the entire quantum ecosystem. We publish papers, run hackathons, and help shape a market that's still being defined.

The future of computing won’t build itself. You might be one of the few who do.

  • Meet our people and learn more about IQM on our stories page.

title: Cyber Security Analyst (Manager role) Experience 5+ years required
description:
The role

This role is for a cyber security analyst in Clifford Chance's cyber security team.

Clifford Chance has a global estate and 7000+ staff; it is imperative that we maintain the security of the estate and enable the legal advisors and others to carry out their work.

The cyber security analyst will be responsible for managing and investigating cyber incidents, ensuring that incidents are handled from beginning to end and are properly contained and remediated. You will work closely with MSSP and internal IT teams

This role will suit a highly motivated individual, with keen attention to detail, who can demonstrate an exceptional analytical skill set and knowledge of current and evolving Cyber threats and developing strategies for their detection and mitigation.

Who you will work with

You will work within the cyber security team at Clifford Chance, alongside the information security team, reporting into the Head of Cyber Security. You will work with several IT and business risk colleagues across the business on incidents and wider improvement projects.

You will be working with colleagues in the security team primarily in the UK and India, however you will work with IT and business teams across the world.

What you will be responsible for

Key responsibilities of the Cyber Security Analyst:

  • Manage and respond to cyber security incidents from initial triage through to close.
  • Work with Major Incident Management teams and Head of Cyber Security to manage and investigate serious incidents as required.
  • Document incidents clearly and report upwards as required.
  • Investigate incidents using a range of tooling – such as endpoint analysis via Microsoft Defender, use of SIEM products, log analysis and malware analysis.
  • Operate several tools but not limited to Vulnerability, SOAR, Threat Hunting, External Exposure, BAS.
  • Research and incorporate relevant threat intelligence during the incident investigation and in written and verbal reports.
  • Maintain current tooling and best practise knowledge in relation to attacker tactics and techniques, response processes, containment and remediation of incidents.
  • Track cyber threat actors/campaigns based off technical analysis and open source intelligence.
  • Perform threat hunting activities across the network, including designing and running threat hunts.
  • Triage and investigate emails reported by CC employees in accordance with established processes
  • Ability to troubleshoot the log feed interruption for the logs sources ingesting logs in SIEM tool and restore the feeds
  • Liaise with Architecture, IT Operations, Network Security and IT Risk to implement security enhancements and during incidents.

What you will do

  • Handle incidents and alerts on a daily basis by utilising Microsoft cloud solutions, log analysis, malware sandboxing, and speaking to other IT teams and users as required.
  • Work across the UK and India Cyber Security team – reporting upwards, sharing knowledge across the wider team, and maintaining regular contact.
  • Support penetration tests and improvement projects – ensuring all are delivered smoothly.
  • Liaise with Architecture, IT Operations, Network Security and IT Risk for new projects, incidents, vulnerabilities and other issues.
  • Support and be part of the on-call rota.

Your experience

  • The cyber security analyst will have at least 3-5 years experience in cyber security and incident handling. Key areas of essential experience include:
  • 3+ years of hands on cyber incident response experience with proven capability and experience of investigating, managing and remediating cyber security incidents.
  • Knowledge of data breaches, ransomware, fraud and other types of serious incident.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging advanced cyber threats, attack and evasion techniques, command and control infrastructures and insider threat behaviour.
  • Experience in escalating and articulating security concepts to senior, technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organisational, communication and project management skills.
  • Strong Azure / M365 cloud knowledge and experience as well as on-premises IT experience.
  • Usage of investigation tools such as malware sandboxes, SIEMs, log analysis tooling, network traffic analysis, endpoint analysis (event logs, files, processes).
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning and management tooling and interpretation of results.
  • Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Experience with standard on-premises security products such as firewalls, proxies, endpoint solutions.
  • Threat modelling and use case development and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to guide detection rulesets, threat hunting and investigations.
  • AI Knowledge and hands on experience

How we will support you

From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.

Equal opportunities

At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.

We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age. This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.

We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.

Our goal is to deliver an equality of opportunity, an equality of aspiration and an equality of experience to everyone who works in our firm.

Find out more about our inclusive culture here.

title: D365 Test Lead
description:
ERP Test Lead (D365)

Full time / Permanent

Hybrid Working – Ashford, Kent or Hemel Hempstead

Competitive Salary + £5500 car allowance

As the ERP Test Lead, you'll play a pivotal role in driving quality across a complex digital transformation programme centred around Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) and its integrated business applications. You'll take ownership of test planning, coordination and delivery, creating detailed test plans, managing schedules and leading testing activities through System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Working hands-on with Azure DevOps (ADO), you'll design, review and execute test scenarios across functional, integration, regression and exploratory testing, ensuring robust coverage and full traceability to business requirements. You'll conduct end-to-end testing across D365 F&O, integration platforms and connected third-party systems, validating data flows, business processes and security roles (RBAC), while leading defect management activities to drive rapid issue resolution and minimise delivery risk.

This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate testing professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with team leadership. You'll lead and develop a team of Test Analysts, fostering a quality-first culture and ensuring adherence to testing standards, governance and best practices. You'll also oversee automated regression testing using Leapwork, analysing failures, supporting the expansion of automation coverage and helping to shape the future testing approach. Working closely with business SMEs, functional consultants, developers, integration partners and programme stakeholders, you'll provide clear reporting on testing progress, risks and quality metrics, translating technical issues into meaningful business impacts. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex challenges across enterprise systems, and want to make a visible impact on the success of a major transformation programme, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for an experienced Test Lead, with the relevant ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level. You’ll have a proven track record of delivering testing activities within large-scale ERP implementations, ideally with hands-on experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). You'll have a strong understanding of the full testing lifecycle, including Functional Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), Regression Testing, Performance Testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), alongside previous experience leading test teams and coordinating testing across complex programmes. You'll be confident working with Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management, defect tracking and reporting, and have experience testing integrations between ERP platforms and third-party systems, with a solid understanding of APIs, middleware, EDI and data synchronisation. We're looking for someone who can interpret business and technical documentation, manage testing activities across both agile and waterfall environments, and effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.

This is a hands-on role, so you must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and personally creating, executing and validating test cases when required, while mentoring and supporting the team. You'll bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and the confidence to translate technical concepts into clear business language. Experience with test automation tools such as Leapwork, Selenium or Tricentis is highly desirable, as is exposure to performance testing tools including JMeter, LoadRunner or StresStimulus. You'll also thrive in a collaborative, matrix environment, working effectively across multiple teams, locations and time zones to drive quality and successful delivery.

This role is offering a hybrid contract from either Ashford, Kent or Hemel Hempstead so you must be within a commutable distance to either site.

At Sysco International everyone is welcome. We don’t want you to ‘fit our culture’ we want you to help define it and we actively celebrate the unique talents of each and every colleague. We don’t just look at your CV, we’re more focused on who you are and your potential. As part of our values, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone has a voice, is appreciated and has the same opportunities. We work hard to ensure that everyone feels part of our business, as we care for one another and connect the world through food and trusted partnerships. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that everyone belongs and thrives at Sysco International and we recognise that Sysco International can only thrive when everyone feels they belong. description:
Work Arrangement / Work Shift: Remote | Part-Time | NOAM Shift

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Adaptive Planning / Forecasting & Budgeting Consultant with a strong background in Accounting and Finance to support clients in improving their financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar Enterprise Performance Management and Financial Planning tools), combined with a solid understanding of financial operations, management reporting, and business performance analysis.

This role will work closely with finance leaders, business stakeholders, and technical teams to design, implement, optimize, and support planning and forecasting solutions that drive informed business decisions.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead and support the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Workday Adaptive Planning and related financial planning solutions.

  • Collaborate with finance and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable planning and reporting models.

  • Design and maintain budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, and financial reporting models.

  • Develop dashboards, management reports, KPIs, and financial analytics to support strategic decision-making.

  • Facilitate annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, long-range planning, and variance analysis processes.

  • Partner with accounting and finance teams to improve financial processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

  • Build and maintain integrations between Adaptive Planning and ERP, accounting, payroll, or other source systems.

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Provide end-user training, documentation, and ongoing support to ensure successful adoption of planning solutions.

  • Troubleshoot system issues, recommend enhancements, and implement best practices for financial planning and analysis (FP&A).

  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end reporting requirements as needed.

  • Stay current with Workday Adaptive Planning product updates and industry best practices.

title: Revenue Cycle QI Trainer - Hospital Billing
description:
Job Description

Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 times for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We also were awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an outstanding benefits package that includes health care, paid time off, and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.

What you will be doing in this role:

The Revenue Cycle Quality Improvement (QI) Trainer develops and provides educational material/programming, facilitates the collection and analysis of training specific feedback, and mentors team members to ensure ongoing growth and development goals (personal and company) are achieved. The work effort is driven by ongoing revenue cycle operational needs and initiatives. In the development of a comprehensive curriculum, the Revenue Cycle QI Trainer addresses Cedars-Sinai Revenue Cycle system updates/upgrades, changes in workflow, leadership recommendations for improvement, workflow changes to address compliance needs, performance/quality improvement initiatives and ongoing training and development support necessary as defined on an ad hoc basis outlined by the Revenue Cycle Support Services Director. Revenue Cycle QI Trainer ensures workflow is understood through training and job aide availability, staff performance expectations can be adhered to post training, and works with to support workflow expectations to support optimal job performance.

  • Facilitates and delivers technical training; assessment, preparation, delivery and evaluation to meet the operational & technical training needs of the revenue cycle.
  • Actively participates as a subject matter expert (SME) in projects, and maintains meaningful relationships with business partners, Enterprise Information Services (EIS), leadership, system users and vendors.
  • Uses understanding of the Electronic Health Record (EHR – CS-Link/Epic) in detail in order to competently develop training curriculum and facilitate training delivery.
  • Analyzes integrated workflow, application dependencies, and user competencies through collaboration with end users, SME, and application analysts to determine learning objectives.
  • Designs and maintains role-based training materials and scenarios, crossing CS-Link/Epic modules and other applications, to incorporate best practices based upon adult learning principles.
  • Translates complex and integrated technical functionality and workflow into easily understood steps.
  • Validates information prior to incorporating into curricula.
  • Devises modes of assessment to measure the effectiveness of the course and actively incorporates feedback to improve the training offered, based on feedback received.
  • Facilitates technical training while monitoring and adjusting the approach as necessary to ensure maximum transfer and retention of knowledge among a variety of audiences.
  • Contributes to the planning, design, development, build, and maintenance of the patient scenarios in the training environment, especially related to integrated areas.
  • Incorporates best practices and the latest tools from CS-Link/ Epic.
  • Assists with training environment testing.
  • Applies project management principles to support the creation of project tasks, including recommendations of tasks, work estimates, and assignments.
  • Serves as an EIS liaison for basic and complex functionality questions for implementations and upgrades with a range of customers including business operations, system users and vendors.
  • Designs, maintains and updates documentation of processes and procedures for Epic training curricula, authoring tools and application best practices.
  • Takes ownership of personal growth and acts upon this opportunity to stay informed of emerging technologies.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, health science, public health or education/training or another related field preferred.
  • Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) preferred.
  • EPIC certification in Admission, Discharge, Transfer (ADT), Hospital Billing (HB) Resolute and/ or Physician Billing (PB) Resolute, preferred.
  • A minimum of 3 years in a supervisory, training or teaching role required.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a revenue cycle application specific to department: Patient Services, Patient Revenue Management- Hospital Billing and Patient Revenue Management- Hospital Billing preferred.
  • Epic hospital billing (PB) experience highly preferred.

Why work here?

Beyond outstanding employee benefits including health and dental insurance, vacation, and a 403(b) we take pride in hiring the best, most passionate employees. Our accomplished staff reflects the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They are proof of our commitment to creating a dynamic, inclusive environment that fuels innovation.

title: Risk & Compliance SME (AI Focus)
description:
Join our consulting team to deliver high-impact solutions across risk, compliance, and operations transformation. In this role, you'll work directly with clients to map how compliance and operational processes actually work, identify where they break down or create risk, and design better processes, then find the right opportunities to layer in AI to make them faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

You'll operate in a fast-paced, client-facing environment, balancing independent ownership with strong collaboration across teams. This role is ideal for people with experience in technology and/or fintech environments, particularly within regulated or compliance-driven contexts, who also bring a genuine interest in where AI can realistically improve how compliance work gets done.

What You'll Do

  • Risk & Compliance Process Design

    • Lead the design and implementation of improved frameworks, systems, and processes, including defining data requirements and analyzing performance trends across operational, logical, and system workflows

  • AI Opportunity Identification

    • Evaluate compliance and operational processes to identify practical AI and automation use cases, from workflow automation to agentic AI

    • Build the business case for where these use cases will actually reduce risk or improve efficiency

  • Client Delivery & Execution

    • Lead client engagements, both onsite and remotely, delivering high-quality workstreams and producing complex, client-ready deliverables

  • Project & Workstream Management

    • Manage timelines, prioritize tasks, and coordinate activities across cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

    • Build strong client relationships and confidently present insights, recommendations, and AI-enabled process improvements to stakeholders, including senior leadership

  • Business Analysis & Problem Solving

    • Analyze client challenges using both quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop structured, actionable solutions

  • Team Collaboration & Mentorship

    • Collaborate with and mentor team members on tools, methodologies, and best practices (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project)

  • Documentation & Knowledge Management

    • Maintain clear and organized project documentation to ensure transparency, continuity, and knowledge sharing

  • Thought Leadership & Practice Development

    • Drive thought leadership by shaping internal initiatives, sharing knowledge, and building firm capabilities around AI in risk and compliance

  • Business Development Support

    • Shape proposal development, identify new opportunities, and drive broader business development efforts

  • Meeting Facilitation

    • Lead effective meetings with both internal teams and clients, ensuring alignment and clear next steps

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business Management, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field

  • 4-7 years of client-facing management consulting experience, preferably within technology or fintech environments

  • Experience supporting or delivering risk, compliance, or regulatory-related initiatives

  • Practical experience with AI adoption, workflow automation, or identifying AI use cases within a business or compliance context, not just familiarity with the concept

  • Strong understanding of industry challenges within technology, fintech, or regulated environments

  • Proven ability to build and manage client relationships

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to present complex ideas clearly

  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including knowing when to escalate issues

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment

Preferred

  • Master's degree or MBA

  • Experience within financial services, fintech, or technology-driven organizations

  • Exposure to areas such as risk management, compliance, financial crimes, or regulatory programs

  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools to compliance, risk, or operational workflows (actual use, not certification-level)

  • Familiarity with data analysis, reporting tools, or process improvement methodologies

  • Exposure to agentic AI concepts and their application to compliance or operational processes

What Sets You Apart

  • A systems thinker who can see how a compliance process connects end to end and where risk or inefficiency creeps in

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, grounded in practical outcomes for risk and compliance work

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in client environments

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous settings with evolving priorities

  • Ability to translate complex problems into structured, actionable solutions

  • Interest in growing into leadership responsibilities and contributing to team development

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for technology, innovation, and emerging trends

Compensation & Benefits

    • Senior Consultant Level: $130,600 - $135,700, commensurate with experience and qualifications

title: Liaison Specialist Hospital
description:
Build meaningful connections across hospital and community care while helping people move forward with confidence, support, and continuity.

This is a remote position open to Missouri Residents only.

The Liaison Specialist plays a key role in connecting patients with the care, resources, and follow-up services that support their health and well-being. Working as part of an integrated care team with Compass Health and SSM Health, this role helps strengthen continuity of care across hospital, primary care, behavioral health, and community settings. The Liaison Specialist builds relationships, coordinates referrals, supports health literacy, and helps identify and address barriers to care—all while honoring the strengths, goals, and individual needs of each person served.


This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating care across multiple systems, and helping people navigate healthcare and community resources. You’ll collaborate with hospital staff, healthcare providers, community organizations, and other partners to help create connected, person-centered pathways to care.

  • Coordinate referrals and follow-up care across medical, dental, behavioral health, primary care, and community services.
  • Follow up with patients after hospital or emergency department visits and support timely access to needed services.
  • Assess access barriers such as transportation, housing, and economic stability, and connect patients with appropriate resources.
  • Partner with patients to identify strengths, needs, goals, and next steps while providing support, education, advocacy, and follow-through.
  • Promote wellness, health literacy, and self-management through culturally responsive education and encouragement.
  • Build and maintain strong referral relationships with community organizations, schools, employers, healthcare providers, and other partners.
  • Support care team communication, program tracking, reporting, and documentation to promote effective outcomes.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, respectful, and welcoming environment for patients, families, visitors, and colleagues.
  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation and information systems in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
• High School Graduate or GED required
• One (1) to Two (2) years of relevant work experience required
• Familiar with medical terminology, insurance coverage, and inpatient/outpatient hospital services
• Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook, as required for the role


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:
  • Build trusting relationships and communicate with warmth, respect, and professionalism.
  • Enjoy bringing people, providers, and community resources together to create smoother paths to care.
  • Approach each person with curiosity and recognize their strengths, goals, culture, and individual circumstances.
  • Are organized, dependable, and comfortable coordinating multiple needs and priorities.
  • Can navigate healthcare systems and community resources while making information easier to understand and act on.
  • Value collaboration and enjoy working across teams and organizations.
  • Are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen access to care and promote wellness in communities where healthcare resources can be limited.

title: Campaign Delivery Manager - 3 month FTC - US
description:

Our goal is to deliver for students by increasing student engagement while enabling Students’ Unions to secure sustainable funding. The Opportunity

We're hiring a Campaign Delivery Manager on a 3 month FTC for someone who will take ownership of delivering a portfolio of US campaigns, working across our teams, campus partners, suppliers and on-the-ground event staff to turn campaign plans into brilliant execution.

It's a hands-on project management role for someone who loves making things happen. One day you might be coordinating the final details of a campus activation; the next, managing suppliers, briefing an Event Manager or solving a last-minute delivery challenge.

You'll work closely with our UK-based Central Operations team, becoming an important part of the bridge between our UK and US operations. As one of our key delivery contacts during US working hours, you'll also be there when campaigns are live, helping teams on the ground, responding to questions and making sure issues are dealt with quickly.

We're looking for someone who can get up to speed quickly, take genuine ownership and thrive in an environment where there is plenty happening at once.

What you’ll be working on

As Campaign Delivery Manager, you’ll be responsible for the following:

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of experiential and integrated campaigns across the US.

  • Be a key point of contact for delivery during US working hours, supporting teams on the ground and responding to live campaign queries.

  • Spot risks early, solve problems quickly and escalate when something needs wider support.

  • Make sure campaigns are delivered safely, professionally, on brand and in line with what we've promised.

  • Ensure campaign evidence and Proof of Delivery are captured so we can demonstrate the impact of our work.

What we’re looking for

You'll already have experience delivering experiential campaigns, events, brand activations, field marketing or similarly fast-moving projects and be ready to take the next step in your career.

You'll be someone who is comfortable being given an outcome and working out what needs to happen to get there.

Specifically, you will bring:

  • Strong campaign or project management experience.

  • Experience coordinating multiple projects, campaigns or events at the same time.

  • A good understanding of experiential delivery and the practicalities behind live activations.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

  • Confidence working with clients, suppliers, partners and on-the-ground teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • A calm, practical approach when plans change or problems need solving.

  • The ability to prioritise and make decisions in a fast-moving environment.

  • Confidence working independently while being part of a wider international team.

  • A collaborative attitude and willingness to get stuck in wherever needed.

Required skills & experience

We are committed to lifting everyone up. We seek to enable people’s best work by optimising for freedom with accountability. You’ll get the most out of this role if you can bring:

  • Experience working with university or college campuses, student audiences or multi-location campaigns would be a bonus, but isn't essential.


Whats in it for you

💰 Base Salary: $70,000 - $80,000 per annum

👨🏽‍💻 Employment through EOR partner

🏡 Remote-first role in the US

⚡ Opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-growing startup.

📈 Play a key role in the US expansion strategy for a mission-driven company.

💡 Access to career growth opportunities as the company scales.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are actively creating an equitable environment for everyone at native to thrive.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we are making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at native. At native, we embrace diversity in all of its forms and foster an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us.

  • Must demonstrate proficiency in all areas of testing and be proficient troubleshooting all applicable instruments/procedures in the department.

  • Perform and report on assigned analytical tests in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) ensuring that applicable quality control requirements are met.
  • Actively support and comply with laboratory policies and procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analysis, reporting and maintaining records of patient test results.

One (1) year full-time experience or training (high complexity testing) in a clinical laboratory setting.

Minimum of 3 years clinical experience with most current year in present department.

  • Ability to stand and work at the bench for long periods of time.

Knowledge:

title: Press Line Operator
description:
Job Summary:

The Press Line Operator is responsible for operating a press and maintaining equipment, maintaining a daily production log, inspecting the products that are created before they are shipped to customers, and ensuring that those products meet quality specifications.

Essential Functions:

  • Ensures that the mold installed on the press is the correct mold to manufacture your assigned product.
  • Verifies the mold and checks the setup check sheet placed on the overhead of the press.
  • Prior to loading the press with crumb rubber, refers to the setup sheet and verifies the crumb rubber formulation and weight required for the assigned product.
  • Manually loads the crumb rubber with a bucket filled with pre-mixed material throughout the bottom cavity of the press and spreads evenly.
  • Removes the finished product from the mold with a pry bar and place it on the worktable.
  • Trims and palletizes finished product to be sent out to the shipping department.
  • Completes daily log of production produced per press.

General Functions:

  • Consistently abides by established safety rules, procedures, and regulations including wearing required safety equipment such as safety shoes and glasses.
  • Maintains a clean and organized work environment.
  • Identifies and reports quality or safety issues to supervisor or manager.
  • Works effectively with co-workers and supervisors, sharing knowledge, resources, and experience to achieve production goals in a timely fashion, while promoting respect, communication, and teamwork.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Why Eficode?

Diversity & Inclusion

title: Buyer
description:
Ready to take the next step in your Sourcing, Procurement and Supply Chain career? 🚀

Join the coolest Buying department (yes, we really are 😎) and help us develop and deliver yarn for all yarn lovers all over the world 🧶✨.

We're looking for an experienced Buyer to join our passionate team at Hobbii - Europe’s leading online yarn retailer🌍. You’ll play a vital role in keeping our shelves stocked, our gross margins healthy, and our global community of knitters and crocheters inspired. Your work will directly impact their ability to create, share, and enjoy their craft – and that’s something we’re incredibly proud of ❤️.

With us, you're not just another cog in the machine - you'll be a key player in shaping our supply chain processes, driving commercial growth, and helping us grow smarter, better, and faster🚀. So reach out to us if you’re ready to take on new challenges and want to be part of our exciting journey. Your expertise will drive our success, and you'll have the opportunity to grow alongside a dedicated and supportive team.

Our fun and passionate Product & Procurement team

Your colleagues are incredibly friendly and come from all over the world, so expect a high level of diversity and cultural richness. Lunch conversations range from weddings in India to politics in Canada and camping tips for exploring Denmark. The team is a talented group of people from different backgrounds - from Product Development and Procurement to Graphic Design, Planning and Logistics. We thrive on teamwork, sharing ideas, and combining our strengths to drive real results 🎯.

Who's got your back

You’ll report to our Buying Manager, a seasoned expert in sourcing, procurement, and negotiation. She’s the kind of manager who will challenge you, support your development, and celebrate your wins - big or small - with genuine excitement 🎉.

Together with our Category Manager, you'll be the strategic engine room: deciding what we sell and at what price, ensuring how it gets here, guaranteeing perfect quality ⭐, and making sure our data remains the source of truth for the rest of the company.

Your role

As our new Buyer, you'll drive commercial growth and profitability through strategic assortment development, global sourcing, and high-level negotiations. You'll ensure Hobbii offers the right products at competitive prices at the right time. You’ll take full category ownership alongside the Product Developer and Category Manager, serving as the company’s "eyes and ears" to keep Hobbii at the forefront of new materials, colour trends, and sustainability standards. You ask the right questions, make well-informed calls, take ownership, and get things done💥.

What you’ll be doing

Sourcing & Negotiation

  • Lead global sourcing initiatives and maintain strategic, long-term supplier relationships across Europe, Asia, and Türkiye through online meetings, trade fairs, and supplier visits.

  • Conduct annual contract negotiations, price benchmarking, and optimize payment terms and Minimum Order Quantities to directly improve Hobbii’s gross margin and cash flow.

  • Perform regular supplier performance reviews to ensure compliance with Hobbii’s quality standards ⭐ and sustainability goals 🌿.

Range & Assortment Management

  • Curate colour palettes and yarn qualities based on data-driven insights and seasonal trends together with Product Development and the Category Manager.

  • Manage our "In/Out" strategy (deciding which products to launch, promote, or phase out) and build clear product roles and tiers within the category range.

  • Keep a close eye on competitors to keep our prices right and competitive.

  • Manage the product lifecycle, balancing inventory turnover with high availability to ensure portfolio health.

Cross-Functional Strategy

  • Work closely with the Product Operations Coordinator to translate strategic decisions into accurate data within the Pipeline document.

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Finance, Warehouse, Tech and Commercial teams.

About you

  • Buying experience, working directly with suppliers

  • Strong negotiation and external/internal stakeholder management skills

  • Analytical, structured, and confident with numbers

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, formulas)

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written

  • Ability to travel - approximately 10-15 travel days per year, primarily within and outside Europe, to visit suppliers and yarn fairs

  • The "Hobster" Spirit: A proactive, energetic, and "no-task-too-small" mindset that prioritizes team success over a rigid job description.

  • Passion for Knitting and/or Crocheting (A Big Plus): If you personally nerd out on yarn, stitch patterns, or craft trends and understand our end users' needs, that's a huge advantage! 🧶✨

Why join Hobbii?

At Hobbii, we proudly serve a global community of passionate knitters and crocheters 🧶❤️. Every year, we ship millions of orders worldwide, fuelling creativity and connection among crafters in more than 50 countries 🌍. Hobbii has +200 passionate “Hobsters” from all over the world, 116 robots in our warehouse, and over 13.000 different products. Our Team is part of a fun, international Product & Procurement department that thrives on collaboration, curiosity, and results 🚀.

We believe work should be exciting, meaningful - and occasionally sprinkled with themed Friday bars 🥳!

The practical stuff 📍 This position is based at our HQ in Dortheavej, Copenhagen (Nordvest), where we have a killer lunch from Meyers, barista-quality coffee, 6 weeks of holiday, and private health insurance. Most of our team works from the office Monday - Thursday, with the option of working remotely on Fridays.

Ready to apply? 📩 Skip the cover letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and answer a few quick questions in the application form. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate is found! ⭐

title: Chief Commercial Officer til Derma Space
description:
Vil du være med til at skalere en succesfuld vækstvirksomhed og sætte retningen for den nordiske kommercielle agenda?

Derma Space har på få år udviklet sig fra en entreprenørdrevet e-commerce-forretning til den førende nordiske distributør af K-beauty-brands. Gennem en kombination af stærke producentrelationer, markedsindsigt og kommerciel forståelse har Derma Space opbygget en markant position i markedet og søger nu en CCO, der kan samle og videreudvikle den kommercielle organisation og sætte retningen for næste fase af væksten.

Som CCO får du det samlede ansvar for virksomhedens kommercielle performance på tværs af markeder, kunder og salgskanaler. Du bliver en central del af ledergruppen og får direkte reference til CEO. Samtidig får du mulighed for at præge både strategi, organisation og eksekvering i en virksomhed med markante vækstambitioner.

Du får det overordnede ansvar for salg, marketing, e-commerce og kundeudvikling samt for at skabe de strukturer, processer og organisatoriske kapabiliteter, der skal understøtte Derma Spaces fortsatte vækst.

Dine primære ansvarsområder:

  • Overordnede ansvar for virksomhedens kommercielle strategi og vækstagenda på tværs af norden.

  • Strategisk ansvar for udvikling af markeder, salgskanaler og nye kommercielle vækstmuligheder.

  • Ansvar for udvikling af den kommercielle organisation på nordisk niveau i tæt samarbejde med Salgsdirektør og Head of E-commerce & Marketing.

  • Ansvar for Key Account Management og strategiske kunderelationer.

  • Overordnede ansvar for kommercielle partnerskaber, kontraktforhandlinger og kundeudvikling.

  • Udvikling af kundesegmentering, kanalstrategier og go-to-market-modeller.

  • Videreudvikling af salgsprocesser, CRM, KPI-strukturer og performance management.

  • Overordnede ansvar for prisstrategi, marginstyring og øvrige kommercielle vilkår.

  • Strategisk ansvar for overordnede e-commerce- og marketing-aktiviteter.

  • Udvikling af en stærk og skalerbar kommerciel organisation med fokus på strategisk ledelse gennem funktionslederne.

Du har erfaring som salgsdirektør, CCO eller lignende fra beauty, FMCG eller retail. Du har skabt resultater gennem udvikling og skalering af kommercielle organisationer på nordisk plan og motiveres af at omsætte strategi til handling. Gennem din karriere har du opbygget solid erfaring med B2B-salg, Key Account Management og udvikling af stærke kunderelationer, ligesom du har navigeret succesfuldt på tværs af nordiske markeder.

Du er en leder, der skaber resultater gennem andre, og du trives med ledelse gennem ledere. Samtidig arbejder du datadrevet og er vant til at anvende KPI'er, forecasting, CRM-systemer og performance management som fundament for beslutninger og kommerciel udvikling. Du har stærke forhandlingsevner og forstår, hvordan lønsom vækst skabes gennem den rette balance mellem strategi, eksekvering og kundeudvikling.

Som person formår du at inspirere og samle mennesker om en fælles retning. Du kommunikerer klart, skaber engagement og er i stand til at omsætte ambitioner til konkrete initiativer, der styrker kunder, organisation og forretning.

Hos Derma Space bliver du en del af en entreprenant kultur med korte beslutningsveje, høje ambitioner og stærke værdier. Du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på Derma Spaces næste vækstkapitel.

Arbejdssted: Skanderborg

Derma Space samarbejder med GML A/S om denne rekruttering. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte seniorkonsulent Mads Nielsen på telefon +45 23 64 46 49 eller Head of Research Henriette Toftgaard Pedersen på telefon +45 60 21 02 31. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Om Derma Space

Derma Space tilbyder et bredt sortiment af koreanske beautyprodukter inden for hudpleje, hårpleje og makeup og samarbejder med en række af de førende brands i kategorien. Virksomheden opererer på tværs af distribution, retail, B2B og e-commerce og har gennem de seneste år opbygget en stærk position på det nordiske marked. Sortimentet udvælges med fokus på kvalitet, innovation og relevans for de nordiske forbrugere, og virksomheden arbejder målrettet med at identificere nye trends, brands og muligheder i et marked præget af høj udviklingshastighed.

Derma Space blev grundlagt i 2018 af mor og datter, Mette og Katrine Vernegaard, og er i dag en af de markante aktører inden for distribution af koreansk hudpleje i Norden.

description:
O stanowisku

Forma zatrudnienia: umowa zlecenie

Lokalizacja: ul. Zwierzyniecka 2, Opole (praca stacjonarna)

O zespole:

Dołącz do zgranego zespołu tworzącego Centrum Bankowości Korporacyjnej! Do naszych zadań należy przede wszystkim opieka nad portfelem klientów z segmentu dużych firm. Nasze zespoły tworzone są przez doradców_czynie, analityków_czki oraz młodszych_e specjalistów_ki wsparcia biznesu. Zależy nam, aby dzięki naszemu wsparciu klienci mogli realizować swoje cele związane z rozwojem firmy. Istotą naszej pracy jest odpowiadanie na potrzeby związane z prowadzeniem działalności, m.in. dobór właściwego sposobu finansowania (kredyty, leasingi, faktoring).

  • dbasz o wsparcie procesów związanych z pozyskiwaniem nowych klientów

  • wspierasz procesy związane z kompletowaniem wniosków do decyzji kredytowej

  • kompletujesz i obsługujesz obieg dokumentów

  • posiadasz status studenta_ki lub absolwenta_ki studiów licencjackich lub magisterskich do 2 lat po ukończeniu studiów (preferowane kierunki ekonomiczno-finansowe)

  • jesteś dostępny_a min. 32 h tygodniowo

  • jesteś otwarty_a na poszerzanie wiedzy i zdobywanie doświadczeń w bankowości korporacyjnej

  • posiadasz zdolności analitycznego myślenia

  • cechujesz się odpowiedzialnością, sumiennością i konsekwencją w działaniu

  • cechujesz się wysoką kulturą osobistą

  • jesteś komunikatywny_a, pozytywnie nastawiony_a do ludzi oraz potrafisz pracować w zespole

  • znasz programy MS Office

Mile widziane

  • posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie B1

  • posiadasz wiedzę z zakresu ekonomii i finansów

  • umowę zlecenie na okres 6 miesięcy

title: Specimen Technician - Hospital
description:
Specimen Technician - Hospital - Boston, MA, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM, with rotational weekends

The Hospital Specimen Associate is responsible for the preparation of patient’s specimens in a hospital location where multiple Hospital Specimen Associates work together with minimal direction. The Hospital Specimen Associate must be able to perform and follow all pre-analytical processing procedures with accuracy and in a timely manner. The roles & responsibilities below are specific to samples being performed by Quest laboratory testing.

Pay range: $21.09 - $23.09 / hour

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.

Benefits information:
We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:

  • Day 1 Medical, supplemental health, dental & vision for FT employees who work 30+ hours
  • Best-in-class well-being programs
  • Annual, no-cost health assessment program Blueprint for Wellness®
  • healthyMINDS mental health program
  • Vacation and Health/Flex Time
  • 6 Holidays plus 1 "MyDay" off
  • FinFit financial coaching and services
  • 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth IRA with company match up to 5% after 12 months of service
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Life and disability insurance, plus buy-up option
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Annual incentive plans
  • Matching gifts program
  • Education assistance through MyQuest for Education
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • and so much more!

Specimen Processing & Test Send Out Responsibilities

  • Demonstrates excellent proficiency in test ordering policies, hospital processing procedures, specimen requirements for test ordering, sample preparation, Quantum, and compliance/legal requirements.
  • Knowledge and competency of Hospital LIS system (client specific)
  • Print Quest performed testing reports
  • Demonstrates ability to interpret specimen flow/tracking data utilizing all available reports and resources
  • Responsible for supply ordering processes.
  • Performs remote accessioning (pre-accessioning), (client specific)

Problem Resolution Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and problem resolution for specimen types, missing information, TIQ, TNP, additional sample requests, and other client issues related to area of responsibility.

Customer Service Responsibilities

  • Demonstrates exceptional customer service skills as the Liaison between customer & Quest performing laboratory to provide pro-active customer support.
  • Responsible for managing inbound calls with a positive client interaction.
  • Communicates and collaborates effectively with the hospital laboratory staff, as well as the Quest Diagnostics sales team and other functions in the organization.
  • Communicates effectively information regarding problem-solving with specimens, test cancellations, testing requirements, billing requirements with various hospital staff.

Required Work Experience:

  • 1 – 3 years of working experience

Preferred Work Experience:

  • Medical background preferred, which includes medical terminology applicable to a clinical laboratory
  • Previous experience in a hospital laboratory environment preferred

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Position requires data-entry background with abilities to enter 6,000 alphanumeric keystrokes/hour.
  • Works in a biohazard environment, practicing good safety habits.
  • Able to sit or stand for long periods.

Skills:

  • Handles multiple tasks simultaneously and works in a production environment.
  • Hospital LIS Systems knowledge or experience a plus
  • Command of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Client interfacing role requiring strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
  • The position requires demonstrated data entry skills to effectively utilize both the Quest Diagnostics system and the hospital client systems.
  • Maintains composure while working under pressure.
  • Reflects good judgment when determining what action to take when resolving problems.
  • Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills that foster a positive environment.
  • Demonstrates flexibility and ability to adapt to change.

Education

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent (Required)

description:

Check if you are up for maximizing your earning/growth potential, leveraging our Disruptive Talent Solution.

Role: Security Engineering Consultant
Location: HYDERABAD | BANGALORE | PUNE | CHENNAI
Experience: 4-6 Years
Notice Period:0-30 days(If you have negotiable notice period or buyout option please apply)


Requirements

As a Consultant in the hybrid operate business, you are responsible for adhering to the defined operating procedures and guidelines in operating the security engineering services in the Managed Services model, which includes the following:


  • Support day-to-day administration and operations of Wiz.io and Azure cloud security platforms.
  • Monitor cloud security posture, security findings, misconfigurations, and policy violations across Azure environments.
  • Review and triage cloud security alerts, vulnerabilities, exposure findings, and risk notifications identified through Wiz.
  • Assist with onboarding cloud subscriptions, workloads, applications, and resources into cloud security monitoring platforms.
  • Support cloud asset visibility, inventory management, and security posture reporting activities.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud engineering, and application teams to track remediation of identified cloud security issues.
  • Perform initial analysis of cloud security findings and assist in prioritizing remediation efforts based on risk and business impact.
  • Monitor platform health, integrations, data collection, and cloud security coverage across the environment.
  • Support incident management, service request fulfillment, and operational troubleshooting related to cloud security platforms.
  • Execute routine platform maintenance, configuration updates, reporting activities, and operational support tasks in accordance with change management procedures.
  • Develop operational reports, security dashboards, cloud security metrics, and documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on strengthening cloud security posture, visibility, and compliance.



The team

Deloitte’s Security Engineering Managed Services team helps clients operate, monitor, and continuously improve their cybersecurity technologies and security infrastructure. The team supports endpoint security, network security, cloud security, data protection, email security, security automation, and related operational services by applying defined operating procedures, service levels, industry-leading security practices, and continuous improvement principles. Working across a diverse technology ecosystem, the team is responsible for maintaining platform health, responding to incidents and requests, implementing configuration changes, driving operational excellence, and enhancing the organization's overall security posture through proactive monitoring, governance, and engineering support.



Required:

  • Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Cloud Security, Cyber Security Operations, Security Engineering, or Infrastructure Security.
  • Basic understanding of Azure cloud services, cloud architecture, and cloud security concepts.
  • Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) principles and cloud security best practices.
  • Knowledge of Azure Identity and Access Management, networking, storage, compute, and security services.
  • Understanding of cloud security risks, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and remediation concepts.
  • Experience supporting security monitoring, incident management, or operational security activities.
  • Ability to analyze security findings and follow established remediation and escalation processes.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, service requests, incidents, and change management processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.




Preferred:

  • Bachelors in computer science or other technical fields.
  • Exposure to Wiz.io, Microsoft Azure Security Center/Defender for Cloud, or similar CSPM platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure deployments, cloud workload security, and cloud governance concepts.
  • Understanding of cloud compliance frameworks and security standards such as NIST, CIS, HIPAA, or ISO 27001.
  • Experience working with security tools, vulnerability management platforms, or cloud monitoring solutions.
  • Knowledge of scripting or automation technologies such as PowerShell, Python, or Azure CLI is a plus.
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Microsoft Security Fundamentals (SC-900), or similar certifications preferred.
  • Security certifications such as Security+ or equivalent are a plus.

title: Senior AML Analyst (Legal Entities EDDs)
description:

What you'll do

As our Senior AML Analyst, you'll help protect Mintos and our investors from financial crime while keeping the platform transparent and compliant. title: Junior Mechanical EIT
description:
CIMA+’s Energy & Resources team is a key player in the energy transition. With more than 700 highly qualified professional in this business sector, we are one of the largest teams specializing in this discipline among consulting engineering firms in Canada. Guided by an entrepreneurial culture based on innovation, sustainability, multidisciplinary agility and collaboration, we support our clients at all stages of their projects, from feasibility studies to commissioning. Join us and immerse yourself in a dynamic, innovative, and collaborative environment where you’ll make a real impact. Together, we’ll push boundaries and go above what’s expected of us to meet the challenges of tomorrow and engineer a better world!

Guided by an entrepreneurial culture built on innovation, sustainability, multidisciplinary agility, and collaboration, we support our clients throughout all stages of their projects, from feasibility studies through commissioning. Our work spans renewable energy generation, industrial facilities, and resource transformation. Regardless of the project delivery model, we bring the skills and experience required to develop innovative solutions adapted to our clients’ needs.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Junior Mechanical EIT to join our Mechanical Resources team in Vancouver or Calgary. Working as part of our broader Energy & Resources team, you will contribute to multidisciplinary industrial projects with a particular focus on piping engineering and pipe stress analysis.

The successful candidate will support pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II and work closely with piping design, structural, mechanical equipment, and other engineering disciplines. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer looking to build strong technical expertise in piping systems while gaining exposure to a variety of industrial projects.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Develop and review piping stress models for thermal, sustained, occasional, seismic, and other applicable loading conditions.
  • Assist in evaluating piping systems for compliance with applicable codes and project requirements.
  • Review piping layouts, P&IDs, isometrics, equipment drawings, and vendor documentation as inputs to stress analysis.
  • Evaluate equipment nozzle loads and coordinate findings with mechanical equipment and piping teams.
  • Assist with pipe support selection and design, including spring supports and other specialty supports where required.
  • Prepare stress isometrics, calculations, technical documentation, and pipe stress reports.
  • Coordinate with piping, structural, mechanical, and other engineering disciplines to resolve design issues identified through stress analysis.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and project coordination meetings.
  • Support brownfield, sustaining capital, and other industrial projects.
  • Participate in site visits and field surveys as required.
  • Assist with the preparation of proposals, scopes of work, and fee estimates when required.
  • Ensure work is completed in accordance with CIMA+ quality, health and safety, and project requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in piping engineering, piping design, or pipe stress analysis. Candidates with less experience and strong pipe stress fundamentals will also be considered.
  • Working knowledge of CAESAR II for static pipe stress analysis.
  • Familiarity with applicable piping codes such as ASME B31.1, B31.3, and/or B31.9.
  • Understanding of piping layouts, isometrics, P&IDs, and general piping design principles.
  • Ability to interpret equipment vendor drawings and datasheets, including equipment nozzle allowable loads.
  • Basic understanding of thermal, sustained, occasional, and seismic load case development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word for engineering calculations, reporting, and documentation.
  • Eligibility for registration as an Engineer-in-Training (EIT) with the applicable provincial engineering regulator.
  • Integrity, team spirit, and a commitment to excellence.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design. Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Job Overview

NAFFCO is looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to support supply chain planning, procurement, inventory management, logistics coordination, and operational reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills and practical experience in analysing supply chain data, monitoring inventory levels, identifying process improvements, and supporting efficient material flow from suppliers to customers.

The successful candidate will work closely with procurement, warehouse, production, logistics, finance, sales, and other internal teams to improve supply chain performance, ensure product availability, control costs, and support timely business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse supply chain, procurement, inventory, and logistics data to identify trends, risks, variances, and improvement opportunities.

  • Monitor inventory levels, stock movements, replenishment requirements, slow-moving items, excess stock, and potential stockouts.

  • Support demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, and material requirements planning activities.

  • Prepare regular reports and dashboards covering inventory, purchasing, supplier performance, order fulfilment, logistics, and supply chain KPIs.

  • Track purchase orders, material availability, delivery schedules, and supplier commitments.

  • Coordinate with procurement and suppliers to follow up on delayed, incomplete, or urgent orders.

  • Review purchasing and inventory data to support cost control, efficient stock utilisation, and improved working capital management.

  • Monitor supplier performance, including delivery times, lead times, order accuracy, quality issues, and service levels.

  • Support the development and maintenance of supply chain performance indicators and service-level reports.

  • Investigate supply chain discrepancies, including inventory variances, delivery delays, order issues, and data inconsistencies.

  • Maintain accurate supply chain master data, including item codes, supplier information, lead times, minimum order quantities, and replenishment parameters.

  • Assist with warehouse and inventory audits, cycle counts, stock reconciliation, and corrective action tracking.

  • Support logistics planning and analyse transportation, freight, delivery, and distribution performance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve supply chain processes, reduce lead times, minimise costs, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Prepare ad hoc analysis and management reports to support supply chain and business decisions.

  • Work with internal departments to ensure accurate and timely communication of supply, inventory, and delivery information.

  • Ensure supply chain records and reports are maintained in accordance with company procedures and internal controls.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field.

  • Relevant professional experience in supply chain analysis, procurement, inventory management, logistics, or operations.

  • Strong experience in analysing supply chain data and preparing operational reports.

  • Good understanding of procurement, demand planning, inventory control, warehouse operations, logistics, and supplier management.

  • Experience with ERP systems and supply chain, procurement, inventory, or warehouse management modules.

  • Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and reporting.

  • Experience with data visualisation or reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.

  • Ability to develop and monitor supply chain KPIs and performance dashboards.

  • Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work accurately with large volumes of operational and supply chain data.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies and data quality issues.

  • Good communication and coordination skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting and operational deadlines.

  • Knowledge of supply chain performance measures, inventory optimisation, and process improvement principles.

Required Skills

  • Supply chain data analysis and reporting.

  • Inventory analysis and stock control.

  • Procurement and supplier performance monitoring.

  • Demand forecasting and replenishment planning.

  • ERP systems and supply chain management software.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and data analysis.

  • Supply chain KPI development and dashboard reporting.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Process improvement and root-cause analysis.

  • Effective communication and cross-functional coordination.

What We’re Looking For

Candidates with practical experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, procurement reporting, logistics coordination, and ERP-based data management will be preferred. Experience in a manufacturing, distribution, trading, or multi-site supply chain environment will be an added advantage.

title: HOST
description:
Host / Hostess:


Komodo Las Vegas, a Groot Hospitality venue employs team members who demonstrate a passion for hospitality and dedication to company values and customer service. We are a diverse organization that provides the opportunity to excel in a fast-paced multicultural environment. We are always looking for passionate people who will embrace our belief of hospitality, company growth and customer experience. Our commitment to diversity, teamwork, and integrity are indicative of the service we provide to our guests. We offer career opportunities with work/life balances, as well as a rewarding career experience.


As a Hostess/Host, you help set the standards by which our restaurant is judged in your personal appearance, your disposition, and your attitude towards the guest. You are always in full view of the guest. You only get one opportunity to make a first impression.

Good communication skills are a must. Your working relationship with the entire staff is vital to the operation of the restaurant. You must be able to anticipate guest needs, as well as communicate those needs to your service staff. Many times, you will be asked to take care of the problem yourself.


A good Host needs to have a positive attitude at all times and be able to maintain that attitude in any situation. Our goal is to be busy. When our restaurant is busy, we all make money. Being busy is not an excuse to not be friendly or forgetting to smile and acknowledge the guests.


Due to the nature of our business, this position is required to work weekends and holidays.


The day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to:


General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Attends all restaurant required meetings and trainings.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Groot hospitality standards.
  • Full time availability with flexibility to work a variable schedule, including evenings, holidays and weekends.
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which includes wearing the proper uniform.
  • Follow food safety and sanitary guidelines issued by the Health Department.
  • Complete assigned side-work in allocated timeframe.
  • Needs to have strong food and beverage menu knowledge.
  • Has complete knowledge of the floor plan, table #’s and stations.
  • Greets guests promptly as they enter the restaurant, making a positive first impression.
  • Greets guests warmly with a smile, making eye contact.
  • Knows and acknowledges all VIP’s by name.
  • Answers phones, keeps accurate count of waitlist and reservations.
  • Collects and stores menus. Maintains the cleanliness and preventability of the menus.
  • Ensures that all menus are current according to the most recent changes.
  • Replaces all menus in poor condition after making sure that replacements are available.
  • Monitors which tables are in use, available, and about to turnover. Is immediately aware when tables are reset and ready for guests. Checks for completeness of table settings.
  • Keeps an accurate count of guests providing the kitchen and management with updates regularly.
  • Frequently checks back with guests who are waiting in the bar area to be seated. Makes it evident to guests that they have not been forgotten and that tables are being prepared for them.
  • When a guest is leaving, always thank them and use their name when able to.

Physical Requirements:

  • Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 pounds of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.
  • Ability to be mobile for a minimum of 6 hour on your feet.
  • Teamwork is the cornerstone of our company philosophy. You are expected to work with other hosts as a team. You are also expected to work with other servers, runners, hosts, server assistant, managers and all of your colleagues. During service here are some things that you can do, to help promote that teamwork.
  • Communicate, with respect, to your team any pertinent information that you feel may affect the guest experience
  • Communicate with management if there are any issues that you see that could affect the guest's experience
  • If you see that something is not in the correct place, fix it

The above job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the position. All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees. Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

· Take feedback constructively and work collaboratively with teams that have strong interdependencies.

Optimisation & Performance Mindset

· Use campaign performance insights and customer behaviour to continuously improve email design and creative effectiveness.

· Bring a commercial lens to design decisions, understanding how creative impacts customer conversion both in-store and online.

· Marry data-driven insights with on-brand visual execution to improve customer engagement and campaign outcomes.

· Stay connected to best practice in digital design and emerging trends in email, CRM and marketing technology.
