title: Trygg og engasjert assistent søkes til 14-åring i Bergen
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid på hverdager, med fleksibilitet etter avtale

Hei!

Jeg er en sporty gutt på 14 år som bor i Bergen, og nå ser jeg etter en eller flere assistenter som kan bli en viktig del av hverdagen min. På fritiden liker jeg gaming og e-sport, styrketrening og ulike sportsaktiviteter. Jeg trives både ute og inne, og liker blant annet friluftsliv, klatring, alpint og skøyter. Jeg er en snill og rolig gutt med glimt i øyet, og håper å finne noen som har lyst til å bli godt kjent med meg over tid.

Årsaken til at jeg trenger assistanse er litt sammensatt. Jeg har ingen fysiske funksjonsnedsettelser, men lever med blant annet alvorlig ADHD og angst. Dette gjør at jeg kan ha utfordringer med å komme i gang med, og gjennomføre daglige gjøremål på egen hånd. Derfor trenger jeg en trygg og støttende assistent som kan hjelpe meg med å skape struktur, motivasjon og en hverdag som fungerer best mulig. Humøret og dagsformen min kan variere, og noen dager vil være enklere enn andre. Derfor betyr det mye for meg å ha en assistent som er tålmodig, forståelsesfull og flink til å møte meg der jeg er.

Jeg søker nå 1–2 faste assistenter i stillinger på 15–30 timer per uke, samt tilkallingsvikarer. Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, med størst behov på formiddag og tidlig ettermiddag. Siden dette er et nytt BPA-vedtak, ønsker jeg at du oppgir i søknaden hvor stor stilling du ønsker, og hvilke dager og tider som passer best for deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Praktisk og sosial bistand i hverdagen

  • Være en trygg ledsager til daglige gjøremål og aktiviteter

  • Bidra med motivasjon og støtte i hverdagen

  • Delta på fritidsaktiviteter og bidra til en aktiv hverdag

Personlige egenskaper jeg ser etter:

  • Rolig, tålmodig og pålitelig

  • Initiativrik og engasjert

  • Omsorgsfull og flink til å lese dagsform og behov

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner

  • Evne til å skape trygge og gode relasjoner

  • Positiv og motiverende

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Ønskelig med førerkort klasse B, men dette er ikke et krav

  • Plettfri politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

For meg er det viktig å finne assistenter som ønsker å bli værende over tid. Det kan ta tid å bygge en trygg relasjon, og derfor håper jeg å høre fra deg som ønsker en meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig kan utgjøre en forskjell.

Ved spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no.

Vi tilbyr

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 225,40 kr, kveldstillegg 60 kr og helgetillegg 57 kr

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer og nettbutikker

  • En meningsfull jobb

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring

  • Relevante kurs

  • Verdifull erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende, og vi ansetter så snart vi finner de rette kandidatene.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
As a Senior Product Manager at GS1 Canada, you own a customer experience of considerable scope and complexity — a complete product, a significant platform capability, or an experience that spans several teams. The problem and the strategy may not be defined yet; you use expertise and judgment to set the right goals and design solutions that last.

You work in an empowered product team with engineering, design, business stakeholders, and subscribers. You lead initiatives and deliver independently, seeking direction when you need it, and you influence strategy, adoption decisions, and organizational priorities. You also coach and mentor other product managers.

GS1 Canada has defined a structured product operating model and is rolling it out across teams; this role owns a meaningful part of it.
Customer Understanding
  • Act as the voice of the customer, synthesizing needs across diverse subscriber personas and use cases in your scope.
  • Engage subscribers directly and watch them use what you have built, rather than relying on second-hand research.
  • Separate representative signal from anecdote, and stated requests from the underlying problem, using research, support data, and usage patterns.
  • Conduct market research to understand the competitive landscape and size opportunities.
Strategy and Decision-Making
  • Define the product vision, problem statement, and strategy for your scope, and own the roadmap and priorities.
  • Understand your business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing, and cost to serve — and connect product decisions to business outcomes.
  • Work through business model and pricing implications so your product is financially sustainable while creating subscriber value.
  • Reason from first principles and treat reversible decisions differently from irreversible ones: experiment quickly where a choice can be undone, apply rigour where it cannot.
  • Make trade-offs and align stakeholders when data is incomplete, deciding with judgment rather than waiting for certainty.
Technical Judgment
  • Go deep enough technically to understand not just what a technology does, but the trade-offs it carries.
  • Assess technical proposals for risk and reversibility, asking what a design makes harder to change later.
  • Balance new capability against system health, recognizing that velocity decisions carry long-term architectural consequences.
  • Apply a working understanding of AI and agentic systems to accelerate discovery, delivery, and decision quality.
Design and Customer Experience
  • Partner with design and engineering on prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and take part in testing and validation.
  • Ground decisions in utility, intuitiveness, and simplicity rather than personal preference.
  • Balance compliance, localization, and accessibility requirements against experience quality.
  • Manage cross-team dependencies and drive delivery to completion, navigating roadblocks and competing demands.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, user story creation, and UAT.
  • Judge when a product is ready to ship, and which simplifications are acceptable.
  • Own launches and product performance before and after release, including adoption and continued evolution.
Measurement and Outcomes
  • Define success criteria and KPIs, distinguishing output measures such as adoption from outcomes such as satisfaction and business impact.
  • Analyze usage, performance, and behavioral data to prioritize investment.
  • Monitor operational health after launch and drive unresolved issues to resolution.
  • Watch support and operational signals for trends that warrant a roadmap response, rather than treating issues case by case.
Collaboration, Influence, and Mentorship
  • Work across engineering, design, data, finance, marketing, account management, legal, and operations to deliver for the customer.
  • Influence without authority, building alignment across teams with competing priorities.
  • Communicate product progress, decisions, and value clearly to Directors, VPs, partners, and subscribers.
  • Produce concise written documents and contribute to annual and mid-year planning and budgeting.
  • Mentor and coach product managers on product management practice.
  • 6+ years in product management in a SaaS or platform environment, including ownership of a complete product or a significant platform capability.
  • Experience setting direction where the problem, opportunity, and strategy were undefined.
  • Track record of owning measurable outcomes — adoption, retention, revenue, or operational efficiency — not feature output alone.
  • Experience with API-first, data-driven platforms; AI-enabled products and mobile launches are an asset
  • Technical fluency to evaluate engineering proposals and assess architectural trade-offs credibly.
  • Strong writing: concise strategy narratives, product briefs, and business cases that move decisions forward.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and present to Director and VP audiences.
  • Able to design and run market research independently.
  • Solid grounding in product discovery, agile delivery, user-centered design, and product analytics
  • Knowledge of GS1 standards and GS1 Canada’s solutions, services, and platform, or the ability to build that depth quickly.
  • Current on emerging technology, including AI and agentic models, and pragmatic about where it adds value.
  • Experience mentoring product managers is not required but is considered an asset.

description:

Role: SAP Group Reporting Consultant
Location: HYDERABAD | BANGALORE | PUNE | CHENNAI
Experience: 6 Years
Notice Period:0-30 days(If you have negotiable notice period or buyout option please apply)



Requirements

We are looking for an experienced SAP Group Reporting Consultant with 6+ years of SAP consulting experience, including at least 2 end-to-end SAP implementations with strong hands-on experience in SAP Group Reporting configuration, implementation, rollout, and consolidation processes.

The ideal candidate will have SME-level expertise in financial consolidation, intercompany eliminations, group close, ownership structures, currency translation, and consolidated financial reporting. The candidate should be capable of leading finance and controllership workshops, translating business requirements into configuration-ready specifications, and working directly with senior client stakeholders.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance, Group Reporting Data Collection, and integration with S/4HANA GL is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Group Reporting Implementation

  • Lead and deliver SAP Group Reporting implementation and rollout activities.
  • Configure SAP Group Reporting based on business and consolidation requirements.
  • Participate in at least 2 end-to-end SAP implementation projects, from requirement gathering through UAT, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Define and implement consolidation processes aligned with SAP-recommended best practices.
  • Analyze existing legacy consolidation processes and recommend appropriate SAP Group Reporting solutions.
  • Support migration from legacy consolidation tools such as SAP BPC, HFM, or similar platforms.

Consolidation Process Design

  • Lead process design workshops with Finance, Controllership, Accounting, and other business stakeholders.
  • Understand existing consolidation pain points and translate them into:
    • User stories
    • Business requirements
    • Functional specifications
    • Configuration-ready requirements
  • Design end-to-end group close and consolidation processes.
  • Define appropriate consolidation rules, validations, and reporting requirements.
  • Present proposed consolidation designs and solutions to client stakeholders, including CFO-level audiences.

Financial Consolidation & Group Close

  • Provide SME-level expertise across:
    • Consolidation
    • Intercompany eliminations
    • Group close
    • Minority interest
    • Currency translation
    • Consolidated financial statements
    • Consolidation of investments
    • Ownership structures
    • Equity pickup
  • Configure and support consolidation logic according to accounting and business requirements.
  • Support statutory and management consolidation reporting cycles.
  • Troubleshoot consolidation discrepancies and support root-cause analysis.

Data Collection & Integration

  • Configure and support various Group Reporting data collection methods, including:
    • Flexible upload
    • Real-time integration from SAP S/4HANA
    • Matrix consolidation
  • Work with SAP Group Reporting Data Collection processes.
  • Support integration between SAP Group Reporting and SAP S/4HANA / Central Finance / S/4HANA GL.
  • Validate data flows from source systems into Group Reporting.
  • Troubleshoot data collection, mapping, validation, and consolidation issues.

Currency Translation & Ownership

  • Configure and support currency translation within SAP Group Reporting.
  • Understand and implement ownership structures and consolidation methods.
  • Configure consolidation of investments and equity pickup logic.
  • Support complex organizational structures and consolidation scenarios.
  • Validate ownership percentages, investment balances, and consolidation results.

Reporting & Financial Statements

  • Design and maintain Financial Statement Versions (FSVs).
  • Configure reporting hierarchies and consolidation reporting structures.
  • Support consolidated financial statement reporting.
  • Develop and validate management and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Perform reconciliation between source financial data and consolidated outputs.
  • Use advanced Excel and reporting-layer capabilities for validation and reconciliation.

Testing, UAT & Cutover

  • Prepare and execute functional and integration testing for Group Reporting.
  • Lead and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
  • Coordinate business users during UAT and defect resolution.
  • Support parallel-run cycles during consolidation cutover.
  • Validate consolidated results against legacy systems and expected business outcomes.
  • Support cutover, go-live, and post-production stabilization activities.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Work directly with Finance, Accounting, Controllership, and IT stakeholders.
  • Lead client discussions and explain complex consolidation concepts in business-friendly language.
  • Present solution designs, process flows, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Manage requirements, dependencies, risks, and issues across implementation workstreams.
  • Provide consulting guidance and recommend SAP best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of overall SAP consulting experience.
  • Minimum 2 end-to-end SAP implementations.
  • Strong hands-on experience in SAP Group Reporting configuration and rollout.
  • SME-level understanding of:
    • Financial consolidation
    • Intercompany eliminations
    • Group close
    • Minority interest
    • Currency translation
    • Consolidated financial statements
  • Strong accounting and financial consolidation background.
  • Experience with consolidation of investments and ownership structures.
  • Understanding of equity pickup logic.
  • Experience with Group Reporting Data Collection.
  • Knowledge of currency translation configuration.
  • Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA GL and Group Reporting integration.
  • Experience designing financial statement versions and reporting hierarchies.
  • Strong Excel and reconciliation skills.
  • Experience managing UAT, parallel runs, cutover, and go-live activities.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with SAP Central Finance and Group Reporting integration.
  • Experience migrating from SAP BPC, HFM, or other legacy consolidation solutions to SAP Group Reporting.
  • Knowledge of SAP-recommended best practices for Group Reporting.
  • Experience with statutory and management consolidation.
  • Prior Big 4 / consulting delivery experience preferred.
  • SAP Group Reporting certification preferred.
  • Exposure to AI tools such as Claude or Gemini for reconciliation automation, documentation, or productivity improvement is a plus.
  • Experience with automation, reporting tools, or reconciliation solutions is an advantage.

title: Residential Counselor FT (68961)
company: Volunteers of America Chesapeake and Carolinas
location: Baltimore Behavioral Health - Windsor Mill, MD 21244
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Volunteers of America Chesapeake & Carolinas empowers self-reliance and inspires hope. As a church without walls, we do this through personalized housing, ministry, health, and human services that benefit vulnerable individuals, their families and the community. Founded in 1896 in Baltimore, MD by social reformers, Ballington and Maud Booth, we were one of the first of over 30 affiliates of Volunteers of America – one of the nation’s largest and most comprehensive human services organizations.

Our founders envisioned a movement dedicated to reaching and uplifting the American people. On behalf of the organization, the Booths pledged “to go wherever we are needed, and do whatever comes to hand”. Their declaration continues to guide Volunteers of America's impact on “Helping America’s most vulnerable”.

Through a dedicated and committed team of more than 850 employees and thousands of volunteers, we provide critical care, support services and hope to thousands of people each year throughout Virginia, Maryland, the District of Columbia and the Carolinas. We firmly believe our employees drive the success of the organization. Through our diversity, equity and inclusion efforts, we endeavor to attract, engage and retain qualified, diverse, compassionate individuals to join our journey and experience a work environment that offers challenging, stimulating and financially rewarding opportunities.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the group homes’ Residential Coordinator, but under the clinical supervision of the Rehabilitation Director, the Residential Counselor is responsible for the provision of direct services which promote the ability of clients to participate in appropriate community activities and which contribute to the development and utilization of skills necessary for independent living. Additionally, the Residential Counselor will participate in the assessment of the client's rehabilitation needs and, in the development, implementation and monitoring of the client's individual rehabilitation plan. The Residential Counselor is also responsible for providing crisis services, including intensive support and assistance, and may be required to provide follow-along services to suspended or discharged clients. The Residential Counselor is responsible for driving and/or transporting clients.

The Residential Counselor is also responsible for ensuring that clients develop and utilize skills that contribute to the maintenance of a safe residential environment as well as documenting service delivery. The Residential Counselor may be privileged to provide basic health teaching in the areas of nutrition, exercise, dental care, substance abuse prevention, and prevention of injury and illness at home and in the community as well as training in communicable disease prevention.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participates in the assessment of clients' rehabilitative service needs and, in the development, implementation and monitoring of the individual's rehabilitation plan
  • Coordinates activities and delivers rehabilitation and support services which address individual client goals and objectives contained within the client's rehabilitation plan which are directed toward the development or restoration of independent living skills.
  • Such activities may include the development or restoration of self-care skills including personal hygiene, grooming, menu planning and preparation, socialization skills, independent living skills, including the maintenance of the individual's living environment, community awareness, mobility skills and/or money management.
  • The Residential Counselor may be privileged to provide health teaching and prevention of communicable diseases.
  • Provides basic supervision in home-like environments for individuals with varying levels of mental illness.
  • Coordinates activities which promote community integration.
  • Communicates with program staff regarding client progress.
  • Documents service delivery and prepares daily billing statements as directed.
  • As needed, and when privileged, monitors client self-administration of prescribed medication, provides for safe storage of medications and monitors client reaction to medication, taking appropriate action when necessary. May also provide reinforcing education on the role and effects of medication in symptom management.
  • As needed, and when privileged, provides basic health teaching in areas including nutrition, exercise, dental care, substance abuse prevention, prevention of injury and illness at home and in the community, and the prevention of communicable disease; including the prevention of sexually transmitted diseases and blood borne pathogens including, HIV/AIDS.
  • Ensures assigned vehicles are maintained appropriately.
  • Collects and records data as required. Monitor resident and program documentation.
  • Participates in discharge planning and the provision of follow-along services when appropriate.
  • Attends staff meetings, training, house and program meetings as required.
  • Ensures client and program compliance with VOAC policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for maintaining homes inspection ready and reporting problems to the Residential Coordinator.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical requirements described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • The ability to safely operate a motor vehicle to transport oneself and/or equipment as necessary
  • The physical ability to travel to assigned locations, stand, sit, stoop, bend, reach, pull, push, lift, grasp, climb, talk, see, hear and perform basic and light home maintenance activities and operate office equipment.
  • Move and lift objects up to 30 pounds such as computers, monitors, files, etc.
  • Operate office equipment requiring continuous or repetitive hand/arm movements.
  • The ability to remain in a sitting position for extended periods of time.

OTHER DUTIES

title: Senior Printer Technician (Lead)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Position Title: Senior Printer Technician (Lead)

Job Summary:

The Senior Printer Technician (Lead) provides advanced operational support and technical leadership throughout the full lifecycle of enterprise print assets, including installation, configuration, maintenance, repair, decommissioning, and disposal, to ensure the proper functioning of HP printers, copiers, fax machines, and peripherals across a multi-site fleet. This role serves as the senior technical escalation point for complex hardware, firmware, and network issues, and is the primary on-the-ground liaison for the organization's enterprise-managed print services (MPS) program. The Senior Printer Technician integrates day-to-day field service with the enterprise MPS platform, ensuring device telemetry, supply replenishment, service tickets, and fleet performance data remain accurate and actionable. In addition to performing hands-on repair and preventive maintenance, this role mentors junior and intermediate technicians, leads root-cause analysis on recurring or fleet-wide issues, and partners with IT leadership, OEM account teams, and the MPS provider to drive continuous improvement in service levels, asset utilization, and total cost of ownership.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential Duties:

  • Serve as the senior, hands-on technical lead for the printer fleet within an assigned territory, installing, configuring, and maintaining HP printers, copiers, fax machines, and associated peripherals on the network, and directing the work of junior and intermediate technicians on complex or multi-device engagements.
  • Act as the primary field point of contact for the enterprise-managed print services (MPS) platform, ensuring device data, meter reads, supply thresholds, and service events synchronize correctly between on-site equipment and the MPS provider's monitoring and dispatch systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve advanced printer malfunctions, including hardware, firmware, and network connectivity issues across wired Internet Protocol access, HTML configuration portal access, Near Field Communications (NFC), Bluetooth, and wireless (802.11) network access services, escalating to OEM Tier 4 engineering only when on-site and regional resources are exhausted.
  • Lead root-cause analysis on recurring, fleet-wide, or high-impact service issues, document findings, and recommend corrective action plans, configuration standards, or hardware refresh strategies to IT leadership and the MPS account team.
  • Perform and oversee routine preventive maintenance, including paper loading and unloading, replenishing supplies, field-replaceable unit (FRU) replacement, and equipment cleaning, and validate that preventive maintenance schedules align with MPS service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Manage and maintain onsite and regional parts inventory, control territory parts budget, and reconcile inventory and consumable usage against MPS reporting and replenishment forecasts.
  • Assess equipment and fleet performance trends to identify systemic sources of problems, propose solutions, and implement corrective actions, including device right-sizing, redeployment, or end-of-life recommendations.
  • Own escalated dispatch calls and complex service activity; serve as the next-level escalation point for intermediate and junior technicians and engage regional/central support and OEM Tier 3-4 services to drive root-cause resolution and timely return to service.
  • Interact directly with customers, account stakeholders, and enterprise IT leadership before, during, and after site visits to confirm corrective measures, validate issue resolution, and support broader account health discussions tied to the MPS contract.
  • Communicate estimated task completion times, status updates, SLA performance, and potential problems to customers, service management, and the MPS provider, including contributions to quarterly business reviews and fleet performance summaries.
  • Perform and validate hard drive wiping and data sanitization for all persistent storage media as required and ensure data destruction records meet enterprise security and contractual compliance documentation standards.
  • Record, upgrade, and replace hardware and software systems; install and reinstall software packages and updates, including firmware and security patches pushed through the enterprise MPS management console.
  • Provide advanced feedback and analysis, including customer information, printer usage reports, and fleet utilization data, to support MPS optimization initiatives, cost-per-page analysis, and contract renewal discussions.
  • Resolve complex Local Area Network (LAN) connectivity issues related to printers and printing, including Netware (legacy), Wireless, USB, Mac OS, and Windows OS environments, across multiple sites and network segments.
  • Lead the sale and administration of maintenance agreements, manage equipment upgrades and fleet refresh projects, and coordinate device onboarding and offboarding within the enterprise MPS platform.
  • Maintain a positive, trusted relationship with customers and enterprise stakeholders; maintain advanced OEM certifications necessary for supported contracts; attend manufacturer and MPS platform training sessions; and mentor other technicians to remain current on technology and process advancements.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical guidance to junior and intermediate printer technicians, including on-the-job coaching, knowledge-sharing sessions, and review of complex repair and configuration work.
  • Offer senior-level technical support for the identification, prioritization, and resolution of reported problems, and serve as a subject-matter resource for enterprise print security, compliance, and MPS integration questions.

Other Duties: Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Data Management Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


Skills and Competencies

  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong quantitative and problem-solving abilities required
  • Experience in Structured Finance/ Securitization field (RMBS, ABS or CMBS) is preferred but not necessary as sufficient training will be given. Candidate must be able to understand the fundamentals around these structures
  • Experience with data tools, scripting and/or programming skills such as SQL, Python, VBA, C# is a must. Candidates might be tested on their stated abilities to write code and/or problem-solving skills
  • This position requires great attention to detail, organization and ability to work effectively in a team setting to deliver outputs accurately in timely fashion
  • A positive, motivated and self-starting attitude is required to have the initiative levels needed to succeed in fulfilling the responsibilities of this role

Education

  • Candidate must have at least a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computing, Statistics, Mathematics or related quantitative field
  • Additional qualifications in Finance or Computing would be preferred (e.g. CFA, FRM, AWS, SQL, Python, other)

Responsibilities

  • Actively increase and maintain CMBS, ABS and RMBS deal universe to ensure timely extraction of data, perform data quality checks and execute resolutions as needed
  • Lead/Participate in quality and productivity enhancement projects and create/test specifications using multiple tools such as Jira
  • Lead/Participate in ETL tool development, automation and enhancement
  • Understand and contribute towards workflow processes, data visualization and project management
  • Work closely with vendors, asset class desk and client support teams regarding client challenges, new feature developments, and new securitization product analysis in the market
  • Utilize coding skills to query, troubleshoot and analyse data; as well as create and maintain reports and applications
  • Work independently but knowing that the team is there to support. Share knowledge, create and maintain documentation
  • Contribute towards deal structure set up for securitization transactions using our proprietary software. You may be tasked with assisting on data issues pertaining to Cash Flow (Waterfall) model for various CMBS ABS and RMBS transactions for external and internal clients, supporting our product and software development teams for these products

About the team

Our Data Management team, within the Structured Finance domain of the Data Estate, is responsible for data acquisition, extraction, enrichment and maintenance in our systems, using our in-house proprietary ETL processes, modelling and deal updating tools. These feed our data and waterfall cash flow modelling products with data of various securitization deal libraries (CMBS,ABS, RMBS, etc.), used by a variety of leading stakeholders in the industry. We are looking for a Data Management Associate to join our team. You will be part of exciting work in data operations and management, as well as gain a solid understanding of structured finance. The team handles a variety of quantitative and qualitative tasks, which develop your skills and abilities to the highest standards

title: Project Manager (Dutch-speaking)
description:
Project Manager (Dutch-speaking)
London, UK (hybrid) · £60,000 – £70,000

Puzzel: The Low-Down 🔍

Puzzel is a leading provider of cloud-based contact centre solutions, empowering businesses to deliver exceptional customer service. Our platform combines omnichannel contact centre, workforce management, and AI-driven analytics to optimize customer interactions and operational efficiency.

With 25 years’ experience since our foundation in Norway, we’re already #1 in the Nordics; growing rapidly in the UK and we are already seeing some great success in the Netherlands since opening the entity in mid-2024, but our ambition is to become the clear European market-leader in the coming years 🚀

Why we’re proud

  • Recognised as an Innovation and Growth Leader in the 2025 EMEA Customer Experience Platforms Frost Radar

  • 2024 CX Awards Winner, ‘Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform’

  • Puzzel was recognised as the 'most innovative European-founded CCaaS provider' and top 3 globally by Frost & Sullivan in 2023

  • Best Practices Company of the Year 2023

  • Consistently high Glassdoor rating

  • Puzzel places high importance on work-life balance and flexible working hours - as recognised by Flexa, placing 16th overall for work:life balance in 2025!

  • We are working with Mercer on salary benchmarking, to ensure pay equality and market competitiveness

Read more about us here.

What you'll do 🏡💻

We're a growing business, and our Professional Services team plays a central role in that growth: helping customers implement, adopt and get lasting value from Puzzel's platform. Puzzel is increasingly partner-first in how we go to market, so much of our delivery work is done alongside, not just for, our customers - through implementation partners, resellers and other third parties. As we expand across the UK and Benelux markets, we're looking for a Project Manager who can bridge both regions and operate confidently in that partner-led model.

As Project Manager, you'll take end-to-end ownership of customer implementation projects, primarily supporting our UK and Dutch customer base. Given our partner-first approach, relationship management is at the heart of this role: you'll be the connective tissue between the customer, our delivery teams and our partners, so being an excellent communicator and relationship-builder matters as much as your project management craft.

You'll report to the PMO Lead and sit within the wider Professional Services team, following Puzzel's established PMO methodology, tools and governance. We don't micromanage - you'll be given real ownership of your projects and trusted to use your initiative. In return, we expect accountability: you own the outcome, you flag what needs flagging, and you don't wait to be asked.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of customer implementation projects from kick-off through to go-live and hypercare, primarily for UK and Dutch customers.

  • Build and manage strong relationships with customers, delivery partners and internal stakeholders - acting as a trusted, confident point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, in both English and Dutch.

  • Work hand-in-hand with implementation and channel partners as part of Puzzel's partner-first delivery model, aligning plans, expectations and ways of working across all parties.

  • Build and maintain project plans, RAID logs, communication plans and status reporting in line with Puzzel's PMO playbook and governance standards.

  • Coordinate cross-functional and third-party resources (technical consultants, solution architects, partners) to keep delivery on track.

  • Take full ownership of risks, issues and scope changes — resolving them proactively and using your own judgement on when and what to escalate.

  • Manage project financials, including tracking effort against budget and supporting change order processes where scope shifts.

  • Run structured UAT and hypercare phases, ensuring a smooth handover from delivery to business-as-usual support.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO processes and share learnings across the Professional Services team.

The must haves 💪

Experience matters most to us for this role. We're looking for someone who has genuinely run projects - not just supported them - and who brings strong relationship-building and communication skills to a partner-first way of working.

  • Minimum 3 years' experience running end-to-end projects, ideally within software, SaaS, or technology implementations.

    - An excellent communicator, comfortable managing a wide range of stakeholders — customers, partners and internal teams — and building genuine, productive relationships with each.

    - Highly accountable and self-led — someone who takes ownership of outcomes, uses their own initiative, and doesn't need close supervision to stay on track.

    - Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.

    - Sound commercial awareness, including experience managing project budgets, timelines and scope.

    - A proactive, solutions-focused mindset — someone who spots problems early and brings solutions, not just issues, to the table.

  • Fluent Dutch and English, with the confidence to manage stakeholder relationships and project communications in both languages.

The location

London office (hybrid). We're looking for someone comfortably commutable to our London office - ideally based within the M25 - with regular travel to customer and partner sites in the UK and the Netherlands as needed (travel costs covered).

What’s In it for You? 💰

You'll join a growing, international business at a genuinely exciting stage — with real autonomy to shape how you deliver projects, backed by an established PMO framework and a supportive Professional Services team. We trust our people: you won't be micromanaged here, but you will be expected to own your outcomes and use your initiative. This is a role for someone who wants genuine ownership, not just a task list.

  • Competitive salary (£60,000–£70,000) based on Mercer salary benchmarking data

  • Flexible, hybrid approach to working; split your time between the office and home

  • You get to be part of a fun, driven and supportive team

  • Annual Summer and Christmas parties

  • Excellent development opportunities and a great company culture

What to expect from the interview process ❔

  • Screening call with Talent Acquisition

  • 1st interview with the Hiring Manager (PMO Lead)

  • Informal chat with a member of the Dutch-speaking team, to get a feel for the team and assess Dutch language proficiency (if needed)

  • Final interview - panel with the Hiring Manager and a senior Project Manager

Puzzel Values 🎯

  • Built on Trust – trust is an intrinsic Nordic value, upon which Puzzel has been built. We trust each other and our customers and partners trust us.

  • Stronger Together – working together in a genuinely collaborative way, with a shared purpose, we have an empowered organisation that is better equipped to delight customers and partners.

  • Stay Hungry – have a continuous hunger to raise our game, innovate and be the best we can be professionally.

Diversity & Inclusion 🌍

We want everyone at Puzzel to be their true, authentic selves at work irrespective of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical ability, age, or economic background.

Whilst we are proud to already have a diverse workforce from across the globe, we are aware that things could always be improved – for example, we currently have a ratio of female 26:74 male employees, which whilst not uncommon for the tech industry (average in SaaS is 26% female), it’s far from ideal. So, what are we doing to improve this?

  • Our Global Leadership Team (C-suite) has shifted from 100% male to 50 male: 50 female in the past 18 months.

  • We have increased our % of female hires from 23.6% in 2021 to 38.5% in 2023.

  • We are partnering with the likes of Flexa, who have significantly higher-than-average talent pools of candidates from diverse backgrounds.

  • We are working with State Employment initiatives in Norway and Sweden to bring candidates through internship/apprenticeship routes and are investigating similar initiatives in the UK and Bulgaria.

  • By raising awareness and transparency, we are hoping to further attract a diverse workforce.


We are continuously striving to foster an inclusive and diverse environment, where everyone is celebrated for who they are. If there is anything we can do to support you in the interview process, or beyond, please let us know.

One Last Thing ☝🏻

Even if you feel you are only a 75% match for this role, we still want to hear from you. This list is purely indicative. Skills can always be learnt.

Please note that we are not able to provide sponsorship for this role, so you must have eligibility to work in the country you are applying for.

By applying you accept the terms of our Privacy Notice which can be found on our website. Puzzel are not considering candidates that do not have a work permit in the country we are hiring in.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About this role

We believe everything has value. Klaravik runs digital auctions for used B2B goods in Sweden, as part of the TBAuctions group, connecting sellers who no longer need equipment with buyers who do. Designing for auctions works differently from e-commerce: every item is unique, listings are time-bound, and both sellers and bidders depend on getting it right in a narrow window.

That complexity is exactly why we’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to join us, working primarily on the internal systems and tools that keep our auctions running. As they're such a central part of our business, you'll also align with teams elsewhere in the group as the work calls for it. What matters most is how you work: thinking holistically, acting proactively, staying open to feedback, and taking ownership from start to finish, while contributing to our growing design team.

You'd be based with us in Lund, and your work reaches across the TBAuctions group. Day to day you'd work closely with colleagues in the Benelux region, and on tools used across brands like Troostwijk, Vavato and Surplex.

Responsibilities & what we’re looking for

Own the harder design problems end to end. You take complex work from research to implementation, and you're the person colleagues lean on when a project gets complicated.

Hold the holistic experience in mind. Working across the teams building our internal tools, you keep the experience consistent and can spot where work overlaps or even breaks a journey elsewhere.

Build for scale. You grow our design system with intention, defining patterns and components that hold up across products rather than solving the same problem twice.

Align stakeholders and set expectations early within the Product & Tech organisation. You communicate clearly about scope and trade-offs, and what it takes to deliver.

Advocate for users and keep their goals in focus. You back your position with data and insights about user behaviour and needs.

Contribute to the Design & Experience team by giving and taking feedback openly. You listen before jumping to solutions, and proactively suggest how we can improve our tools, rituals, and ways of working.

Must have qualifications

  • A portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of complex problems. Work you took from research and framing through to shipped design, across more than one team or product area, with your reasoning visible.

  • Experience with complex internal or operational tools, where flows matter more than surface.

  • Evidence of holistic thinking. You can walk us through how a project fitted into a larger flow, what you changed or took into consideration, and what the results were.

  • Strong communication. You can explain your decisions clearly to non-designers and be direct about scope and trade-offs.

  • Comfort with feedback in both directions. You're able to deliver well-formulated critique and can point to your own work that got better because of someone else's input.

  • Practical use of research and data. You use insight to make and defend decisions, to keep the experience attached to user needs and goals.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Marketplace, e-commerce, or auction domain knowledge.

  • Design system experience, especially using AI to speed up or scale how components and patterns are built and maintained.

  • A feel for content, such as UX writing, or working with texts and translation keys across languages.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other designers, formally or informally.

  • One of our core languages (Swedish, German, or Dutch) alongside English.

What success looks like for this role

Within the first year, you'll have helped us make real progress on a new product we're building, through releases that hold together as complete flows rather than isolated features. That work is documented and built properly into our design system, so what we solve once can be reused. We measure progress by whether people can actually get their work done, not by how much we shipped.

Benefits

You'd be based from our modern office in central Lund, right by the train station. The whole design team meets up about once a week for reviews and critique; the rest is flexible, with remote options so you can balance work with whatever else life involves. We offer six weeks of vacation, a wellness contribution, a pension solution, and health insurance.

How to apply

Apply with your CV and a portfolio. The portfolio matters most to us: we want to see the thinking behind the work, the problem you were solving, and what you personally contributed, especially on projects where you worked with others.

We're excited to find the right person and we'll begin interviewing straight away rather than waiting for a closing date. If this looks like your role, apply early.

Commitment to diversity, inclusion and equal opportunity

At TBAuctions we believe everything has value, and that includes people. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We know great designers reach this point by many different routes, so if you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you. If you need any adjustments during the process, tell us and we'll arrange them.

About us

TBAuctions is Europe's leading multi-brand digital auction platform for B2B used goods, powered by a diverse and international team. Our core values guide everything we do: we put our bidders and sellers first, we take responsibility, we deliver and we succeed as a team.

Job type: Full-time

Location: Lund, Sweden

Salary range: According to agreement

Start date: According to agreement

Work authorisation: You must have the right to work in Sweden.

Expected travel: 3-4 times a year to our other offices and to off-sites.

This role reports to the Design Lead, and will be part of the Product & Tech organisation within TBAuctions. Your employment would be with Klaravik, one of the brands in the group.

title: Senior Signal Engineer
description:
Modern Railway Systems, a subsidiary of Stacy Witbeck is seeking an experienced Senior Signal Engineer to plan, design, and deliver rail transit signal systems from conceptual to final design, and construction support phases for light rail, commuter rail and high-speed rail projects. This position offers a unique opportunity to interact with clients and team members across the entire organization, working on highly sophisticated project deliverables.

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:


Design & Review: Develop and check detailed signal hardware and logic designs, control tables, route and aspect charts, and vital interlocking logic. Redline existing drawings and work with drafting to maintain and update CAD files. Design/modify signal line, crossing approach and cable plans. Design/modify and test/verify application logic programs, write test procedures, and develop a test plan.

Testing & Commissioning: Support installation and field testing for signal systems. Configure and maintain Software Configuration Management Control Plan database. Develop and maintain power calculations for AC, DC and battery loads associated with signal design.

Project Management: Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, contribute to engineering schedule and budget development, and review contractor shop drawings. Develop and maintain material lists.

Safety & Standards: Comply with all safety rules and procedures and report all hazards as required. Attend and participate in all assigned meetings and training, specifically safety and security related.
**Please note--Requirements are essential, but preferences have flexibility. **

Education: Associate’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or 10 years of experience in Signal Engineering Design.

REQUIREMENTS
  • Minimum of 15 years designing railroad signal systems.
  • Minimum of 8 years leading design teams for railroad signal systems.
  • Experience with Vital Signal Circuit Design for relay and microprocessor-based systems, minimum of 7 years.
  • Familiarity with multiple logic simulation environments.
  • Quality minded and detail oriented with the ability to read and understand specifications and contract drawings.
  • Report and correspondence writing ability including specification documents, release notes, product submittals and RFIs.
  • Capable of generating technical white papers and power calculations.
  • Understanding of requirements tracing methods and tools.
  • Highly organized and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Adept at in working in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Knowledgeable in train operations and associated safety requirements.
  • Familiar with Microsoft 365, specifically Word and Excel, with the ability to learn other software applications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to be able to communicate successfully with a variety of disciplines and levels, both internal and external staff.
  • Able to perform moderate data collection and analysis.
  • Experience working independently and leading small teams.
  • Can manage their own schedule and priority.
  • Possess mentorship skills to guide less experienced engineers to prepare project documents and designs.
  • Able to design, peer review designs, and troubleshoot independently even on more complex engineering.
  • Be able to manage significant client interfaces on small to medium projects and moderate interfaces on large projects.
  • Can contribute moderately to schedule, estimating and budgeting efforts.

PREFERENCES
  • Is a subject matter expert in at least one subsystem.
  • Able to develop logic for ELIXS and VHLC applications using Logic Station compiler, experience with MicroLok and VPI applications is also desired.
  • Award-winning contractor with a dynamic business model and an excellent reputation.
  • We are a 100% employee-owned company with a competitive ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
  • Company pays 100% of employee premiums for health insurance; employee pays up to $15 per week for family premiums.**Benefits and employee costs are subject to change

title: VP-Strategy & Business Management
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


Skills and Competencies
  • In-depth knowledge of or interest in Moody’s Ratings business model, position in the credit rating agency industry, role in the global financial markets, and applicable regulatory regimes
  • Strong understanding of financial sector development, capital markets evolution, and regulatory trends across EMEA, with a particular focus on the Middle East
  • Knowledge of Islamic finance, including Shariah-compliant funding structures, fixed income markets, and financial institutions
  • Strong communication and relationship management skills with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders across diverse business cultures
  • Ability to converse on analytical and technical financial issues and translate complex market developments into strategic business insights
  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically across the Middle East, including key financial and capital markets hubs
  • Experience and willingness to explore innovative approaches to problem solving while working independently with minimal supervision and producing high-quality work
  • Fluent in English; Arabic language skills are highly desirable
  • Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use.
Education
  • Minimum of an undergraduate degree or equivalent, preferably in finance, accounting, business, or economics
  • Professional business, financial, or accounting qualification preferred, such as Chartered Financial Analyst or Master of Business Administration
Responsibilities
Drive strategic growth, stakeholder engagement, and transformational initiatives that advance Moody’s Ratings’ priorities across the Middle East region.
  • Support the evaluation and strategic oversight of regional growth initiatives, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment across regional growth initiatives, partnerships, and investments on governance, operational, analytical, and strategic matters
  • Build and maintain relationships with key capital market stakeholders across the region, including regulators, stock exchanges, banks, asset managers, issuers, and public sector entities
  • Support the planning and execution of market outreach activities, events, thought leadership programs, and educational initiatives that promote capital market development
  • Deliver market intelligence and strategic insights to regional and global leadership to support business planning and regional priorities
  • Partner with the Senior Vice President, Head of Strategy and Business Management, on the evaluation, execution, and integration of strategic opportunities across the region
  • Contribute to the development and execution of EMEA Regional Management objectives and support broader cross-functional strategic initiatives as required
  • Serve as a representative director or board member for relevant affiliate investments, providing governance oversight and strategic guidance as opportunities arise
About the Team
The Regional Management team provides leadership and coordination across Moody’s Ratings’ business activities throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The team works closely with business, analytical, and functional leaders to ensure strategic priorities are executed effectively, regional capabilities are strengthened, and growth opportunities are identified and advanced. By joining the team, you will contribute to initiatives that support the development of financial markets, enhance stakeholder engagement, and drive innovation and transformation across the region.

title: VP of Commercial Operations
description:
The VP Commercial Operations will be responsible for building and scaling a disciplined, data-driven commercial operating engine across Sales, Client Success, and Client Services. This role will translate strategic direction into a clear, repeatable revenue system, ensuring execution rigour, forecasting accuracy, and consistent customer value delivery.

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer, the role holder will act as a critical operating partner; bringing structure, cadence, and accountability to a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The role requires a commercially credible operator who can balance pace with discipline, enabling growth while ensuring operational control and alignment across functions.

This is a highly cross-functional senior leadership role, working closely with Sales, Client Success, Client Services, Product, Marketing, and Finance to drive predictable revenue performance and scalable growth.

What you will be doing:

Key responsibilities will include:

Commercial Operating Model & Execution

· Design and implement a scalable end-to-end commercial operating model across Sales, Client Success and Client Services.

· Establish clear operating cadence including pipeline reviews, forecast governance, and performance tracking.

· Ensure alignment between commercial strategy and day-to-day execution.

· Own enterprise territory strategy, coverage models, capacity planning and quota methodology to ensure alignment between growth objectives, customer demand and delivery capability.

· Partner with Finance and commercial leaders on quota design, target allocation and performance measurement frameworks.

Forecasting & Pipeline Governance

· Own forecasting and performance governance, providing visibility of revenue opportunities, risks and interventions to the executive leadership team.

· Implement and enforce pipeline hygiene standards, stage definitions, and conversion metrics.

· Drive data-led decision-making across the commercial organisation.

Revenue Performance & Analytics

· Develop and maintain performance dashboards covering pipeline, bookings, renewals, churn, and customer health.

· Identify systemic performance risks and opportunities, sponsoring cross-functional interventions to improve commercial effectiveness and revenue outcomes.

· Partner with Finance on revenue planning, target setting, and reporting.

· Establish governance frameworks for pricing, discounting, deal approvals and commercial risk management.

· Ensure commercial decisions are consistent with company strategy, profitability objectives and client commitments.

· Lead win-loss analysis and commercial insights programmes, identifying trends and opportunities to improve conversion, retention and expansion performance.

· Provide data-driven recommendations to the executive leadership team on growth opportunities, investment priorities, commercial risks and resource allocation decisions.

Customer Lifecycle Management

· Design and govern scalable customer lifecycle frameworks supporting onboarding, value realisation, renewal and expansion activities.

· Ensure commercial commitments are deliverable and aligned with capacity.

· Introduce consistent customer success metrics and governance.

CRM & Systems Leadership

· Define the long-term commercial technology and data strategy, ensuring systems, processes and insights capabilities support future business growth

· Own CRM adoption and data integrity.

· Ensure systems support scalable growth and actionable insight.

· Drive compliance and embed CRM as a core commercial tool.

· Lead the adoption of advanced analytics and business intelligence tools, translating data into actionable insights that inform commercial strategies.

Sales Enablement & Commercial Capability

· Define the commercial excellence strategy and capability framework to improve productivity, effectiveness and consistency across commercial teams.

· Ensure commercial teams have the tools, capabilities and insights required to execute consistently at scale.

· Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within commercial teams, identifying new technologies and methodologies to stay ahead of industry trends.

Senior Leadership

· Lead and develop a team of experienced professionals and People Leaders.

· Exemplify the One Diaceutics Leadership behaviors as a senior leader.

· Act as a trusted advisor and execution partner to the Chief Customer Officer.

· Build strong, trusted relationships across the executive leadership team.

· Provide senior leadership challenge on priorities, sequencing, and execution readiness of the Commercial Operations operating model.

· Sponsor enterprise-wide commercial transformation initiatives, ensuring organisational readiness, adoption and measurable business impact.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

· As a member of the Extended Leadership Team (ELT), bridge strategy and execution, reducing siloed thinking and driving operational excellence across Diaceutics.

· Partner closely with Sales, Client Services, Client Success, Product, Data & Analytics, Marketing and Finance to deliver a seamless end-to-end client experience with clarity on trade-offs, dependencies and resource allocation.

· Partner with Finance and People teams to design, administer and evaluate incentive and compensation programmes that drive desired commercial outcomes.

· Represent Diaceutics externally with credibility and professionalism as a senior leader.

Measures of success:

Growth & Value Creation:

· Revenue growth and market penetration

· Forecast accuracy

· Pipeline coverage ratios

· Improved sales productivity and efficiency

· Commercial excellence improvements (pricing, segmentation)

Delivery & Product Effectiveness:

· Sales cycle efficiency

· Adoption of standardized processes and tools

· Data quality and governance metrics

· Data-driven decision-making adoption across teams

People & Capability:

· Team engagement and development

· Team capability and succession readiness

· Effectiveness of coaching and mentorship

Who we are looking for:

You are a strong strategic leader with demonstrated success in executing complex commercial operations models and building commercial strategies and operating rhythms. You will build a Commercial Operations function that enables sustainable growth and predictable revenue performance, requiring analytical thinking, change management capability and a deep understanding of the systems, processes, data and governance required to drive efficient and scalable growth.

Successful candidates will currently operate, or have operated, in senior leadership roles with significant influence on business strategy, commercial performance and investment decisions. You will have accountability for budgets and have responsibility for the performance of a team of professionals and People Leaders.

Skills and competencies:

  • Proven track record: You have extensive senior level experience in Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or similar, leading high performing teams in high growth organizations. This experience will include designing and executing complex commercial strategies and building scalable revenue engines.

  • Leadership capability: You have a history of creating an environment where people learn and grow, inspiring others to perform through coaching, feedback and transparent communication. You set ambitious goals and hold people to account for delivering results.

  • Commercial acumen: You have a deep understanding of sales operations, customer economics, revenue models and drivers and go to market approaches. You will have in-depth knowledge of complex B2B sales cycles and end to end customer lifecycle processes.

  • Knowledge and expertise: You will have deep expertise in CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and knowledge of forecasting, pipeline management and revenue metrics at an enterprise level. It would be advantageous if this knowledge was gained in a life sciences, data, or analytics environment.

  • Delivering with others: You are an excellent cross-functional collaborator, with a strong understanding of and ability to influence the interdependencies that shape the overall client experience, driving alignment.

title: Steel Structure and Welding Supervisor
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a Steel Structure and Welding Supervisor to oversee steel fabrication, structural assembly, welding, installation preparation, and production quality. You will coordinate teams, materials, equipment, and schedules to meet project drawings, codes, deadlines, and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily fabrication, structural assembly, welding, cutting, fitting, grinding, and preparation activities.

  • Allocate work to welders, fabricators, fitters, technicians, and other workshop personnel.

  • Review drawings, welding details, material specifications, work instructions, and project requirements.

  • Ensure work is completed to approved drawings, dimensions/tolerances, procedures, and quality standards.

  • Supervise welding using approved processes (e.g., MIG, MAG, TIG or arc welding) and ensure correct welding procedures, symbols, and sequences.

  • Monitor fit-up, alignment, weld preparation, preheating, interpass temperatures, and post-weld requirements.

  • Inspect completed work, support weld inspections/NDT, and manage corrective actions and documentation.

  • Track material and consumable availability, equipment readiness, labour productivity, rework, and progress.

  • Maintain daily records for production, manpower, inspections, and material usage.

  • Ensure workshop safety, conduct toolbox talks/inspections, and enforce hot work controls, PPE, and environmental requirements.

  • Support training, competency development, and preparation of structures for painting/surface treatment, transportation, and installation.

Requirements

  • Technical qualification, diploma, or equivalent of 10 years of experience in Welding, Steel Fabrication, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proven experience supervising steel structure fabrication, welding, structural assembly, or heavy industrial workshop operations.

  • Ability to read structural/fabrication drawings, weld symbols, material specifications, and inspection requirements.

  • Knowledge of welding procedures, welder qualifications, consumables, joint preparation, welding sequences, and weld defect identification.

  • Understanding of relevant welding, fabrication, structural, quality, and health & safety standards.

  • Experience coordinating workshop teams and planning daily activities to meet production deadlines.

  • Competence in dimensional and weld inspection, and awareness of NDT and quality documentation.

  • Strong workshop safety knowledge, including hot work controls, lifting operations, and working-at-height requirements.

  • Good communication, leadership, problem-solving, and basic root-cause analysis skills.

  • Certifications in welding, fabrication/inspection, or safety are an advantage.

Required Skills

  • 10 years of experience

  • Steel structure fabrication and assembly supervision.

  • Welding supervision and quality control.

  • Structural drawing and weld symbol interpretation.

  • Fabrication planning, workforce allocation, and production reporting.

  • Weld defect identification, dimensional inspection, and corrective action support.

  • Health and safety compliance for workshop and hot work activities.

What We’re Looking For

Candidates with practical experience leading steel fabrication and welding teams, including weld quality control and workshop production, will be preferred. Experience in construction, manufacturing, structural steel, heavy engineering, oil & gas, shipbuilding, or industrial fabrication environments is an advantage.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Status: Exempt (Non-Management)

Reports To: Chief Information Officer

Supervises: None


WHO WE ARE: At Central One, our values are to Deliver Exceptional Service, Work as a Team, Have Fun, and the Credit Union philosophy of People Helping People; all while striving to be C.E.N.T.R.A.L. One Ambassadors. CENTRAL stands for Caring, Enthusiastic, Nimble, Team-Oriented, Resilient, Altruistic and Loyal. At the core of our values lies a commitment to our community, members, and employees, with a focus on overall well-being.


PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

The Data Engineer owns the design, build, and ongoing development of COFCU’s enterprise data infrastructure — a modern, scalable platform built on Azure and Microsoft Fabric. This role is the technical engine behind COFCU’s data strategy, responsible for delivering the pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models, and integrations that power trusted reporting, analytics, and AI capabilities across the organization.


The Data Engineer does not work in isolation. This role operates as a collaborative lead within the Data Infrastructure team, working closely with business department leaders, data domain owners, the Data & AI Governance Lead, and COFCU’s Managed Service Provider (MSP) to continuously build, refine, and scale the infrastructure. The Data Engineer is also an active participant in the Data & AI Governance framework — applying governance standards, enabling technical implementation of policies, and serving as a technical representative on the Data & AI Governance Committee.


This position is foundational to COFCU’s shift from manual reporting to a governed, enterprise-wide data ecosystem — and plays a central role in enabling leadership and staff to access timely, trusted insights that support strategic decision-making.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Data Infrastructure Ownership & Development

Own the enterprise data platform end-to-end and drive its ongoing evolution in partnership with the MSP, domain owners, and IT leadership.

  • Serve as the primary technical owner of COFCU’s data infrastructure, including the data lakehouse/warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformation layers, and semantic models built on Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Lead and manage the day-to-day execution of the Data Infrastructure team workstreams, coordinating with the MSP to ensure deliverables align with project scope, timelines, and COFCU standards.
  • Partner with business departments and data domain owners (Member, Financial, Lending, Operational, Employee, and Vendor Data) to understand data needs and translate them into infrastructure design and build requirements.
  • Build and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines for structured and unstructured data from diverse sources including core banking systems, SaaS platforms, APIs, and flat files.
  • Automate data processing workflows to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and increase timeliness of data availability.
  • Manage Microsoft Purview configuration, data classification, and cataloging as part of the technical governance infrastructure.

Analytics & Reporting Enablement

Ensure analysts and business users have access to clean, well-structured, analytics-ready data.

  • Design and maintain semantic models and Power BI datasets optimized for performance, consistency, and self-service consumption.
  • Collaborate with analysts and business teams to migrate manual reports and spreadsheets to governed Power BI dashboards.
  • Establish and maintain dataset documentation, naming standards, and data dictionaries in coordination with the Governance Lead.
  • Enable self-service analytics by building reusable, well-documented data products aligned to enterprise data domain definitions.

Data & AI Governance Participation

Actively participate in COFCU’s Data & AI Governance framework as the technical implementation partner for governance policies and standards.

  • Serve as a standing technical member of the Data & AI Governance Committee, representing the infrastructure perspective in governance decisions.
  • Partner with the Data & AI Governance Lead to implement governance policies in the platform: data quality checks, access controls, lineage tracking, classification, and auditability.
  • Apply Azure RBAC, row-level security, and Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels to enforce data access and security governance policies.
  • Implement and maintain data quality monitoring, alerting, and issue tracking to support Governance Committee reporting on data reliability.
  • Contribute to the Enterprise Data Catalog and ensure infrastructure assets are cataloged, documented, and discoverable per governance standards.
  • Support the technical implementation of AI governance controls, including data lineage and model input/output auditing, where applicable.

Platform Security, Performance & Reliability

Maintain a secure, high-performing, and cost-efficient data environment.

  • Manage data platform security using Azure identity management, RBAC, and encryption best practices.
  • Monitor platform performance, pipeline health, and storage costs; proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Implement CI/CD or DevOps practices for data pipeline and analytics asset deployment to ensure reliable, repeatable releases.
  • Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity considerations for data infrastructure components.

Collaboration, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in the Data Infrastructure Team channel and working sessions to maintain visibility and alignment across stakeholders.
  • Contribute to data standards, reusable patterns, and best practices that can be adopted across departments.
  • Document infrastructure architecture, pipeline design, and data flow to ensure institutional knowledge is retained independently of the MSP.
  • Stay current on Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Purview capabilities; identify and recommend enhancements that advance COFCU’s data strategy.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serves as community role model and participates in volunteer activities to support the People Helping People value and enhance the Credit Union’s visibility.
  • Adhere to all applicable Credit Union policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Perform other duties as requested or assigned.

Pay Range: $96,000 - $124,000 per year commensurate with experience

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement with a combination of required in office days and remote days upon completion of in-office training period.

title: Director of IT Transformation (Europe)
