Required Skills & Experience

  • 3 to 5 years of software development experience, including at least 2 years in front-end development
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST APIs
  • Experience with modern web frameworks such as Lit, React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, or similar technologies
  • Understanding of modern front-end architecture and Micro Frontend concepts
  • Experience working with Web Components, Open-WC, Rollup, and Storybook
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive web development practices
  • Experience with testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, Karma, Cypress, Web Test Runner, and Postman
  • Experience using Git and complex branching workflows
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices
  • Strong communication skills and proficiency in English
  • Experience working within Agile, Scrum, or Kanban environments

What We Offer

  • Opportunities to work with a modern and evolving technology stack
  • Access to a global engineering community and knowledge-sharing culture
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
  • Career growth within an international organization
  • The chance to contribute to products that impact customers across multiple markets
  • A supportive, diverse, and collaborative work environment

Worried about the wage gap? So are we. Our commitment to pay equity means you'll be valued for your skills, not your gender.

How to Apply

Click the apply button on our career site and submit your application through Workday. We look forward to learning more about you.

Job Application Safety Reminder ⚠️

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site.
  • Check the sender's email carefully: legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com
  • No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it's a scam.

About ING

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Creator Coordinator - TikTok Shop

About us:

Grail is one of the largest US & UK TikTok Shop partner agencies. Within our network, we manage a network of strong creators that we incubate and nurture to help them succeed on the platform. In addition, we work directly with merchants and secure partnerships with creators in order to maximize their earnings on TikTok Shop.


TikTok Shop is rapidly transforming the future of e-commerce, and at Grail, we’re at the center of it. With over 1B+ users on TikTok, this is an opportunity to work in one of the fastest-growing and most exciting spaces in social commerce.


If you’re excited by TikTok culture, influencer marketing, and building impactful brand partnerships, this role is for you.


Role Description:

We’re looking for a proactive, highly organized, TikTok-savvy Talent Coordinator to sign, and work closely with TikTok Shop creators.


In this role, you’ll be responsible for pitching and signing creators to Grail, as well as securing and managing flat-fee brand deals for creators on our roster. You’ll act as the primary point of contact for your talent, identifying monetization opportunities, pitching creators to brands, negotiating deal terms, and ensuring seamless execution of campaigns.


You’ll work closely with a Senior Talent Manager as well as creators to optimize their positioning, increase deal flow, and maximize earnings through consistent paid partnerships.


This is a high-impact, revenue-driving role with significant ownership and growth potential within the creator economy.

  • Sign TikTok Shop creators to Grail and manage their brand deals

  • Grow revenue for TikTok Shop flat-fee partnerships across a roster of signed creators

  • Identify, pitch, and secure paid partnership opportunities for creators

  • Negotiate deal terms, rates, and deliverables with brands

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and advocate for your creators

  • Manage campaign execution from deal close through completion

  • Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and communication between creators and brands

  • Ensure creators deliver content on schedule and meet brand expectations

  • Provide guidance to creators on content performance and positioning to increase deal flow

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with brands and TikTok Shop partners

  • Track partnership performance and report on revenue and campaign outcomes across the entire TikTok Shop team

  • Work cross functionally with the Social Commerce Team


What we’re looking for:

  • No experience required

  • Familiar with TikTok Shop

  • Exceptional organization skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to manage multiple creators, deals, and timelines simultaneously

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Interest in influencer marketing, TikTok culture, and the creator economy


The ideal person for this role:

  • Is highly motivated by revenue and closing deals

  • Builds strong, trust-based relationships with creators

  • Is confident pitching talent and negotiating with brands

  • Is proactive and resourceful when solving problems and managing timelines

  • Has a “figure it out” mindset and enjoys testing new ideas and processes

  • Is excited to take ownership of a rapidly growing area of the business


Requirements:

  • Must be a fluent English speaker

  • Highly organized and deadline-driven

  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to move quickly and take initiative


Benefits:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage available with 50% covered by company

  • 28 days vacation inclusive of federal holidays (plus Christmas period flex time)

  • Fully remote environment

  • Performance based bonuses

  • Growth opportunities

The optical designs will be analyzed to assess imaging, illumination, throughput, and radiometric performance as well as review and mitigation of stray light artifacts. This role typically supports multiple program efforts in parallel with short deadlines as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Our programs include single and multiple aperture imaging systems, with both fixed and scanning platforms, operating across the UV to LWIR regions of the electromagnetic spectrum. Most of these systems function in a space environment. Mission requirements and packaging have driven our solutions to utilize custom multiple-mirror reflective designs, some including free-form optics and refractive lens cell assemblies.

Essential Functions:
• Participate in optical system design trade studies and evaluate and recommend optical materials, components, and vendors.
• Perform detailed image quality analyses, including wavefront error, modulation transfer function (MTF), ensquared energy, distortion, color correction, and resolution.
• Perform optical component tolerancing and sensitivity analysis.
• Support as-fabricated hardware component re-optimization to maximize system performance attributes.
• Conduct initial stray light and ghost analysis, proposing corrective actions to suppress stray light artifacts.
• Document detailed optical design specifications and tolerances.
• Support program design review cycles in consultation with system and mechanical design personnel.
• Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a team setting.
• Provide regular updates to program leadership to communicate progress, issues, and execution status.
• Engage in troubleshooting activities and verification of system requirements to ensure compliance and functionality.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree in optics or related field and a minimum of 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
• Experience using Zemax and/or Code V for optical design and analysis including both sequential (Zemax and/or Code V) or non-sequential (FRED) tools.
• Knowledge or familiarity with space-based telescope systems or complex commercial imaging systems.
• Participation and leadership in optical design and analysis projects.
• Effective communication skills to develop, document, present, and disseminate technical materials and progress in a team environment.
• Ability to obtain and maintain an active Secret Security clearance.

Preferred Additional Skills:
• Active security clearance is preferred.
• Experience with MATLAB or Python for data analysis and automation of testing procedures.
• Experience with athermalization of optical systems.
• Experience with STOP analysis.
• Background in optical fabrication or testing metrology.
• Knowledgeable in interferometry concepts, optical testing layouts, and optical measurement data analysis products.

About the Job

At our rapidly growing practice, Midwest Cardiovascular Institute (MCI) we are seeking a highly motivated Exercise Physiologist to join our team! As the Exercise Physiologist, you will be responsible for helping the team deliver safe, age-appropriate patient care as part of the team. You will work collaboratively with the RNs, RDs and MDs to promote wellness and optimize patient outcomes and quality care.

About the Company

The next generation of independent cardiology is being built here. CardioOne is a physician-led, technology-driven cardiology platform built to empower independent practices to compete, and win, in a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. Our mission is to provide cardiologists with the tools, infrastructure, and expertise they need to thrive while maintaining full clinical independence. We believe the best care is delivered by physicians who are empowered - not constrained - by the systems around them. We combine a deep bench of healthcare operators with purpose-built technology and AI-enabled solutions across operations, revenue cycle, imaging, and practice development. From real estate and advanced imaging to clinical workflows and data infrastructure, CardioOne delivers a fully integrated platform designed to drive growth, efficiency, and superior patient outcomes.

Backed by WindRose Health Investors and leading healthcare executives, CardioOne is building one of the most sophisticated and scalable cardiology MSOs in the country - designed to reimagine what is possible for independent cardiology

Specific Duties:

  • Prepare patients for testing, explain procedures, and review appropriate pre-test instructions.

  • Cardiac stress testing, cardiac rehabilitation, or cardiovascular experience preferred.

  • BLS certification required.

  • ACLS certification required or must be obtained within the required timeframe.

  • Knowledge of EKG monitoring, exercise physiology, and cardiovascular stress-testing protocols.

  • Strong communication, organization, and patient-care skills.

title: Associate Director, AI Engineering
description:
About the role

You’ll be one of the senior technical leaders responsible for the direction, quality and growth of AI Engineering at Blend360.

This is a broad leadership role spanning technical strategy, major client engagements, engineering standards and the development of our AI Engineering capability. You’ll operate across the department, providing leadership wherever the biggest technical decisions, risks or opportunities sit.

You’ll also remain deeply hands-on. You’ll design architectures, challenge technical decisions, work directly with engineers and clients, and get into the code when the problem warrants it.

You’ll be expected to challenge technical decisions where needed, explain your reasoning clearly and help teams arrive at stronger solutions. When a client or internal team proposes an approach that won’t hold up, you’ll be able to identify the risks, make the case for a better option and take responsibility for the technical direction.

We’re not looking for someone to simply review or approve other people’s architecture. You’ll be expected to set technical direction, make difficult decisions and remain accountable for the quality of what we deliver.

Our AI Engineering work spans CPG, pharma and energy clients, and it’s growing.

The work

  • Set technical direction across AI Engineering, defining the architecture principles, engineering standards, delivery practices and technical capabilities we need as the practice grows.

  • Own the technical quality of major AI engagements, particularly where architecture, scale, complexity or delivery risk requires senior leadership.

  • Lead across multiple projects and technical workstreams, setting priorities and direction while ensuring teams can execute without becoming dependent on you for every decision.

  • Design and review production AI architectures, including retrieval and knowledge layers, agentic pipelines, evaluation, multilingual systems, and the cost, latency, reliability and scalability trade-offs involved.

  • Remain hands-on on the hardest problems: reviewing code, prototyping approaches, resolving architectural issues and working directly with engineers when senior technical intervention will materially improve the outcome.

  • Run rigorous design reviews that raise the engineering bar across the practice and create an environment where technical decisions are challenged regardless of seniority.

  • Act as a senior technical counterpart to clients, including CxO and architecture leadership, taking ownership of difficult technical conversations, trade-offs, delivery risks and changes in direction.

  • Own the technical quality of major AI proposals, translating solution concepts into credible architectures, scopes, delivery models, team structures, estimates and commercial assumptions.

  • Work with commercial and account leadership to shape technical propositions, identify opportunities and determine where the AI Engineering practice should invest and differentiate.

  • Develop senior engineers and technical leads, building the leadership depth and succession required to scale the department.

  • Shape the AI Engineering capability plan, including hiring priorities, skills development, team composition and the bar for senior technical talent.

  • At least 10 years’ experience across AI, data and software engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering teams or a substantial technical function within consulting or professional services.

  • Experience operating beyond individual project leadership, with responsibility for technical direction, engineering quality or capability across multiple teams.

  • Deep technical credibility. You’re comfortable working in production Python, substantial codebases and API-driven systems that need to perform reliably at scale.

  • Recent, personal experience architecting and building production AI systems. Expect to discuss retrieval strategy, caching, context economics, serving constraints, evaluation, observability and what went wrong in practice.

  • Strong systems thinking. You can reason through unfamiliar platforms and problems rather than relying on expertise in a single stack.

  • Experience leading complex programmes or multiple concurrent engineering workstreams, with accountability for technical direction, planning, resourcing, risk and delivery outcomes.

  • The judgement to know when to intervene personally and when to lead through others, delegating effectively without giving up accountability for technical quality.

  • Experience developing senior engineers and technical leaders, shaping team capability and raising the engineering bar across a wider organisation.

  • Commercial awareness sufficient to turn a technical solution into a realistic scope, team shape, estimate and delivery plan, and to challenge assumptions that do not hold up.

  • Experience contributing to account growth, technical propositions or go-to-market activity within a consulting organisation.

  • Confidence operating with senior clients and executives while remaining credible with engineers at code and architecture level.

  • The ability to make difficult technical calls, create clarity where there is ambiguity and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Strong experience with Databricks and Azure OpenAI, which underpin much of our delivery.

Nice to have

  • Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer experience.

  • Delivery experience in pharma or CPG.

  • Practical experience designing systems around EU AI Act requirements.

  • Multilingual AI systems in production.

  • A strong presence in the Databricks or Microsoft partner ecosystem.

  • Experience shaping go-to-market and commercial strategy for an AI Engineering practice.

title: Customer Advisor - 10 Hours
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

A peek into your daily adventures:

title: Clinical Research Regulatory Coordinator: Hoag Clinical Research
description:
Primary Duties And Responsibilities
  • The Sr. Clinical Research Regulatory Coordinator supports clinical research teams (physicians, nurses, etc.) and with minimal direction and considerable use of independent judgment, facilitates the study start-up approval process and maintaining documentation of regulatory compliance throughout the trial’s duration for research studies involving human subjects. The Sr. Regulatory Coordinator ensures all research studies are compliant with regulations and maintains accurate and up-to-date regulatory files. The Sr. Coordinator is the central resource for regulatory staff conducting clinical research. Understands current regulatory requirements and ensures a smooth submission process to minimize delays to study initiation. Remains informed of current federal, state, and local regulations regarding clinical research and communicates any changes to study team.

  • Produces and maintains regulatory binders prior to studies starting with all required documents and ensures dedicated electronic study folder is current. Obtains and completes all required documents for new submissions, exemption requests, compassionate uses, amendment applications, continuing review, and closure activities.
  • Completes the External Visitors Checklist to meet badge requirements for access to institution. Reviews informed consents for institutional language and works with legal and sponsors to ensure CTA language is consistent with consent.
  • Works with multiple IRBs and understands submission process and requirements.
  • Provides institutional authorization for new submissions with WIRB.
  • Provides study, enrollment updates, and SAE reports to Clinical Research Oversight Committee.
  • Work with Investigators to renew NCI/CTEP applications.
  • Participates in all investigator meetings, as required.
  • Maintains working knowledge of current protocols and internal SOPs.
  • Assists with the coordination and review of amendments, annual reports, safety reports, and other regulatory submissions required for maintenance of INDs or IDEs.
  • Serves as a team leader within the clinical research regulatory team and trains new regulatory staff, when appropriate.

Education and Experience

  • Associate Degree or equivalent education and experience required. Bachelor Degree preferred.
  • More than one (1) year of regulatory documentation experience in clinical research required
  • Working knowledge of FDA, NIH, and OHRP regulatory requirements and ICH GCP guidelines preferred

description:
Location: Edinburgh, Hybrid

In this position, you’ll be based in the Edinburgh office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex.

A role you will love

As one of our Scrum Masters you will be a member of cross-functional scrum teams that develop, deliver, and sustain products across a portfolio of applications. You will coach your teams in our agile ways of working, process and to develop a high performing delivery focused culture.

In this role, you will support Product Owners and development teams, highlighting the need for clear and concise backlog items and providing support regarding backlog management and value delivery. You will also support organisation wide agile initiatives as an active contributor to our Global Agile Community.

Some key responsibilities:

  • Facilitate scrum events to be purposeful, effective, action oriented and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Create a safe environment allowing each team to experiment with new opportunities and industry ideas, as well as working with the team to inspect and adapt when things don’t go to plan.
  • As a servant-leader, guide each team towards self-organisation and promote a collaborative culture that embraces problem solving, trust and feedback.
  • Work with each team to resolve impediments to team progress, supports the removal of impediments out with the control of the team.
  • Knowledge of techniques to support effective Product Goal definition, refinement and Product Backlog management to support delivering value to our customers

What will you bring to the role?

As this is a Scrum Master role within a technical function, you will need to have experience working in a similar role ideally within cross-functional agile teams. Stakeholder management and communication skills will be key for the role, so experience dealing with stakeholders at different levels would be ideal.

Of course, this is an agile role, and we are a company that has fully embraced agile ways of working. So, to be successful in this role you will need to come with a true passion for agile software delivery.

Other key skills required for the role include:

  • In-depth knowledge and application of agile principles, frameworks, methodologies and practices.
  • Proven skills and knowledge of servant leadership, coaching, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, and empowerment
  • Experience of supporting and creating Agile training materials for delivery team as well as the wider organization
  • Experience supporting Product Owners with creating, prioritizing and managing backlogs.
  • A good ability to coach, mentor, tech, and pass on knowledge.
  • Self-motivation and innovative thinking for outside the box solutions.

Rewards designed for you

Health and wellbeing rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family

Invest in our business by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer Affiliate Technologies
description:
About Schibsted Marketing Services

Schibsted Marketing Services is Schibsted´s advertising organization, representing some of the strongest news brands in Norway and Sweden - like VG, Aftonbladet, Aftenposten and SvD.

Advertising plays a central role in funding independent news media, and affiliate marketing is a growing component of our advertising revenue. We are currently increasing our focus on affiliate marketing and other performance marketing, and are looking for a fullstack engineer to work on affiliate data collection and tooling.


About the Role

As a Software Engineer on Affiliate Technologies your task is to build internal systems and infrastructure that fuels data collection and automate processes. This is a hands-on development role: you will focus on internal tooling, integrations, and infrastructure that support our affiliate team and other advertising teams. In this role you will have the opportunity to independently design, develop and deploy tooling that has a direct revenue impact for the free press. Affiliate is a cross brand initiative in Schibsted, used for monetizing most of our brands across Norway and Sweden.

You will work within Ads Data capabilities and work closely with the affiliate team and with other data teams in Schibsted. The Ads Data Capabilities delivers targeting and reporting capabilities, a necessity for Schibsted to succeed in the advertising market. Among our products are data cleanrooms, matched audiences infrastructure, reach estimation models, as well as general ad impression level data reporting and data products.

In this role, you will

  • Develop data collection tools and process tooling for the affiliate business model

  • Develop a solution for managing and distributing commercial offers (“Tilbud”)

  • Collaborate with our data teams to ensure affiliate distribution gets powered by the data available within Schibsted

  • Collaborate with our data teams to ensure all advertising can be powered with data generated by affiliate initiatives


About our affiliate tooling

Linkfusion is a click tracking tool that enables Schibsted to manage affiliate tracking link clicks, and it also orchestrates multiple data pipelines tying this data to revenue data from tens of different partners Schibsted works with. Built on a solid foundation it has the option to become a core component in Schibsted Marketing Services effort to collect AI ready data from our affiliate business.

Tilbudstudio is our solution for delivering commercial offers to our users, both during fast paced commercial events such as Black Week, but also for highlighting good offers on a daily basis. Our setup needs a complete revamp, and deciding how to rebuild will be part of this role's responsibility. This is an opportunity to assemble a purpose built content management stack both to support the backend process affiliate content, but also to deliver the consumer phasing front end while working seamlessly with the existing infrastructure of Norway's most visited news sites. AI supported workflows to create new offers is also high on the priority list.

The (current) stack

The current tooling is made on these technologies and familiarity with them or similar technologies is valued:

  • Laravel

  • Next.js

  • Sanity

  • AWS RDS (PostgreSQL)

  • AWS Cloudfront

  • Snowflake

  • Redis/Valkey

We encourage agentic engineering and integrating AI tools into day-to-day development workflow, experimenting with new ways of building software faster, smarter, and with greater impact.

Additional competency requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as software engineer

  • Experience with cloud platforms

  • Knowledge and further curiosity about agentic engineering and AI tooling for coding

Valued skills and experience

  • Fluency in a Scandinavian language

  • Experience with performance marketing technologies

  • Experience from media or advertising industry

title: Cryptography Engineer, SEAR
description:
Embedded within Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture (SEAR) organization, the Cryptographic Engineering team's mission is to deliver world-class cryptographic implementation and secure protocol engineering for products going in the hands of millions of customers. We are looking for an expert Cryptography Engineer with a strong software background, capable of implementing and designing security countermeasures against side-channel and physical attacks for various algorithms.

We provide the cryptographic foundations protecting user data and valuable assets across all products, including Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. In this role there will be the opportunity to work on analyzing, proposing, and validating innovative cryptographic solutions for our applications.

Work in an innovative environment:

  • Collaborate with a wide range of collaborators, from Silicon Engineering to Cloud services
  • Implement and review innovative algorithms and protocols on a wide range of architectures and embedded systems, design and implement side channel attack countermeasure, improve performance, formally prove the correctness of Apple cryptographic software
  • Work cooperatively with other teams in Apple on multi-functional technologies and initiatives to improve security
  • Evangelize and drive the adoption of these technologies across the organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • A passion for creating effective and pragmatic cryptographic implementations
  • Expert in fundamental cryptographic algorithms & underlying mathematics
  • Track record implementing highly optimized cryptographic functions secured against side-channel attack and fault injection
  • Excellent C and systems programming skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the formal verification of countermeasures or cryptographic software.

title: Materials Research Engineer -- Principal Engineer
description:
This position is in Western Digital Research, a world-class research laboratory in San Jose, California with ~80 employees. Research activities in the lab focus on all aspects of information storage, sensors, spintronics, superconducting devices, non-volatile memory, and AI compute architectures. The materials team’s mission is to develop novel materials for emerging technologies. The team is well-equipped with thin film deposition tools and related characterization tools, located in a fully functional cleanroom with the capability to fabricate a wide array of nanoscale devices using novel materials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct hands-on, experimental research of thin films for emerging technologies such as superconducting qubits, non-volatile memories and novel sensor applications.
  • Thin film growth by physical vapor deposition using ultra-high vacuum film deposition tools.
  • Characterization of structural, electronic, optical, chemical, magnetic, thermal and mechanical film properties.
  • Design of materials for integration into nanoscale devices.
  • Collect, analyze, present and report film and device characterization data, results and conclusions.
  • Work closely and collaborate within a team of engineers and support staff.
  • Ph.D. in materials science and engineering, physics, electrical engineering, or closely related field.
  • Expertise with materials and devices in the areas of non-volatile memory technologies, superconducting qubits, oxide semiconductor transistors, or novel magnetic or chemical sensors.
  • Strong hands-on experience with UHV film deposition equipment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with film characterization instrumentation and techniques such as XRD, XRF, XPS, AFM, and electrical transport as a function of temperature.
  • Strong knowledge of nanofabrication and general device design and operation.
  • Demonstrated ability to self-direct a research project.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.

title: BIM Projectcoördinator
description:
Geef vorm aan de toekomst van onze complexe infrastructuurprojecten bij Boskalis Nederland.

Als BIM Projectcoördinator richt je de projectomgeving in en zorg je voor het soepel laten verlopen van integrale projecten binnen het ontwerpteam. Je begeleidt ontwerpsessies en het stap voor stap efficiënter maken van het projectproces is daarbij essentieel. Je vindt het leuk om het 3D‑coördinatiemodel op te zetten en verschillende disciplines samen te brengen. Dit model gebruik je om het integrale ontwerp te ondersteunen en via issues actueel te houden. Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt en vervult daarmee een signalerende en faciliterende rol binnen de projectorganisatie. Ga het maar doen!

Je komt terecht in een jong team van BIM Projectcoördinatoren & 4D BIM Coördinatoren binnen het Cluster Geografisch Ontwerp, waar je samenwerkt met waterbouw-, weg- en constructief ontwerpers. Binnen dit team draag je niet alleen bij aan projecten, maar werk je ook mee aan innovaties op het gebied van data-integratie en automatisering om het ontwerpproces continu te verbeteren. Spreekt dit je aan? Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou!

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit:

Als BIM Projectcoördinator heb je een proactieve houding en zorg je voor een soepele en continue afstemming tussen de verschillende disciplines (bijvoorbeeld bruggenbouw). Je schakelt makkelijk tussen stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen aangesloten blijft en dezelfde koers volgt. Daarbij neem je initiatief, signaleer je knelpunten tijdig en anticipeer je op wat het project nodig heeft om efficiënt door te kunnen blijven lopen.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het inrichten van het modelmanagementsysteem, het opstellen van werkafspraken voor informatielevering en het uitvoeren van clashdetectie.

Concreet betekent dit dat je je gaat bezighouden met:

  • Het coördineren en vastleggen van afspraken in het BIM‑uitvoeringsplan en het actueel houden hiervan in samenspraak met de informatiemanager, ontwerpleider en hoofdontwerper. Als rechterhand van de ontwerpleider zie je erop toe dat deze afspraken worden nageleefd.

  • Het volgen van marktontwikkelingen op het gebied van 3D‑ontwerp en modelcoördinatie, het onderzoeken van behoeften binnen de organisatie en het bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het cluster.

Dit maakt jouw toekomstige collega trots....

"Integraal samenwerken geeft mij dagelijks energie. Door ontwerp en uitvoering te verbinden, werk ik samen aan sterke resultaten. Ik krijg het vertrouwen en de ruimte om kansen te benutten en richting te geven, waardoor ik me continu ontwikkel, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Een plek waar ik mij echt betrokken voel en graag deel van uitmaak."

Marco, Vakgroephoofd Modelbeheer

Bekijk meer collega’s en projecten waar we trots op zijn! Boskalis job stories | Boskalis

Herken je jezelf hierin?

Herken jij jezelf in het onderstaande profiel en word je enthousiast van het begeleiden van ontwerpsessies en het stap voor stap efficiënter maken van het projectproces en vind je het leuk om het 3D‑coördinatiemodel op te zetten en verschillende disciplines samen te brengen en heb je:

  • Een afgeronde relevante hbo-opleiding.
  • Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring als modelleur, ontwerper of BIM-coördinator op integrale projecten.
  • Kennis van 3D-modelleersoftware, zoals Revit. - Je hebt ervaring met het samenbrengen van verschillende disciplines binnen een ontwerpproces.
  • Sterke communicatieve en coachende vaardigheden.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Onzettend veel zin om door Nederland te reizen en verschillende projectlocaties te bezoeken.

Jij helpt Nederland vooruit, wij jou

Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

  • Een 4‑wekelijkse uitbetaling van € 3374,-- tot € 5503,-- bij een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur). Je ontvangt maar liefst 13 betalingen per jaar.
  • 26 verlofdagen bij een fulltime dienstverband plús een variabel aantal roostervrije dagen per jaar. Daarnaast kun je extra vrije dagen bijkopen.
  • Een leaseauto.
  • Een laptop en telefoon.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waaraan Boskalis Nederland (grotendeels) meebetaalt zodat je netto meer salaris overhoudt.
  • Volop ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden. Denk aan opleidingen via onze eigen Boskalis Academy, Performance & Development-gesprekken én boeiende events – van webinars tot career-events met trainingen en collega’s die vertellen over hun loopbaanstappen binnen Boskalis.
  • Projecten op locaties door het hele land. De Boskalis-campus in Papendrecht is de uitvalsbasis – hier vind je restaurants, een sportveld mét wekelijkse sportlessen, een state-of-the-art auditorium, een hippe koffieplek én een prachtig uitzicht op onze eigen scheepskade.
  • Waardevolle ontmoetingen met collega’s. Bijvoorbeeld via netwerk- en kennissessies en andere events. Of de activiteiten van onze community’s, zoals Young Boskalis en Women@Boskalis.

Zo word jij onze nieuwe BIM Projectcoördinator

Upload je cv via het sollicitatieformulier.

Houd je inbox of telefoon in de gaten: binnen 5 dagen ontvang je een persoonlijke reactie.

Voor meer informatie over de functie of sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met Sandra Hofstede, senior corporate recruiter, via 06 – 46042957.

title: Physician - ADHD Diagnosis and Treatment (Arkansas)
description:
Who are we, and why should you join us?

ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. Our telehealth platform——was founded to integrate technology, clinical expertise, and progressive approaches to emotional wellness.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for Arkansas licensed Physicians to join our provider network. You can focus on providing clinical expertise while we take care of everything else. Arkansas license required.

Who Should Apply?
  • Physicians looking for an easy, all-in-one technology platform for telehealth.
  • Physicians who are experienced in prescribing stimulant and non stimulant medication when necessary and following federal and state laws.
  • Physicians who want to focus 100% on clinical work – not on acquiring clients, billing, support, or operations. (We handle all of that!)
  • Provide holistic mental healthcare to your patients including diagnostic and medication management.
  • Develop and implement treatment plans tailored to your patient's needs and follow the best practices and clinical guidelines.
  • Collaborate with our team of mental health professionals to ensure that your patients receive comprehensive, coordinated care.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records following legal and ethical standards.
  • Help shape our treatment philosophy and contribute to developing clinical policies and procedures.
  • Active and unrestricted license in Arkansas (required).
  • Active DEA license preferred. Stimulants can be provided in certain states where a DEA is required.
  • Currently carry (or be willing to obtain) independent malpractice liability insurance.
  • Experience diagnosing and treating adult ADHD (ages 18+).
  • Experience prescribing medication, preferably on a telehealth platform.
  • A private and professional environment for conducting sessions.
  • Excellent written communication.
  • Reliable Internet connection.
  • Currently residing in the US.
  • Flexible schedule: You’re always in control of your schedule and appointment times.
  • Location: We are fully remote – you can work anywhere in the US.
  • License reimbursement: We pay for your license in states where we face a high demand.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We handle operations and ongoing client support.
  • Visibility: We regularly work with leading mental health online publications (Forbes, Ver Well Mind, etc.) to feature articles or case studies written by our team members

Hourly Pay: $150-$200
  • Diagnosis + Medication Management (45 minutes): $112.50-$150
  • Medication Management (30 minutes): $75.00-$100
  • Medication Management Follow-Up (15 minutes): $37.50-$50

title: Regional Director - Customer (East)
description:
This is a pivotal leadership appointment where customer experience, colleague engagement and place-based strategy sit at the heart of success.

Shape the future of customer experience in our communities.

At Bromford Flagship Livewest we believe everyone deserves a safe, secure and warm home. As our Regional Director - Customer, you will be the leading customer voice within the region, driving the delivery of outstanding services while shaping the future of our customer and colleague experience.

This is a highly visible leadership role, responsible for translating our organisational vision into a customer-focused regional strategy that delivers excellent outcomes for residents, colleagues and communities. You'll build on strong existing foundations, ensuring our services continue to evolve to meet changing customer needs while maintaining the trusted relationships already established across the business.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an inspirational leader who understands that great customer outcomes are achieved through engaged colleagues, strong partnerships and a deep understanding of place.

You will lead the development and delivery of customer strategy across the region, ensuring services remain locally responsive, commercially sustainable and focused on achieving the highest standards of customer satisfaction. Working alongside Heads of Service and senior leaders across Housing, Property, Compliance and other business areas, you will champion a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

This role offers the opportunity to influence strategic direction, drive transformational change and ensure that customer insight remains central to decision making across the organisation.

Location: Regional (Candidates should be based within the region or demonstrate exceptional knowledge of the local communities, demographics and housing landscape)

Hours: Full Time - 37 hpw - Monday to Friday

Contract: Permanent

Benefit Package: Market-leading salary and excellent benefits

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • leading the regional customer strategy and ensuring delivery of exceptional customer outcomes.

  • developing and implementing new approaches, initiatives and service improvements that enhance both customer and colleague experience.

  • using customer insight, operational performance data and local knowledge to shape priorities and drive continuous improvement.

  • maintaining and strengthening trusted relationships with Heads of Service and other senior stakeholders across the business.

  • acting as a compelling ambassador for customer excellence, influencing and securing buy-in from colleagues, customers, partners and executive stakeholders.

  • building strong relationships with local authorities, community organisations and strategic partners.

  • leading high-performing teams through change while creating a culture where colleagues feel empowered, engaged and supported.

  • ensuring services remain compliant, efficient and aligned with organisational objectives and regulatory requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

We are particularly interested in hearing from candidates who have:

  • significant senior leadership experience within housing or a similarly customer-centric and regulated environment.

  • a proven track record of developing and successfully implementing customer, operational or service transformation strategies.

  • demonstrable experience improving customer satisfaction, service delivery and colleague engagement.

  • outstanding stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence, challenge and gain commitment at all levels.

  • strong commercial awareness and experience managing significant operational budgets.

  • a genuine passion for customers, communities and creating services that make a meaningful difference.

  • the credibility and relationship-building skills to continue the excellent partnerships already established across the business.

  • deep knowledge of the region, its communities and demographics, either through living and working locally or through extensive professional experience within the area.

  • the ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery and execution.

For full details on the role and its responsibilities, click here to view the Regional Director - Customer - The Part I Play document.

WHY JOIN US

This is more than an operational leadership position. It is an opportunity to shape how customers experience our services, influence organisational strategy and improve outcomes for thousands of residents across the region.

This is an exciting time to join BFL. Through strong performance, financial resilience and a clear commitment to investing in homes, communities and services, the organisation is delivering meaningful improvements for customers while continuing to grow and evolve.

As Regional Director - Customer, you will have the opportunity to build on this success by shaping the future customer experience across the region. Working at the forefront of strategic change, you will help ensure that every decision reflects the needs of customers and communities, creating services that are locally responsive, colleague-led and truly customer-focused.

Discover more about BFL's performance and vision for the future.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • market-leading salary - up to £140,000.00 per annum

  • fully flexible annual leave

  • agile working

  • family friendly policies

  • health and wellbeing support

  • commitment to enabling you to thrive

For full benefit information, click here.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply please click "apply online" below. You will be asked to attach your CV (in MS Word or PDF format) and provide a supporting statement, outlining why you’re the right person for the job.

Important information

Closing Date: 20th September 2026 (Midnight)

Interview: We operate a three-stage interview process designed to provide both you and us with valuable insight into the opportunity, ensuring a strong alignment of experience, values, leadership approach, and long-term aspirations. Dates to be confirmed.

About Us
Bromford Flagship Livewest. By joining us, you become part of a one of the largest housing providers in the UK - delivering community-focused services across the East, Central and South West of England. We manage approximately 120,000 homes, serving around 300,000 customers, and with firm ambitions to deliver an additional 50,000 new homes by 2040.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW OF 73 STRINGS:

73 Strings is an innovative platform providing comprehensive data extraction, monitoring, and valuation solutions for the private capital industry. The company's AI-powered platform streamlines middle-office processes for alternative investments, enabling seamless data structuring and standardization, monitoring, and fair value estimation at the click of a button. 73 Strings serves clients globally across various strategies, including Private Equity, Growth Equity, Venture Capital, Infrastructure and Private Credit.

Our 2025 $55M Series B, the largest in the industry, was led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from Golub Capital and Hamilton Lane, with continued support from Blackstone, Fidelity International Strategic Ventures and Broadhaven Ventures.

About the Role:

73 Strings has been consistently growing and innovating. Our FP&A function needs to keep pace — and that means bringing in a sharp, commercially curious analyst who wants to do more than process numbers.

This role sits at the centre of financial planning, reporting, and analysis for a scaling AI SaaS business. You'll report to the Head of FP&A, supporting the financial infrastructure that underpins board reporting, investor communications, and strategic decision-making. If you're part-qualified (ACCA, CIMA, or ACA), intellectually curious, and want exposure to the full finance stack of a high-growth company, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Support the monthly close process — variance analysis, management accounts, and board-ready reporting packs.

  • Analyse revenue performance by product, cohort, and segment — identifying trends, not just reporting them.

  • Partner with function leads across the business to build, monitor and maintain budgets and forecasts — translating their plans into financial terms and their results back into business language.

  • Identify reporting inefficiencies and fix them; use AI tools actively to automate repetitive analysis, draft commentary, and accelerate model-building.

  • Flag risks & opportunities before they show up in the financials, using early signals from the business rather than waiting for month-end close.

  • Support other ah doc projects as required by the business.

Requirements:

  • Part-qualified in ACCA, CIMA, or ACA — actively studying, CIMA preferred. Study support (exam costs, study leave provided).

  • 2–3 years in an FP&A, finance, or commercial analyst role (SaaS or tech experience a plus).

  • Comfortable in Excel at an advanced level — model-building, not just model-reading.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in a finance context — Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar — to speed up analysis, draft output, or handle repetitive tasks.

  • Exposure to NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and CRM tools such as HubSpot — comfortable pulling data, reconciling outputs, and working across systems.

  • Analytical instinct: you don't just describe numbers, you ask why they moved.

  • Able to work with ambiguous data and state your assumptions clearly.

  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the commercial story.

  • Effective communicator — you can translate financial output into plain language for non-finance stakeholders.

title: Geospatial Data Analyst
description:
Geospatial Data Analyst

The Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation (RMEF) is a mission-driven non-profit dedicated to ensuring the future of elk, other wildlife, their habitat and our hunting heritage. Since our founding in 1984, we have helped conserve nearly one square mile of elk country every day. In partnership with others, we have conserved or enhanced more than 9.1 million acres, including improving public access to 1.6 million acres. Our impact will extend to 10 million acres by 2030. RMEF is proud of our conservation successes and is committed to making an even larger impact in the future.


RMEF is seeking an experienced professional to serve as the organization’s central geospatial resource, responsible for collecting, managing, analyzing, and visualizing spatial data to advance RMEF’s operations, mission, and strategic goals. Responsibilities include:

  • Designing and maintaining a centralized GIS architecture
  • Developing standardized workflows
  • Producing high-quality maps, applications, and analyses that support mission delivery, storytelling, advocacy, fundraising, membership growth, and executive decision-making

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of conservation in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.


Qualifications include:

· Bachelor’s degree is required in geography, GIS, natural resource management, or a closely related field

· Minimum of five years’ experience with geospatial analysis, GIS data management, and cartography is required, preferably within a wildlife conservation or natural resources context

· Demonstrated experience with cartographic design, interactive mapping, or geospatial storytelling preferred


Location: This position is based at RMEF’s Headquarters office in Missoula, Montana and requires fulltime on-site work.


Essential Functions:

1. Geospatial Data Governance + Standards: Design, implement, and maintain RMEF’s centralized GIS data structure in conjunction with organizational data governance. Establish and document standards for geospatial data collection, storage, access, naming conventions, metadata, quality control, and versioning. Ensure spatial datasets are consistent, sustainable, and usable across departments and systems. Work across departments to promote consistent, standardized use of GIS tools and data. Develop documentation, workflows, and training resources to improve GIS literacy and enable non-technical staff to effectively access organizational data through GIS tools.


2. Geospatial Data Management + Integration: Collect, manage, maintain, and validate internal and external datasets critical to mission delivery and organizational planning. Engage with agency and industry partners to research, acquire, and steward key datasets, including parcel data, conservation easements, habitat and wildlife layers, proprietary partner layers, and access-related information. Identify and integrate GIS data with internal systems, NetSuite, and workflows, including mission, grants, membership, marketing, and development data, to support reporting, analysis, and compliance needs.


3. Mapping, Visualization + Design: Create high-quality static and interactive maps, dashboards, and web-based GIS applications that clearly communicate RMEF accomplishments, opportunities, and future direction. Apply strong cartographic design principles to ensure clarity, accuracy, and visual impact in line with RMEF brand standards. Collaborate with the Brand + Communications and Marketing + Partnerships departments to support storytelling, donor engagement, and public-facing communications through compelling visual products.


4. Mission Support: Provide direct geospatial support to Mission projects, including creation of project maps, access analysis, parcel research, and grant applications. Support conservation planning, project selection, and development by supplying spatial research, analysis, and visualization that strengthens decision-making and documentation.


5. Evolving Technology + Modernization: Maintain and administer GIS software, tools, licenses, and supporting infrastructure in coordination with Internal Operations staff. Stay current on emerging GIS technologies, visualization techniques, and best practices, recommending and implementing improvements that increase analytical capacity, efficiency, and organizational value.


6. Additional Responsibilities: Maintain relevant GIS certifications and pursue ongoing professional development. Coordinate with external partners and vendors as needed. Serve as backup support for other members of the department as needed. Perform other work as required.


Supervision of Others:

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.


Education and Experience:

A bachelor’s degree is required in geography, GIS, natural resource management, or a closely related field. A minimum of five years’ experience with geospatial analysis, GIS data management, and cartography is required, preferably within a wildlife conservation or natural resources context. Demonstrated experience with cartographic design, interactive mapping, or geospatial storytelling preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  1. Knowledge and support of RMEF’s mission, goals, and activities, and ability to promote them.
  2. Strong knowledge of GIS principles, spatial analysis techniques, and geospatial data management.
  3. Proficiency in creating high-quality maps and dynamic maps using sound cartographic design principles.
  4. Knowledge of wildlife management, habitat management, land conservation, and access-related spatial data.
  5. Working knowledge of real estate transactions, including title work and proficiency in reading legal descriptions, to support accurate spatial data interpretation and creation.
  6. Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining geospatial data structures, standards, and workflows.
  7. Ability to translate complex spatial data into clear, compelling visual products for technical and non-technical audiences.
  8. Working knowledge and understanding of accounting, Microsoft Office, and relational databases.
  9. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  10. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with sound judgment.
  11. Ability to meet deadlines, set priorities, and work within a dynamic, changing environment.
  12. Ability to work independently while functioning effectively in a team environment.
  13. Strong customer service ethic and professional demeanor.


Physical Demands:

The employee must sit or stand for long periods of time; use a computer terminal; reach forward and to the side; bend from both standing and sitting position; and lift items of light and medium weight. Travel by automobile, airplane, foot, or mechanized ORV may be required. Travel may include overnight and weekend trips.

title: UI/UX Artist
description:
Join us as a UI/UX Artist on Supremacy: Warhammer 40K, our strategy game set in the iconic universe!

We are looking for a talented and experienced UI/UX Artist to join our Art Team and help shape the player experience. In this role, you will combine strong visual design and UX expertise with hands-on Unity knowledge to create intuitive, polished interfaces and bring them from Figma into the final game.

You will work on a complex, systems-heavy strategy game and have the opportunity to create UI within the distinctive visual universe of Warhammer 40K, while taking ownership of UI quality throughout the full production process—early flows and mockups to in-engine implementation and visual QA.

If you’re excited about combining great UX, strong visual design, and technical UI skills, we would love to hear from you! Apply now with your CV and portfolio.

YOUR MISSION

  • Design and deliver cross-platform UI/UX solutions that improve usability, clarity, and player engagement.

  • Transform game design briefs into intuitive user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.

  • Create visually appealing UI assets, including icons, layouts, components, and animations, while ensuring readability and consistency with the game's visual direction.

  • Translate Figma designs into production-ready UI in Unity, including layouts, components and prefabs, responsive behaviour, states, text, sprites, and animations.

  • Design and implement responsive interfaces that work reliably across supported resolutions, aspect ratios, safe areas, and device classes.

  • Own the visual quality of UI from initial design through in-engine implementation, including visual QA and iteration in Unity.

  • Analyse existing interfaces and propose improvements to functionality, information hierarchy, usability, and aesthetics.

  • Build and maintain reusable UI components, design systems, guidelines, and best practices across Figma and Unity.

  • Collaborate closely with game designers, UX, developers, tech artists, and other artists to ensure design goals are technically feasible and implementation constraints are addressed early.

  • Contribute to improving the Figma-to-Unity production pipeline and reducing unnecessary development overhead for routine UI implementation.

  • Ensure final in-game interfaces accurately reflect approved designs in terms of layout, spacing, typography, assets, responsiveness, and interaction states.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in a UI/UX-related role in the mobile gaming industry or a similar field.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in interface design, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and UX principles, ideally for games or other complex digital products.

  • Proficient in Figma, with strong knowledge of component-based design systems, variants, reusable patterns, and scalable file organisation.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Unity UI and the ability to translate Figma designs into production-ready in-engine interfaces.

  • Experience working with UI layouts, prefabs or reusable components, anchors, responsive behaviour, text, sprites, UI states, and animations in Unity.

  • Strong understanding of the Figma-to-Unity workflow, including asset preparation, componentisation, scaling, resolution and aspect-ratio handling, and implementation constraints.

  • Good understanding of responsive UI principles, safe areas, layout scaling, and cross-device constraints.

  • Experience designing information-dense interfaces and complex interaction flows; experience with strategy, simulation, MMO, or other systems-heavy games is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with or enthusiasm for the Warhammer 40K universe and its distinctive visual identity is a plus.

  • Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance visual quality, usability, and technical constraints.

  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and multicultural teams, including remote collaboration.

  • Passion for staying actively involved throughout development and taking ownership of the quality of the final player-facing experience.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

A Global Team, A Shared Purpose

Our strength lies in our diversity. With over 30 nationalities represented across our two locations, we’re united by a shared passion for strategy games and a bold vision for the future. We celebrate what makes each of us unique – our perspectives, our stories, and the paths that led us here.

Work Your Way

Whether you're crafting code from a harbor-view desk in Hamburg or fine-tuning design details under the Maltese sun, we support flexible hybrid work models that empower you to do your best work – wherever you are.

Grow With Us

At Twin Harbour, your journey matters. Our Career Path Framework and mentorship culture provide the clarity and feedback you need to take the next step – whether you’re deepening your expertise or branching into new disciplines. We invest in your growth with language courses, e-learning platforms, and support for conferences and training.

We’re Human First

We believe that great teams are built on trust, respect, and good humor. From game nights to casual drinks, quiz nights, and karaoke, we don’t just work together – we connect, play, and support each other like a true crew.

Join Twin Harbour Interactive

Where Strategy Meets Vision.

Twin Harbour Interactive is a global strategy game powerhouse, shaping the future of long-term multiplayer gaming. With offices in Hamburg and Malta, we design strategy games that bring people together – across borders and generations.

Whether you’re an expert tactician or an imaginative world-builder, there’s a place here for you to grow, thrive, and leave your mark.

Jeg liker musikk, bøker på engelsk, serier som Game of Thrones og Bridgerton, og spill som Minecraft og Simms. Kan du tegnspråk, er det flott – hvis ikke, kan vi lære sammen.

Jeg gleder meg til å møte deg!

Jeg ser nå etter en fast assistent som kan jobbe 13-14 timer i uka. Vi ser for oss en dagvakt i uka (gjerne onsdag, men her er vi fleksible), samt mandag ettermiddag/kveld. Skriv gjerne når du har mulighet til å jobbe, så finner vi ut av nøyaktig arbeidstid sammen.

I tillegg ser jeg etter et par tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov.

description:

The Agile Scrum Master / Project Manager provides senior-level management and consulting expertise in support of IT programs and application development projects. This position provides technical support in systems analysis and design, project management coordination, project planning, risk and issue management, and the development of project documentation and methodologies. The role works closely with Government staff, application teams, and business process reengineering teams to support successful program and project execution.

description:
Pay: LADC, $34-37/hr


Community Medical Services (CMS) is hiring a Substance Abuse Counselor to assist patients recovering from addictions to opioids and other illicit substances. Whether facilitating individual or group sessions, or assisting patients with treatment plans and coping strategies, your work will help foster a safe place for anyone looking to start their recovery journey with us.


As part of our mission to help individuals recover from substance use disorders, you’ll thrive in a supportive, engaging, and fulfilling work environment where your contributions are valued.


Along the way, we’ll invest in your well-being through a benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

  • Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Short and long-term disability insurance
  • Life insurance

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is excited to work in an outpatient setting, much like a doctor’s office or behavioral health clinic.
  • Enjoys a consistent schedule.
  • Is open to working with multi-cultural and low socio-economic individuals.

To thrive in this role, you must be able to:

  • Maintain and manage a caseload in compliance with regulatory standards and ratios.

  • Maintain a thorough and comprehensive client record.
  • Serve as the point of contact for coordination and communication with other systems where clinical knowledge of the case is crucial.
  • Assist in screening and coordinating primary care services for clients.

title: Head of Tax, North America
description:
Position Summary

The Head of Tax, North America is responsible for leading the regional tax function across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

The role is accountable for the effective management of tax compliance, tax reporting, audits, transfer pricing, tax risk, and governance. Equally important, the position is expected to establish and drive a proactive regional tax agenda focused on tax optimization, cash-tax management, risk reduction, process improvement, and support of significant business initiatives.

The Head of Tax, North America serves as the principal tax leader for North America. The position directly reports to the CFO North America and functionally to the Global Head of Tax. The role must anticipate tax implications, independently identify risks and opportunities, develop clear recommendations and drive initiatives through implementation rather than operating solely as a reactive compliance function.

The position is integral part of and works closely with the AUMOVIO Group Tax Function and to ensure that regional activities are aligned with global tax strategy, policies, governance standards, and reporting requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Strategy and Optimization

• Develop and execute the North America tax strategy in alignment with regional business priorities and the global tax framework.

• Establish and maintain a forward-looking tax agenda covering tax optimization, cash-tax improvement, risk reduction, and operational effectiveness.

• Proactively identify tax risks and opportunities without relying on the CFO or other functions to initiate the review.

• Develop business cases and actionable recommendations, including estimated financial impact, required resources, risks, and implementation steps.

• Initiate and lead tax-related projects through completion, working across Finance, Treasury, Legal, Operations and other functions.

• Identify opportunities related to legal entity structures, supply-chain arrangements, incentives, credits, transfer pricing, and other relevant areas.

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and recommend appropriate actions.

Executive and Business Partnership

• Serve as the principal tax leader and strategic business partner to the North America CFO, regional leadership team, Global Head of Tax, and AUMOVIO Group Tax organization.

• Provide clear, practical advice on significant business decisions, investments, restructurings, contracts, financing activities, supply-chain changes, and other transactions.

• Translate complex tax matters into concise business recommendations that allow leadership to make informed decisions.

• Participate early in significant initiatives so that tax implications are identified and managed before decisions are finalized.

• Maintain effective relationships with the Global Head of Tax and Group Tax organization.

Tax Operations, Reporting and Compliance

• Oversee all significant direct and indirect tax compliance activities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

• Ensure accurate and timely tax provisions, forecasts, tax packages, statutory reporting, and other required submissions (e.g., Pillar II reporting).

• Maintain appropriate oversight of uncertain tax positions, tax-related internal controls, supporting documentation, and compliance with Group Tax reporting requirements.

• Ensure regional compliance with global tax policies, documentation standards, and governance requirements.

• Improve tax processes, systems, automation, data quality, and operating efficiency.

• Maintain clear ownership, backup coverage, and documentation for critical tax processes.

Tax Risk, Audits and Controversy

• Own the identification, assessment and reporting of material tax risks across North America.

• Lead the regional strategy for tax audits, assessments, disputes, appeals, and settlements.

• Ensure significant matters are escalated promptly to the North America CFO and Global Head of Tax.

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders, external advisors, and tax authorities.

• Develop defensible positions that protect enterprise value while appropriately managing commercial and operational considerations.

Transfer Pricing

• Oversee regional execution of global transfer pricing policies and requirements.

• Ensure appropriate documentation, implementation, and monitoring of intercompany arrangements.

• Partner with Group Tax on transfer pricing strategy, audits, disputes, and changes to business models.

• Identify and address transfer pricing risks arising from operational or organizational changes.

Leadership and Organization Development

• Lead, develop and retain a capable regional tax organization.

• Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability across the team.

• Build succession plans and backup coverage for critical responsibilities.

• Improve the team’s ability to operate as a proactive business partner rather than solely as a compliance function.

• Ensure the organization has the right balance of internal capability and external support.

External Advisor Management

• Establish an effective external-advisor strategy based on capability, responsiveness, cost, and business need.

• Define clear scopes, deliverables, timelines, and accountability for external advisors.

• Ensure external spending produces measurable value and does not replace appropriate internal ownership.

• Maintain key relationships with accounting firms, legal counsel, and specialist tax advisors.

Leadership Profile

• Proactive and self-directed.

• A strategic tax leader, not solely a technical specialist.

• Commercially minded and focused on practical outcomes.

• Comfortable challenging existing assumptions and raising issues independently.

• Capable of moving from analysis to recommendation and implementation.

• Able to communicate complex matters clearly to senior executives.

• Effective in a matrix organization with both regional and global stakeholders.

• Accountable for results, deadlines, and measurable value creation.

Success Measures

Performance will be evaluated based on:

• Establishment and execution of a proactive tax agenda.

• Identification and delivery of tax optimization and cash-tax opportunities.

• Effective management and mitigation of material tax risks.

• Quality and timeliness of tax reporting and compliance.

• Successful management of audits, disputes, and tax authority matters.

• Quality of recommendations, support and business outcomes delivered to executive leadership.

• Timely execution of tax-related projects and business initiatives.

• Strength and development of the regional tax team.

• Effectiveness and value of external-advisor spend.

• Alignment with global tax strategy, policies, and governance requirements.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, Finance, Law, or a related field.

• 12+ years of progressive tax experience, including at least 5 years in a tax leadership role within a complex multinational organization.

• Strong technical knowledge of U.S. federal, state, international and transfer pricing matters.

• Experience leading tax compliance, tax reporting, audits, and controversy matters.

• Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing tax planning or optimization initiatives.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects and advising executive leadership.

• Strong business judgment, communication, and influencing skills.

• Ability to balance tax optimization, compliance, governance, and commercial objectives.

• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job posting.

• AUMOVIO may offer relocation assistance for this opportunity.

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT

• CPA, JD, master’s degree in taxation or equivalent professional qualification.

• Experience in manufacturing, automotive or another complex industrial environment.

• Experience across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

• Experience working within a global matrix organization.

• Experience managing internal teams and external-advisor networks.

• Experience supporting restructurings, supply-chain changes, legal-entity optimization or other significant business transformations.

THE PERKS

  • Immediate Benefits
  • Robust Total Rewards Package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Employee Discounts
  • Competitive Bonus Programs
  • Employees 401k Match
  • Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment with 20+ Employee Resource groups.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Future Growth Opportunities, including personal and professional
  • And many more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

title: Taloushallinnon asiantuntija
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme taloushallinnon asiantuntijaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka hallitset taloushallinnon arjen käytännöt, viihdyt itsenäisessä vastuuroolissa ja haluat olla tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa yrityksen päivittäisen taloushallinnon sujuvuutta.

Kyseessä on rekrytointi asiakkaamme kirjoille. Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus joustavaan etätyöhön.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?

Roolissasi vastaat yrityksen päivittäisen taloushallinnon hoitamisesta ja toimit tärkeänä yhteyshenkilönä ulkoistetun kirjanpidon ja palkanlaskennan suuntaan. Kirjanpito ja palkanlaskenta tehdään kumppaneiden toimesta, mutta tässä tehtävässä varmistat, että tarvittavat aineistot, tiedot ja selvitykset kulkevat oikein ja ajallaan.

Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat reskontrien hoito, maksuliikenne, laskutukseen liittyvät selvitykset sekä kirjanpitoaineistojen koordinointi. Lisäksi tehtävään voi sisältyä palkka-aineistoihin liittyvää seurantaa ja korjausten selvittelyä sekä mahdollisia henkilöstöhallinnon tukitehtäviä osaamisesi mukaan.

Tehtävä on luonteeltaan itsenäinen ja vastuullinen. Pääset ottamaan haltuun vakiintunutta taloushallinnon kokonaisuutta ja toimimaan yrityksen johdon, tilitoimiston, palkanlaskennan sekä sisäisten sidosryhmien tukena. Raportoit tehtävässä yrityksen toimitusjohtajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta taloushallinnon tehtävistä ja ymmärrät kirjanpidon, reskontran ja maksuliikenteen perusprosessit. Etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta erityisesti reskontrien ja maksuliikenteen hoitamisesta sekä valmiutta toimia yhteyshenkilönä tilitoimiston ja palkanlaskennan kanssa. Sinun ei tarvitse olla varsinainen kirjanpitäjä tai palkanlaskija, mutta sinun tulee ymmärtää näiden kokonaisuuksien toimintalogiikkaa riittävästi arjen yhteistyön ja aineistojen hallinnan näkökulmasta.

Arvostamme huolellista, järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta. Tehtävässä tarvitaan kykyä tarttua asioihin itsenäisesti, selvittää tilanteita ja pitää taloushallinnon arki hallinnassa. Hyvät perustason IT-taidot ja valmius oppia yrityksen käytössä olevia järjestelmiä auttavat tehtävässä onnistumisessa.

Tehtävässä tarvitaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen osaamista.

Miksi meille?

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja vastuullisen roolin kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa taloushallinnon asiantuntijalla on tärkeä vaikutus arjen sujuvuuteen. Rooli tarjoaa mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää omaa työnkuvaa osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Mikäli sinulla on valmiuksia esimerkiksi henkilöstöhallinnon, raportoinnin tai johdon tukemisen suuntaan, voidaan toimenkuvaa laajentaa ajan myötä.

Työaika on pääsääntöisesti arkisin noin klo 8–16 välillä ja viikkotyöaika on 37,5 tuntia. Tehtävässä on joustoa, ja myös etätyö on mahdollista työn kokonaisuus huomioiden. Kuukausipalkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja aloitus onnistuu sopimuksen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta ja etsit itsenäistä taloushallinnon roolia, jossa pääset ottamaan vastuuta ja tekemään merkityksellistä työtä yrityksen arjen tukena, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään ke 2.9.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja asiakasyritysestämme antaa Roope Takala, puh. 050 475 2852 tai roope.takala@biisoni.fi.

title: Entry QA Automation Engineer
