title: Faculty Position in Cancer Immunology
description:
Mayo Clinic invites applications for an institutionally supported faculty position in Immunology at its Arizona campus. We seek an innovative and collaborative investigator to develop a cutting-edge research program in the field of Cancer Immunology. Candidates are required to have a PhD or equivalent degree in a relevant discipline, with a track record of success in extramural funding, publications, and collaborations with clinicians. Ideal candidates would be those with expertise in the area of tumor and immune cell interactions, tumor immune environment, molecular and cell biology of immune cells involved in cancer, immune variations and immune monitoring across cancer patients, and cancer immunotherapy. All areas related to immune-oncology are also encouraged to apply. Preferred candidates will have innovative ideas that synergize with current strengths in the Department of Immunology and desire to translate their work to the clinic. The candidate is expected to establish an internationally recognized research program while fostering strong collaborations with leading basic scientists, clinician investigators and clinician specialists across Mayo Clinic’s integrated research and clinical enterprise.

Mayo Clinic
With an 83,000-person workforce, Mayo Clinic cares for more than 1.4 million people each year with serious or complex illnesses from all 50 U.S. states and 135 countries. Mayo Clinic is the largest not-for-profit, multidisciplinary academic medical center in the world with over 4,000 physicians and scientists in an integrated multi-campus system spanning the globe. The unified mission at Mayo Clinic is to provide the best patient care, backed by our expertise and innovation in education, research and practice, to bring hope and healing in times of need. We embrace collegial relationships among three campuses (Arizona, Florida and Minnesota) allowing for best practices and innovation to help solve the most serious complex medical challenges-one patient at a time.

We support a vibrant and diverse research enterprise, with programs in basic, translational, clinical, population, and data sciences. In 2025, the Mayo Clinic received $782 million in extramural research awards; the institution provided additional $539 million of intermural support to promote research. Laboratories and shared resource facilities are state-of-the-art, including those for biomolecular analysis, molecular development, data analytics, specimen processing, and structural testing and imaging. Mayo Clinic supports innovation and has a wealth of resources available – including an integrated health record and collaboration with top clinical specialists. The highly competitive compensation package includes substantial long-term institutional and departmental support for salary, personnel, equipment, and travel as well as a competitive startup package all designed to ensure immediate and continued success. Additional benefits for faculty at Mayo Clinic include intramural funding opportunities for research, innovation and collaboration.

The Department of Immunology
The Department of Immunology at Mayo Clinic, the oldest free-standing immunology department in the country, is the academic home for basic and translational scientists studying the immune system in health and disease. As scientists, department members have a common understanding and passion for advancing knowledge of fundamental mechanisms that cause and regulate inflammation and immunity. The Department of Immunology faculty are located at three campuses across the Mayo Clinic enterprise. Immunology laboratories are highly interactive and collaborative between campuses in Rochester (MN), Jacksonville (FL), and Phoenix/Scottsdale (AZ).

Faculty members in the Department of Immunology study a wide spectrum of diseases interrelated by the molecular, cellular, and genetic regulatory mechanisms that dictate the immune responses associated with them. The Department nurtures a highly interactive approach to basic science that creates new knowledge and fosters the discovery of new treatments and diagnostic tests for patients with disease-specific problems.

Research in the Department of Immunology is intertwined with the education and training of the next generation of researchers. Faculty members' laboratories serve as focal points for training graduate students seeking Ph.D. or M.D.-Ph.D. degrees through the Mayo Clinic Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences (MCGSBS). Department of Immunology faculty members teach courses in MCGSBS and Mayo Clinic Alix School of Medicine. They also mentor postdoctoral research fellows and clinical trainees conducting research. Each summer, the Mayo Clinic Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences' Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship engages undergraduates in various research experiences, including in the Department of Immunology.

Research Environment Related to Cancer Immunology
Mayo Clinic and Mayo Clinic Comprehensive Cancer Center (MCCCC) offer a highly collaborative and integrated academic medical center environment with expanding strengths in basic and clinical immunology, computational biology, AI-driven discovery, cell therapy, cancer immunotherapy, regenerative medicine, and translational science. Faculty benefit from:

  • Collaborative and supportive interactions with basic, translational, and clinical immunology faculty
  • Established CAR-T and immune therapy programs with active clinical translation
  • State-of-the-art genome engineering and cell manufacturing infrastructure
  • Existing and emerging cell therapy platforms, enabling novel approaches to immune cell engineering, stem cell modification, and in vivo gene editing strategies
  • Access to institutional core facilities including genomics, single-cell sequencing, proteomics, bioinformatics, and advanced imaging
  • A very strong AI-driven discovery program with exceptional “on prem” and cloud-based computational resources
  • Mayo Clinic Platform which holds the fully digitized longitudinal patient records from 15M Mayo Clinic patients and 54M patients with collaborating healthcare institutions from across the nation and the globe
  • A strong focus on translating first-in-human trials to bring new treatments to patients
  • Dedicated institutional support for regulatory strategy, clinical trial development, and commercialization pathway
  • A growing biotechnology corridor that attracts partner companies to accelerate translation of discoveries

Mayo Clinic Comprehensive Cancer Center (MCCCC)
With 440 members and >1500 aligned cancer physicians working in six Cancer Research Programs and 15 Disease Groups, MCCCC is a global leader and represents the pinnacle of cancer care, research and education and training. Every year, across its three enterprise sites (Rochester, Minnesota; Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona; and Jacksonville, Florida), MCCCC physicians provide expert cancer diagnosis and treatment to more than 150,000 unique patients from across the nation and the globe.

The MCCCC Misson: To inspire hope and promote health and healing through integrated research, clinical practice, and education, centered around our primary value: the needs of the patient come first.

The MCCCC Vision: To be a global cancer authority: transforming cancer research and practice to assure that our discoveries, knowledge, and expertise are accessible to all, within and beyond our walls, at anyplace and anytime.

MCCCC Goals:

  1. To cure cancers through translation of innovative transdisciplinary science to new means of prevention, early detection, interception, intervention, and unparalleled care delivery.
  2. To transform cancer research and practice using category of one data platforms, digital technologies, artificial intelligence (AI), and intelligent automation, creating new models for community and patient engagement, and the conduct of research, clinical trials and patient-centered care delivery in clinical, home, and community settings.
  3. To use Mayo Clinic Platform to engage patients and communities in our catchment areas and across the nation and the world in cancer research and distributed and decentralized clinical trials.
  4. To educate, train, and mentor the next generation of cancer physicians, scientists, and leaders.


Over the past year, MCCCC has continued to achieve exceptional performance metrics, with high levels of cancer research funding (reporting $61.2M in annual peer-reviewed funding ($41.1M from NCI) and $98.7M in industry and non-peer reviewed funding). The Center currently has over 80 multi-investigator programmatic grants including 6 NCI Specialized Programs of Research Emphasis (SPORES): Myeloma, Ovarian Cancer, Breast Cancer, Liver/Hepatobiliary Cancers, Prostate Cancer, and Sarcoma. In 2025, clinical trial accrual has remained robust, reporting the Center’s highest accrual to therapeutic interventional trials: 2,624 (12% of newly registered cases), with 6,588 interventional accruals (30% of newly registered patients) and 10,367 non-interventional accruals. In 2025, MCCCC members published an exceptional number (1776) of peer-reviewed academic works, 24% of which were published in high impact journals.

Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona
Phoenix is the capital city of Arizona and is located in the central region of the state; Scottsdale is adjacent to Phoenix. Their metropolitan area boasts almost 5 million residents in 25 cities and towns. People may know it for its year-round sun, desert beauty, and world-class resorts and golf, but as the fifth-largest city in the U.S., it also offers sophisticated urban capes, southwest culture and lots of outdoor adventure. The "Valley of the Sun" as Phoenicians refer to it, is surrounded by mountain parks—in fact, South Mountain Park and Preserve is the largest municipal park in the U.S.—so it's easy to get out and enjoy the flora, fauna and some incredible views (and sunsets). And, although Phoenix is in the Sonoran Desert, there are six lakes in close proximity where water lovers can kayak, paddleboard, Jetski, waterski, boat, fish or just lounge on the shore. Over the next few years, Mayo Clinic is making significant investments in both the physical and technological future of health care, through doubling the size of the Mayo Clinic campus in Phoenix, inclusive of practice, education, and research activities.

Credentials of a successful candidate will include a doctoral degree (Ph.D., M.D., Sc.D., or equivalent) with background in a relevant science and/or engineering field (e.g. immunology, pathology, cell biology, molecular biology, biomedical engineering). We especially seek investigators whose research programs directly and innovatively impact the field of cancer immunology.

The ideal candidate will have a history of NIH-equivalent extramural funding and strong promise to continuously compete well for meritorious, competitive extramural funding. Junior investigators with strong track record of funding and publications with clear vision to develop their research program in cancer immunology are also encouraged to apply. Candidates should exhibit evidence of leadership skills and multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary collaborations with both scientists and clinicians.

Applications should include a cover letter, CV with bibliography, and a statement of research interests.

title: Telephone Office Operator
description:
The Telephone Operator is primarily responsible for processing all incoming calls from Mayo Clinic patients, visitors, clinic staff, administrative staff, support staff, and the general public. Operator must be able to accurately process a high rate of telephone calls over an extended period of time. Responsibilities and tasks can be repetitive and persistent, but must be supported in a courteous manner through the duration of a full shift. Assists all callers in a polite, articulate, professional, and clear manner. Operator must handle confidential and sensitive information.

Utilizes the paging systems for authorized personnel over multiple channels including: public address system, emergency voice pagers, and alpha display priority pagers. Responsible for expediting all 911 emergencies to include: Code Triage Disasters; Radiation and Chemical Spills; External law enforcement, fire, and emergency medical service response (as applicable); coordination of non-emergency medical transports for Mayo Clinic patients; Fire Evacuation; Code Blue, Medical Emergency Team, Ventricular Assisted Device, and various internal/external Stroke Alert calls for the Phoenix and Scottsdale campuses.

Ability to search phonetically within various complex clinical applications inclusive of the Electronic Health Record. Responsible for physician on-call schedule updates, to include regular maintenance of provider schedules. Responsible for editing of employee directory, inclusive of all updates for new hires, transfers, terminations. Must be able to navigate through multiple electronic applications and devices, examples include: Infinity Telephone Agent (Telephone Operating system), On Call Supervisor, Telephone Operators Directory (TOD) Quarterly Manager, Quarterly Directory (printed and on-line), Intelligent Series Supervisor, Red Phone, Pager Lookup, Stroke LVO Group Paging System and backup.

This position requires critical thinking skills with strong attention to detail. Requires the ability to prioritize daily tasks simultaneously within a fast paced, ever changing work environment; must be adaptable and flexible within a strong team structure. Possesses a high level of concentration, memory retention, and attention to detail.

Must be able to meet the physical requirements including the ability to do the following: view a computer monitor and read newsprint font style and size; hear in both ears; visual acuity and ability to distinguish colors; sit at a computer desk, work in varying light levels, and perform repetitive upper body motions for duration of work shift. Works flexible hours, which may include days, evenings, nights, holidays and weekends. May be asked to perform other job-related duties as assigned by leadership including training of new employees.

High school diploma or GED equivalent. A minimum of two (2) years of customer service/hospitality/telephone operator experience, which includes at least one (1) year of multiple-line telephone experience.

Preferred:

  • Evidence of experience using various computer systems, applications and keyboarding skills.
  • Familiarity with Code Calls, Emergency Preparedness, and medical terminology preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to clearly speak, write, and understand the English language as well as be understood while speaking the English language.
  • Operators must be able to handle calls from diverse callers to include non-English speakers and utilization of translation resources.
  • Demonstrated competency of the following skills: spoken communication; interaction and versatility; decision making and problem solving; coping; commitment to task; tolerance of ambiguity; ability to handle stressful situations and process emergencies on the fly; use of verbal de-escalation techniques to manage irate or emotional callers, to bring resolution to their concerns.
  • Evidence of service excellence while displaying strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Ability to be alert, perceptive, dependable, and task oriented.
  • Ability to relate to persons with diverse educational, socioeconomic, and racial/ethnic backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated ability to function independently after receiving four to eight weeks of on-the-job-training.
  • Demonstrated ability to accurately maintain a log of emergent patient calls (after hours); emergency code calls; and stroke calls.

title: Vi söker fler undersköterskor till.....
description:
Välkommen till en värderingsstyrd organisation

Vi är ett litet boende med 35 platser med både somatisk och demensinriktning, beläget på Lidingö. Vi är ett trevligt team bestående av verksamhetschef, gruppchef, två sjuksköterskor och omvårdnadspersonal.

Vi söker dig som drivs av att arbeta med människor och göra verklig skillnad för boende varje dag. Du har förmåga att stärka och stödja dem i alla delar av vardagen.

Som person är du noggrann och engagerad i boendes behov och deras närstående. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, har ett professionellt förhållningssätt och bidrar till en god och trevlig stämning på vår arbetsplats. Viktigt att du ska kunna både ge och ta feedback för att bidra till utveckling av verksamheten.

Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vi söker dig som har intresse att planera och utföra aktiviteter samt utevistelse på vårt boende.

Tjänsten innefattar både arbete som undersköterska på ca 70 % omvårdnadsarbete samt 30 % aktivitetsansvar.

Arbetstider

Arbetstider under dag/kväll/helg.

Tillträdesdatum är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Dina arbetsuppgifter som aktivitetsansvarig kommer att vara:

  • Planera och utföra aktiviteter både på individ samt gruppnivå.

  • Göra inköp till aktivitet, därav med fördel ha körkort.

  • Ansvara för årets högtider/dukningar, pynt och liknande.

  • Sköta Instagram, lägga ut bilder.

I omvårdnadsuppgifter ingår:

  • Daglig omvårdnad till boende.

  • Städ i boendes lägenhet veckovis samt daglig tillsynsstäd.

  • Matlagning av lunch och middag, mottagning av matleveranser.

  • Daglig dokumentation.

  • Medicin utdelning.

Stämmer denna beskrivning in på dig?

Sök redan idag!

Du vill arbeta på en arbetsplats där du tillsammans med ditt team kan göra skillnad och ert engagemang uppskattas. Du trivs med att skapa goda relationer med kunder och vill skapa värde för dem och deras anhöriga. Du skulle beskriva dig själv som en serviceinriktad och ansvarsfull person som brinner för att hjälpa andra.

Kvalifikationer

Krav:

  • Erfarenhet från omsorgsarbete i äldreomsorgen.

  • Kravet är att ha undersköterskeutbildning med bevis från Socialstyrelsen.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska språket (tal och skrift).

  • God datorkunskap/datorvana samt att ha lätt att hantera olika appar/system i mobila telefoner (Epsilion, Sensio Pocket, MCSS Appva).

  • Medicindelegering.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?

Attendo är en trygg arbetsgivare som kan erbjuda dig som vill goda möjligheter att ta mer ansvar eller att gå vidare till nya roller.

Vi erbjuder dig som medarbetare utbildningsmöjligheter, kollektivavtal, friskvård samt flera andra förmåner och personalrabatter via vår förmånsportal AttendoPlus i samarbete med Benifex.

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Före eventuell anställning ska utdrag ur belastningsregistret tillsammans med giltig fotolegitimation visas upp.

Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så vänta inte med din ansökan!

Om Attendo

Attendo är ett av Nordens största omsorgsföretag och startades 1985. Vi är verksamma inom äldreboende och hemtjänst.

Våra värderingar omtanke, engagemang och kompetens vägleder oss dagligen i vårt arbete för att alla ska uppleva trivsel, delaktighet, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.

Välkommen med din ansökan – Tillsammans för framtidens omsorg!

Jasmina Filipovic, gruppchef

The Camera Modeling & Simulation team, a part of the Camera Hardware and Depth Team, develops novel metrology, calibration, and simulation processes to enable the implementation and architecture of machine-vision-driven and photographic experiences. We collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to define hardware design specifications and key performance metrics to deliver seamless user experiences. The team is seeking an expert in imaging, optical system design, or computer vision with broad skills to help develop next-generation, high-throughput simulation frameworks to guide the design and architecture of next generation products.

As a Modeling & Simulation Engineer on the Camera & Depth Architecture team, you will design, develop, and maintain high-throughput simulation frameworks to generate large volumes of synthetic imagery on-demand, and build and refine models of camera systems—from sensor to lens—to simulate real-world imaging performance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS and a minimum of 10+ years relevant industry experience in Optics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Programming experience in at least one of the coding languages: Python, C, C++ or Matlab.
  • Experience with one or more of the following: Optics: imaging system design, optical design, computational imaging, or similar.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS/PhD degree in Optics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or related field and relevant industry experience in Optics, optical systems modeling & simulation,
  • Experience in project management and/or driving projects independently in ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Published research in imaging, computational photography, or related fields.
  • Experience with one or more of diffraction, raytracing, beam propagation, radiometry, sensor physics.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation for ML training pipelines, model optimization and/or deployment, related to imaging and data analyses.
  • Data analysis from manufacturing sources, validation and correlation against real hardware.
  • Distributed processing / simulations at scale.
  • Experience with algorithms for image quality enhancement.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Python
description:
About Zinkworks

Zinkworks partners with leading Telecommunications and Financial Services organizations to modernize legacy systems, migrate mission-critical platforms to the cloud, and engineer AI-driven automation. From OSS transformation to rApp development and network intelligence, our teams simplify complexity and turn it into competitive advantage. Based in Ireland and operating across the EU, UK, and US, Zinkworks combines deep domain expertise with delivery excellence to help clients modernize faster and operate smarter.

About the Role

We are building a small, empowered product discovery team focused on Zinkworks’ Autonomous Networks product portfolio. The team will take new product ideas from initial concept through to high-fidelity working prototypes that telecommunications operators can explore, test, and respond to.

We are now hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the end-to-end technical foundations of these prototypes.

This is a hands-on engineering role spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, data flows, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations. You will build complete product experiences, translating early-stage ideas into reliable and engaging prototypes that demonstrate how autonomous network technologies can solve real operational problems.

Many of the products we build are agent-driven. You will work closely with AI Engineers to connect intuitive user experiences and dependable backend services with the underlying agent layer. This includes designing the technical seams that allow agentic systems to interact safely and effectively with users, data, workflows, and real-world systems.

The role is suited to someone who enjoys early-stage product engineering, can make sensible technical decisions without every requirement being fully defined, and is comfortable moving quickly without compromising engineering quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full-stack implementation of product discovery probes, demonstrators, and working prototypes.

  • Build intuitive, responsive user interfaces that allow telecommunications operators to understand, test, and interact with complex autonomous network capabilities.

  • Design and develop backend services, APIs, data models, and integrations that support AI-enabled products and workflows.

  • Build server-side foundations that allow agent-driven applications to interact with real systems, processes, and data sources.

  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to define integration patterns between the application layer, backend services, and agent frameworks.

  • Translate AI and agent outputs into clear, trustworthy, and actionable user experiences.

  • Design APIs, data flows, and service boundaries that support both frontend applications and autonomous agents.

  • Implement real-time and asynchronous application experiences, including job status, notifications, streaming responses, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Stand up and maintain demo and prototype infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

  • Work with Product, Design, AI Engineering, and the Tech Lead to move ideas from early concepts to high-fidelity prototypes.

  • Help define full-stack code standards, engineering practices, reusable components, and technical guardrails.

  • Make pragmatic architecture and technology decisions in a fast-moving product discovery environment.

  • Introduce appropriate testing, observability, security, and deployment practices without slowing down experimentation.

  • Support the transition of successful prototypes into more scalable and production-ready product delivery paths.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Software Engineer, or similar, delivering user-facing applications from frontend through to backend.

  • Production experience with Python for backend services, APIs, or data-driven applications.

  • Strong experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, or an equivalent technology.

  • Experience designing and building APIs, backend services, data models, and integrations.

  • Ability to create polished, responsive, and accessible user interfaces.

  • Good understanding of frontend architecture, component design, application state, API integration, and browser-based performance.

  • Solid understanding of cloud-native engineering principles.

  • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform or a comparable cloud provider.

  • Confidence working in ambiguous, early-stage, or product discovery environments.

  • Ability to make technical and product decisions without relying on a fully defined backlog or detailed specification.

  • Strong product instincts and an interest in building technology that users can explore, validate, and respond to.

  • Comfortable using AI-augmented development tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

  • Ability to collaborate closely with AI Engineers, Product, Design, and technical stakeholders.

  • A practical engineering mindset that balances speed, user experience, quality, security, and maintainability.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building full-stack applications for AI-driven products.

  • Exposure to agentic AI systems, LLM applications, or modern agent frameworks.

  • Experience designing user experiences for conversational, generative, or autonomous systems.

  • Familiarity with patterns such as streaming responses, tool execution, approval workflows, explainability, and human-in-the-loop interactions.

  • Experience building dashboards, operational tooling, workflow applications, or complex data visualisations.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, or similar.

  • Familiarity with Google ADK or related agent development frameworks.

  • Experience with event-driven systems, asynchronous processing, or real-time application updates.

  • Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, auditability, and secure integration patterns.

  • Telecoms, OSS, network automation, or autonomous networks experience.

  • Experience working on prototypes, product discovery teams, start-up environments, or innovation-led engineering projects.

  • Experience helping successful prototypes evolve into scalable, production-grade applications.

Technologies You’ll Work With

  • Python

  • TypeScript and JavaScript

  • React, Next.js, or comparable modern frontend frameworks

  • HTML and CSS

  • REST, event-driven, and real-time APIs

  • Google Cloud Platform

  • Cloud Run

  • Pub/Sub

  • BigQuery

  • Google ADK

  • Modern agent frameworks

  • AI development tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and equivalent platforms

Inclusion & Diversity at Zinkworks

At Zinkworks, we are deeply committed to fostering a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. By embracing an inclusive environment, we empower innovation and collaboration across all levels of our organisation. Based in Ireland, we are proud to support and engage with our local communities through meaningful initiatives that promote equity and opportunity. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, as we actively contribute to creating a more inclusive and connected society for all.

title: Master Control Operator (Evenings/Overnight)
description:
Work with a driven and highly motivated team to support the on-air operations of Versant Media. As a Master Control Operator at Versant, you will be responsible for all aspects of maintaining and ensuring the reliability of all Versant Networks and streaming platforms including live execution of events for news, entertainment, and sports. Will be required to monitor and recover live networks for all Versant media outlets.

Essential Functions (Responsibilities):

  • Perform the duties of a live sports master control operator in a fast-paced environment, including manipulating commercial playlists, executing program/commercial/marketing changes, managing playlists, sending logs for reconciliation and maintaining the overall reliability and execution of live events for network and streaming broadcasts.
  • Monitor and maintain the continuity and availability for various networks (including linear, streaming and VOD services).
  • Perform control room duties (Technical Director, Commercial Integration, and Associate Director) to support live events.
  • Receive and execute directions to successfully execute the desired traffic integration of the operating networks.
  • Perform ingest and quality control duties for all on-air content airing on streaming platforms and linear networks.
  • Work well within a team environment.
  • Exceed expectations in on-air reliability and customer service for all applicable clients. Ensure reliability of on-air schedules in a dynamic environment.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Ability to be flexible in approach and respond well to pressure.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations.
  • Possess strong troubleshooting and processing skills.
  • Attention to detail and thinking ahead to alleviate potential issues.
  • This position requires the ability to work any scheduled time, including nights, weekends and holidays to support the 24x7 on-air broadcast environment. Must be available to work on weekends.

Desired Characteristics

  • BA/BS in related field.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple tasks and pressure situations.
  • 1 + year experience in an On-air broadcast environment with a proven understanding of live “on-air” broadcast operations execution.
  • 1 + year of experience in a live environment, specifically a strong background in executing live event broadcasts.
  • 1 + year experience demonstrating an overall understanding & knowledge of the television production process, broadcast operations & news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements.
  • 1 + year of proven knowledge of switchers, routers, communications, ingest and automation systems including cloud-based systems.
  • 1 + year of experience in ingest and quality control processes.
  • Proven leadership, high energy level, strong attention to detail and strong team and communication skills.
  • Extensive and significant experience, understanding and knowledge of digital broadcast and production technical systems, standards and processes.
  • Technical experience with automated, real-time systems, digital video and audio troubleshooting and test techniques.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with work rules and scheduling.

title: Senior Associate, IT, Network Engineer (12 Month Contract)
description:
The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing solutions that compliment a dynamic, always growing and evolving global network for one of the leading organizations in financial services. You will bring a unique perspective to a team that adapts and maintains a secure and reliable network hosted across both cloud and office/site network infrastructure.

Although the core focus of this role will be to act as a Network Engineer with a solid understanding of Network & IT Infrastructure Fundamentals including protocols, switches, routers/firewalls, it will also include exposure to experience operating within Azure & AWS cloud tenants. You will design and manage the local and wide area networks of our organization to ensure maximum up time for our users.

Reporting to the Director, IT, Infrastructure, you will:

  • Design and Architect Networks

    Develop secure, scalable, and highly available network architectures using technologies like VPNs, VPCs, virtual networks, and load balancers.

  • Cloud Network Management

    Provision, configure, and manage cloud-based network resources across platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Cisco Meraki.

  • Network Security Implementation

    Enforce robust security measures including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, encryption, and compliance with industry standards.

  • Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting

    Continuously monitor network performance, diagnose issues, and optimize for stability, availability, and efficiency.

  • Hybrid Network Integration

    Seamlessly connect cloud environments with on-premises infrastructure using secure methods like VPNs.

  • Automation and Scripting

    Leverage automation tools and scripting languages to streamline network operations and reduce manual tasks.

  • Disaster Recovery and Continuity Planning

    Manage backup strategies, disaster recovery protocols, and ensure business continuity for network systems.

  • Documentation and Compliance

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of network configurations, operational procedures, and compliance records.

  • Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration

    Collaborate with IT teams and stakeholders, providing clear updates on incidents, maintenance, and project progress.

  • Continuous Learning and Innovation

    Stay current with emerging technologies and trends, recommending improvements to enhance network infrastructure.

You Have:

  • Bachelor's/Associates degree in computer engineering or computer science
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and supporting network infrastructure within AWS and Azure (required)
  • Demonstrable experience in a professional information technology environment with exposure to network and security engineering
  • Understanding of Network Fundamentals, protocols, and technologies TCP/IP, VLAN, WAN, MPLS, DNS, DHCP, IPSEC, TLS, NAT, PAT, VPN, BGP, OSPF
  • 3+ years working within L2 IT Support capacity
  • Good knowledge of switches, routers, and firewalls, VPNs, Layer-3 devices, APs, specifically with Cisco (Meraki), Palo Alto, and/or Forti
  • Implementing & Administering Wi-Fi
  • Microsoft Server 2008 R2 – 2019
  • Terminal Services
  • Active Directory / DNS / Group Policy
  • VMware vSphere 6.5+
  • SAN systems (HPE 3par experience preferred)

  • Demonstrable experience with cloud-based networking (AWS/Azure)
  • ITIL Certified is an asset

Additional duties may include, but are not limited to:

  • Upholding all company, client, and governmental safety requirements throughout project lifecycles.
  • Maintaining effective communication with clients, team members, subcontractors, and management at all stages.
  • Assisting with the development of technical proposals, change orders, and comprehensive cost estimates, as well as defining clear scopes of work.
  • Collaborating with other departments for efficient project delivery and resolution of technical challenges.
  • Overseeing or assisting with the preparation and approval of project deliverables, including detailed reports, permit applications, and engineering work plans.
  • Reviewing civil engineering plans, specifications, calculations, and design documents for site development, grading, stormwater management, utilities, erosion and sediment control, and related infrastructure improvements.
  • Providing technical oversight during field investigations, construction observation, and project implementation to verify work is completed in accordance with approved plans, specifications, permits, and applicable codes or standards.
  • Managing the scheduling, coordinating with clients, subcontractors, and vendors for equipment procurement and rental.
  • Providing timely updates on project progress and communicating key milestones and features to both internal teams and clients.

  • Adherence to all company and client mandated safety requirements.
  • Frequent communication with clients, coworkers, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, and management.
  • Developing and/or assisting with proposals and change orders, including scope of services and cost estimates for projects.
  • Maintain most up to date project documentation and communicate changes to appropriate parties.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required, occasionally work out-of-town, if necessary, in all seasonal weather conditions.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities at time, if necessary, to achieve project and/or company goals.

The Professional Engineer may have the authority to direct and oversee other staff members, including S1, S2, or S3, and lower-level positions within the engineering department as appropriate for their assignments. While a Professional Engineer typically leads project teams and provides guidance to other staff working under their supervision, they must ensure that all significant client communications and any deviations from the established project scope are clearly communicated to the appropriate project manager, if applicable, or another senior manager before implementation.


The Professional Engineer has the authority to oversee all aspects of designated projects, ensuring that each phase is executed in line with project goals and standards. The Professional Engineer is expected to exercise sound judgment, communicate significant developments to the appropriate senior manager, and support both project success and staff advancement.

title: Quality Systems Specialist
description:
Corporate Overview

Argonaut Manufacturing Services Inc. is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 100,000 square feet of manufacturing space across four locations. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the biopharmaceutical and molecular diagnostics industries. Argonaut is a full service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions in the areas of formulation, filling and final kitting of reagents and consumables. Argonaut provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

Benefits and Pay Range

At Argonaut Manufacturing Services we value our employees and are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future. Eligible employees enjoy:

✔ Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance ✔ Company-Paid Life Insurance (1x Annual Salary) ✔ Voluntary Life Insurance Options ✔ Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance ✔ Flexible Spending Account (FSA) & Health Savings Account (HSA) ✔ 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Matching ✔ 10 Days of Paid Time Off (PTO) ✔ 10 Paid Holidays Annually

The pay range for this position is $36.00 - $40.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as location, skills, education, experience, and other relevant qualifications.

Position Overview

The Quality Systems Specialist will identify, document, and resolve quality issues, deviations, and non-conformances related to sterile drug product manufacturing operations. They will perform root cause analysis, assess risks, and determine Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to ensure strict compliance with FDA and cGMP standards. The Quality System Specialist will also participate in internal and external audits (client and supplier) and facilitate any corrective actions identified.

The role is a key Quality contact at Argonaut and requires the ability to independently manage timelines and effectively communicate with team members, cross-functional stakeholders, and clients while helping to maintain site Quality Systems in a state of inspection readiness.

This role is an on-site position Monday - Friday 8 hours/day (excluding lunch break). Overtime, weekends and holidays may be required. Flexible start time between 7:00 am - 9:00 am with a consistent schedule. Exceptions to the schedule must be approved by the manager in advance.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead in-depth investigations into batch deviations, out-of-specifications, and product failures

  • Oversee the analysis of customer complaints, review production history records, and interview personnel.

  • Ensure that investigation documentation and manufacturing processes align with FDA, cGMP, ISO, and other relevant industry standards.

  • Analyze and present quality data via metrics and reports to inform management decision-making.

  • Assist other departments to successfully investigate and documents investigations.

  • Complete accurate and thorough historical searches within quality system to identify similar events and determine trends.

  • Lead quality training sessions as needed

  • Participate in process improvements associated with investigations

  • Support visual inspection of finished product

  • Lead internal audit program and assist in hosting and responding to client and regulatory audits

  • Other duties may be assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences (Biology, Chemistry), Engineering, or a closely related field is strongly preferred

  • Minimum four (4) years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing, heavily focused on GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and performing investigations.

  • Strong analytical mindset, root-cause analysis skills, exceptional technical writing, and a solid working knowledge of FDA guidelines and ICH requirements.

  • Must have a high attention to detail, and excellent communication skills

  • Must be able to effectively communicate within the department and cross-functionally with other divisions

  • Experience with MasterControl and NetSuite a plus

  • Superior attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task in a time-line driven environment

  • Ability to make decisions regarding quality of product and material

  • Strong initiative and willingness to take ownership and drive projects to completion

Argonaut Manufacturing Services, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age or disability, or any other class protected by Federal, State or local laws. Argonaut complies will all employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and all must have the authorization to work in the US.

As a condition of employment, employees are required to review and sign certain company agreements and policies, including a confidential information agreement and an arbitration agreement for the resolution of employment-related disputes, in accordance with applicable law.


Background checks are conducted to support workplace productivity, safety, and security by ensuring applicant backgrounds and qualifications are suitable for the position being considered.


It is the policy of Argonaut Manufacturing Services, Inc., as part of its hiring procedures, to conduct background checks on finalist(s) for all positions. These checks will be job-related, consistent with business necessity, and conducted pursuant to all applicable laws, rules, policies, and procedures. Background checks may include, but are not limited to, verification with educational institutions or licensing/credentialing boards; standard criminal checks; employment verification; and other pertinent information and resources.


Employment offers will generally be made after successful completion of applicable background check(s). title: Product Designer – Digital Identity (EUDI) – Remote-First
description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France and Germany and launching very soon in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Backed by 16 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What's in it for you

In this role, you’ll shape the experience of Europe’s next-generation digital identity infrastructure. You’ll design and deliver world-class identity flows for EUDI and Wero, turning complex regulatory and trust-based requirements into intuitive, human-centered interfaces that millions can rely on.

You’ll lead the conception and prototyping of critical identity journeys, influence experience principles across the organisation, and help define how digital identity feels in everyday life. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Content Design in a collaborative, remote-first environment, you’ll ensure our identity solutions are secure, accessible, and empowering by design.

Our roadmap is clear: prototyping and specification run through 2026, pilot and testing follow in 2027, and then we move into integration within Wero and rollout. You’ll provide design continuity across these phases, ensuring consistency, clarity, and usability as the identity ecosystem scales.

This is a rare opportunity to become a trusted Digital Identity design reference within EPI, working alongside teams across the organisation as digital identity expands in scope and impact across Europe.

At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.

🐝 About the team

You will work closely with our Digital Identity Product Leader and Engineering counterparts as part of a focused Identity task force, and you will be reporting into the Head of Experience Design. From day one, you will act as the Design Lead for Identity, turning complex and sometimes ambiguous requirements into clear, implementable experience solutions and scalable design decisions.

You will be embedded in the Identity domain, working within a cross-functional product team alongside Product and Engineering. At the same time, you will be part of a wider Design organisation of around 14 people, including Product Design, Research, Content Design, and Design Operations.

While Product Designers are embedded within specific domains, disciplines such as Research, Content Design, and Operations work transversally across teams. This gives you both domain ownership and access to shared expertise, enabling strong collaboration across the organisation.

You will collaborate in a matrix setup across Europe, contributing to identity initiatives that span multiple teams and markets. As the identity roadmap progresses from prototype to pilot, and into Wero integration and rollout, you will provide design continuity and ensure experience quality across phases.

💥 Your impact

  • Conceive, design, and deliver implementable user interface flows to create world‑class payment and identity experiences for end users.

  • Present and defend product design recommendations and Wero experience principles to senior stakeholders across EPI, member banks, and merchant teams.

  • Act as a central point of contact for the EUDI European Digital Identity experience, collaborating closely with UX and Product partners to ensure solutions are fast, reliable, dynamic, and empowering.

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to translate complex identity and trust requirements into clear, usable interfaces.

  • Nurture mutually respectful and collaborative relationships with EPI colleagues and extended partner teams.

  • Contribute to inclusive and accessible design practices across all solutions.

💻 Technology stack

Figma, Slack, Miro, Microsoft Suite, Confluence, Jira.

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

Product Design Craft & Systems Thinking:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer in a product-led environment, with a track record of shaping complex digital products from concept to launch

  • Strong background in end-to-end product design with advanced UI design skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma

  • Ability to balance craft, speed, and pragmatism in a real-world product environment

  • Ability to maintain clear, well-structured design artifacts and documentation

Designing in Regulated & Trust-Critical Environments:

  • Experience translating abstract, regulatory, and trust-based requirements (e.g., digital identity, authentication, consent, privacy) into intuitive, user-centered solutions

  • Experience building to AA standard

  • Experience in payments, financial services, or fintech environments is considered a plus

Research & Evidence-Based Decision Making:

  • Qualitative and quantitative research capabilities

  • Ability to use research insights and data to inform design decisions

  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity

Collaboration, Communication & Stakeholder Management:

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior leaders and external partners

  • Highly collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams

  • Experience working in distributed or multi-market teams is considered a plus

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German or Dutch or any additional European languages is a plus

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters (45 min)

  2. Portfolio review + Job-Specific Skills Interview (60 min) with your hiring manager + relevant experts

  3. Culture Interview (60 min) with your hiring manager + digital identity lead

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You’re looking for a fully structured environment with little ambiguity and prefer clearly defined execution over discovery, exploration, and rapid prototyping.

  • You’re not comfortable taking ownership of the experience direction from day one, making decisions with incomplete information, and translating business, regulatory, or consortium requirements into clear, user-centered solutions.

  • You prefer working within a narrow scope rather than acting as a design partner who aligns stakeholders, shapes experience principles, and regularly communicates trade-offs to mixed technical and non-technical audiences.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus, and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits program

  • The opportunity to be part of a multicultural European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year


Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

description:
At UMC, we don’t just make products - we innovate, solve problems, and build a better future. As a proud, privately owned second-generation manufacturer, we’ve earned our reputation as leaders in our industry by producing highly complex parts with precision and ingenuity. What sets us apart? Our people. We’re a passionate team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and going above and beyond. If this sounds like your kind of workplace, keep reading!


Why UMC?

  • Wage: The position includes a 20% shift differential and an annual $3,000.00 retention bonus.
  • Generous PTO: Start with 3 weeks of paid time off per year, with accrual starting on day one.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and paid holidays.
  • 401k Match: Dollar-for-dollar matching up to 5%.
  • Professional Growth: Tuition reimbursement for professional development.
  • Work Schedule: Friday-Sunday, 4:00am-4:30pm or 5:00 am – 5:30 pm, onsite in Monticello, MN.

About the Role

As a General Finishing Operator, you will rotate through various tasks, including assembly, deburring, polishing, washing, and tumbling. Utilizing manual pneumatic, electric, or hand tools, you will produce high-quality, cosmetically appealing products that meet customer specifications and process requirements, while upholding our core values: Great People, Going Beyond, and Growing.


What You’ll Do

  • Accurate and competent use of all inspection equipment related to job inspection requirements such as micrometers, air gauging, optical comparator, refractometer, calipers, go and no-go gauges, thread gauges and plug/pin gauges.
  • Follow appropriate process to polish, wash, tumble, bead blast, hone, assemble and deburr parts as needed.
  • Effectively repeat processes to ensure parts are consistently free of burrs.
  • Exhibit a working knowledge of health and safety, responsible for safety awareness, while upholding and improving the culture of safety within the organization. Identify opportunities for improvement and act if appropriate before a problem occurs. Report potential hazards, unsafe working conditions, unsafe equipment, unsafe acts, and injuries immediately.
  • Consistent fine motor manipulation.
  • Regular use of microscope.
  • Able to recognize and remove burrs on components.

title: Risk & Compliance SME (AI Focus)
description:
Join our consulting team to deliver high-impact solutions across risk, compliance, and operations transformation. In this role, you'll work directly with clients to map how compliance and operational processes actually work, identify where they break down or create risk, and design better processes, then find the right opportunities to layer in AI to make them faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

You'll operate in a fast-paced, client-facing environment, balancing independent ownership with strong collaboration across teams. This role is ideal for people with experience in technology and/or fintech environments, particularly within regulated or compliance-driven contexts, who also bring a genuine interest in where AI can realistically improve how compliance work gets done.

What You'll Do

  • Risk & Compliance Process Design

    • Map and diagnose compliance and operational processes end to end to pinpoint where they break down or create risk

    • Lead the design and implementation of improved frameworks, systems, and processes, including defining data requirements and analyzing performance trends across operational, logical, and system workflows

  • AI Opportunity Identification

    • Evaluate compliance and operational processes to identify practical AI and automation use cases, from workflow automation to agentic AI

    • Build the business case for where these use cases will actually reduce risk or improve efficiency

  • Client Delivery & Execution

    • Lead client engagements, both onsite and remotely, delivering high-quality workstreams and producing complex, client-ready deliverables

  • Project & Workstream Management

    • Manage timelines, prioritize tasks, and coordinate activities across cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

    • Build strong client relationships and confidently present insights, recommendations, and AI-enabled process improvements to stakeholders, including senior leadership

  • Business Analysis & Problem Solving

    • Analyze client challenges using both quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop structured, actionable solutions

  • Team Collaboration & Mentorship

    • Collaborate with and mentor team members on tools, methodologies, and best practices (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project)

  • Documentation & Knowledge Management

    • Maintain clear and organized project documentation to ensure transparency, continuity, and knowledge sharing

  • Thought Leadership & Practice Development

    • Drive thought leadership by shaping internal initiatives, sharing knowledge, and building firm capabilities around AI in risk and compliance

  • Business Development Support

    • Shape proposal development, identify new opportunities, and drive broader business development efforts

  • Meeting Facilitation

    • Lead effective meetings with both internal teams and clients, ensuring alignment and clear next steps

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business Management, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field

  • 4-7 years of client-facing management consulting experience, preferably within technology or fintech environments

  • Experience supporting or delivering risk, compliance, or regulatory-related initiatives

  • Practical experience with AI adoption, workflow automation, or identifying AI use cases within a business or compliance context, not just familiarity with the concept

  • Strong understanding of industry challenges within technology, fintech, or regulated environments

  • Proven ability to build and manage client relationships

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to present complex ideas clearly

  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including knowing when to escalate issues

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment

Preferred

  • Master's degree or MBA

  • Experience within financial services, fintech, or technology-driven organizations

  • Exposure to areas such as risk management, compliance, financial crimes, or regulatory programs

  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools to compliance, risk, or operational workflows (actual use, not certification-level)

  • Familiarity with data analysis, reporting tools, or process improvement methodologies

  • Exposure to agentic AI concepts and their application to compliance or operational processes

What Sets You Apart

  • A systems thinker who can see how a compliance process connects end to end and where risk or inefficiency creeps in

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, grounded in practical outcomes for risk and compliance work

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in client environments

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous settings with evolving priorities

  • Ability to translate complex problems into structured, actionable solutions

  • Interest in growing into leadership responsibilities and contributing to team development

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for technology, innovation, and emerging trends

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in supporting our team professionally and personally. Here’s a snapshot of the comprehensive benefits you’ll enjoy as part of Sia.

Competitive Compensation

  • Annual Base Salary Range
    • Senior Consultant Level: $124,400 - $129,500, commensurate with experience and qualifications
  • Annual performance based discretionary bonus

Robust Health Coverage

  • 3 Medical plans
  • Dental and Vision
  • Life, AD&D and other voluntary insurance

Tax-Advantaged Accounts

  • 401K retirement plan
  • 4% matching and 100% vested upon enrollment
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Health, Dependent Care, Commuter

Family Friendly Benefits

  • 100% paid parental leave for all new parents with eligible tenure
  • Building Healthy Families program if enrolled through Medical plan

Time Off to Recharge

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy
  • 9 company holidays plus 1 floating holiday

Extras that Make Life Easier

  • Access to wellness programs at no cost if enrolled through Medical plan, including:
    • Gym membership reimbursement
    • LiveHealth Online virtual care
    • Personalized support from a Well-being Coach
  • Employee Assistance Program at no cost

    • On-demand access to Emotional Well-being resources (ranging from relaxation techniques to stress management)

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging. We are committed to recruiting and developing a diverse network of employees and investing in their growth by providing unique opportunities for professional and cultural immersion. Our commitment toward inclusion motivates dynamic collaboration with our clients, building trust by creating an inclusive environment of curiosity and learning which affects lasting impact. Please visit our website for more information.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Sia is committed to providing a flexible workplace environment that supports client, business, and market needs. Consultants located in our primary market office locations—New York City, Charlotte, Seattle, and San Francisco—are expected to live within a reasonable commuting distance and attend the office at least three days or more per week. title: Chief People Officer (CPO), People & Culture hos BDO Danmark
description:
Vil du sætte retningen for mennesker, kultur og ledelse i en af Danmarks førende rådgivnings- og revisionsvirksomheder?

BDO Danmark søger en erfaren og relationelt stærk Chief People Officer, der kan sætte retning for People & Culture og skabe sammenhæng på tværs af en landsdækkende, partnerdrevet organisation. Rollen får stor betydning for BDO Danmarks fortsatte udvikling og for arbejdet med Strategi 2030 ”tættere på – stærkere sammen”, hvor mennesker, ledelse, kompetencer og kultur er centrale drivere.

BDO Danmark er dansk ejet og ledet og drives som en partnerejet virksomhed, hvor ejerne selv er aktive i den daglige drift. Beslutninger træffes i Danmark, og vejen fra idé til beslutning er kort. Samtidig er BDO en del af et stærkt internationalt netværk, som giver adgang til viden, perspektiver og Best Practice på tværs af lande.

En People-agenda, der er en del af forretningen

BDO er en virksomhed, hvor mennesker er forretningen. BDO sælger ikke produkter – forretningen består af medarbejdernes faglighed, dømmekraft og relationer til kunderne. Derfor er evnen til at tiltrække, udvikle og tilknytte de rigtige mennesker ikke en supportopgave, men en central del af BDO’s forretningsmæssige udvikling.

Udgangspunktet er en stærk organisation og kultur, som den kommende CPO skal bygge videre på, styrke sammenhængskraften i og gøre endnu mere skalerbar.

Udgangspunktet er stærkt. BDO blev i juni 2026 fremhævet som en af Danmarks mest attraktive arbejdspladser i Randstad Employer Brand Research 2026 og opnåede samtidig den bedste placering i revisions- og rådgivningsbranchen. BDO ligger desuden blandt de 5 % bedst præsterende virksomheder inden for Professional Services på medarbejderengagement og arbejdsglæde.

Rollen

Som CPO får du det overordnede ansvar for People & Culture i BDO Danmark og refererer til CEO. Du bliver en central sparringspartner for ledelsen og får ansvar for at sikre, at P&C understøtter forretningens strategiske ambitioner og samtidig opleves som nærværende, relevant og værdiskabende i hele organisationen.

Du sætter strategisk retning for P&C og skaber sammenhæng på tværs af Recruitment, Operations, Learning & Development samt People & Culture Legal. Du leder gennem selvstændige ledere og specialister og skal samtidig sikre fælles retning, prioritering og høj kvalitet på tværs.

En central del af opgaven bliver at omsætte Strategi 2030 ”tættere på – stærkere sammen” til konkrete People-initiativer, der giver mening i organisationen og skaber reel værdi for BDO’s forretning. Det gælder blandt andet inden for ledelses- og kompetenceudvikling, talent, employer branding, kultur og organisatorisk kapacitet.

Rollen kalder på en leder, der både kan tænke strategisk og være tæt på den virkelighed, strategien skal fungere i. Du skal kunne samle forskellige perspektiver, skabe klarhed og prioritere – og samtidig kunne udfordre og træffe tydelige valg.

Du bidrager til klare rammer for samarbejde, kommunikation og prioritering ift. BDO’s decentrale organisation og bringer nye perspektiver, digitale muligheder og Best Practice ind i P&C-arbejdet.

Tæt på ejere, partnere og organisationen

En vigtig del af rollen bliver at være tæt på BDO’s ejere, partnere, ledere og lokale afdelinger. Du skal kunne forstå forretningens forskellige perspektiver og behov og omsætte dem til en samlet People-retning.

BDO’s partnerdrevne og decentrale organisation betyder, at People-agendaen skal skabes i tæt samspil med organisationen. Det kræver en CPO, der kan skabe øjenhøjde med fagligt og kommercielt stærke profiler og opbygge relationer, der skaber opbakning.

Samtidig skal du kunne balancere fælles retning og standarder med respekt for den lokale virkelighed og de enkelte forretningsområders behov.

Du bliver dermed en vigtig brobygger mellem centrale funktioner og den decentrale organisation – med BDO’s samlede interesser for øje.

Din profil

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse eller tilsvarende faglig ballast og solid erfaring med:

  • Strategisk og forretningsorienteret: Du har solid erfaring med strategisk og forretningsorienteret People & Culture-ledelse og kan omsætte virksomhedens strategi til konkrete People-initiativer.

  • Ledelse og relationer: Du har erfaring med ledelse af ledere eller faglige miljøer og er vant til at arbejde tæt sammen med topledelse, partnere og andre centrale interessenter. Du skaber tillid og kan skabe opbakning til fælles retning.

  • Dømmekraft og gennemslagskraft: Du er tydelig, lyttende og løsningsorienteret. Du kan samle forskellige perspektiver, skabe klarhed i komplekse problemstillinger og omsætte dem til beslutninger og handling. Du kan udfordre, når det skaber værdi, og samtidig bevare gode relationer til organisationens forskellige interessenter.

  • Udvikling og nye muligheder: Du har et nysgerrigt og udviklingsorienteret mindset og ser data, AI, digitale løsninger og nye arbejdsformer som naturlige redskaber til at styrke processer, beslutninger og organisatorisk udvikling. Du har erfaring med at omsætte strategi til konkrete people-initiativer og ved, hvordan man skaber resultater gennem relationer, tillid og fælles retning.

Du behersker dansk og engelsk flydende i skrift og tale.

Det får du mulighed for

Som CPO får du mulighed for at spille en central rolle i BDO’s fortsatte strategiske og organisatoriske udvikling.

Du kommer ind på et tidspunkt, hvor retningen med Strategi 2030 ”tættere på – stærkere sammen” er sat, men hvor People-delen af strategien skal formes og omsættes til praksis. Du får dermed mulighed for at præge udviklingen af P&C som en stærk, forretningsnær og værdiskabende funktion.

Du bliver en del af en organisation med stærke faglige miljøer, høj medarbejdertrivsel, stærke kunderelationer og et solidt employer brand. Samtidig får du adgang til inspiration, viden og Best Practice gennem BDO’s internationale netværk.

Det er en rolle for en CPO, der motiveres af at gøre en forskel tæt på forretningen – og som trives med at skabe resultater gennem andre.

Arbejdsstedet er BDO’s kontor i Aarhus C. Rollen indebærer rejseaktivitet og forudsætter lyst til at være synlig og nærværende i BDO’s afdelinger i hele landet.

Interesseret?

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Partner Lise Holler

E-mail: liho@gml-hr.dk

Mobil: +45 2026 9981

Med dybe lokale rødder og over 1.800 engagerede medarbejdere, herunder mere end 180 statsautoriserede revisorer, er BDO i Danmark markedsledere inden for rådgivning, revision og andre serviceydelser.

title: Piercer
description:
Why Astrid & Miyu?

We're more than a jewellery brand, we're on a mission to revolutionise the jewellery experience, and that starts with our people.

We're a fast moving, values led team built on trust, ownership and growth. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to life, make an impact and grow alongside a team that celebrates each other. If you're adaptable, proactive, and energised by growth, you'll thrive here.

Everything we do is guided by our values:

Grow Together. Celebrate Each Other. Break All Boundaries.

Want to discover more? Explore life at A&M, meet our people and learn more about our values here.

Location: Cardiff

Hours: 12 hours per week on a 9-12 months FTC. Weekend working is preferred. If you're unable to work on weekends, please let us know ahead of your Values Interview.

Salary & Benefits: £17 p/h + commission. See more on our benefits here.

Our Commitment: Sustainability starts with us. From community work, caring for our suppliers and educating and supporting our team. See our commitments here.

The Piercer Mission:

We’re more than a piercing studio - we’re a community shaping the future of piercing and jewellery. As a visionary in your craft, you’ll play a key role in empowering our customers to bring their dream curations to life, guiding them with expertise, artistry and heart every step of the way.

Why pierce with us?

  • Our studios are fully disposable, aseptic, and stocked with high-quality tools from top suppliers like Probodyart and Stiletto

  • We’re a growing brand committed to continuous learning. We work to APP standards, and invest in your growth and development. From ongoing education and courses, to seminars with industry experts like Olly Todd. You’ll join a team of passionate piercers where your craft is truly celebrated and your expertise is valued

  • Pierce with premium implant-grade jewellery, internally threaded titanium and 14ct solid white and yellow gold, along with lab-grown diamonds and semi-precious stones

How you'll drive success:

  • Champion safety and excellence, taking full ownership of the cleanliness and hygiene of your studio, while proactively managing and maintaining piercing supplies to the highest standard

  • Inspire our community with styling advice, executing precise and aesthetic piercings - all with a meticulous eye for detail and a genuine love for what you do

  • Host from the Heart, creating a warm, intentional space where every customer feels seen, valued and cared for, while holding space with empathy and compassion, especially during sensitive moments

  • Lead on the shop floor, sharing your piercing expertise and passion with both customers and your team, inspiring trust and elevating the energy around you

What you'll need to thrive:

  • This role is suitable for any Piercers with at least 1 year experience in a studio looking for that next step in their journey

  • A values champion and brand ambassador, our values resonate deeply with you

  • You radiate positivity & enthusiasm and inspire the people around you

  • You’re able to stay grounded during more difficult and sensitive interactions, always leading with empathy

The Interview Process and Candidate Experience

  1. Values Interview: a 30 min video call with our Talent Team to get to know you better, learning more about your journey, what motivates you and how you like to work.

  2. In-Store Technical Interview - you'll meet one of our Piercer Mentors for a Studio Set-Up & Piercing Demo, alongside your Store Manager who will chat through your experience, skill-set and what you're looking for in your next role.

Feedback: We’re committed to creating the best candidate experience we can for you. You’ll receive feedback over the phone or email at every stage in the process once you’ve had an interview so that we can set you up for success and help fuel your growth.

title: Truss Builder
description:
TRUSS BUILDER

FULL-TIME

HOURLY

ROBERTSDALE, AL


Why Swift Supply? At Swift Supply family is important to us. When you join Swift Supply, you join our family and we take care of family. We thrive on providing quality service to our customers and our employees. We believe in creating opportunities for our employees to work hard, build lasting relationships, develop professionally, find work/life balance and have fun. You can build your life around a career at Swift Supply.With more than 100 years of experience as a 6th generation family-owned business, we are a winning team culture dedicated to remaining the leader in southwest Alabama and northwest Florida for quality construction materials to the professional builder, business, industry and individual through the use of the latest technology and quality service.


Our Opportunity. We help ensure the roof on our customer’s home is designed properly and built to the highest quality. The purpose of this position is to assemble roof trusses. This is a full-time, hourly position. Overtime may be required.


What You Will Do (with or without reasonable accommodation)

  • Place connector plate at each truss joint by hammering in place
  • Fit parts together in accordance with the prescribed manner and in accordance with quality standards
  • Use a mechanical roller to embed the connector plate to the truss
  • Send the truss through the finished press
  • Move each assembled truss to the yard for delivery preparation
  • Stack completed products in accordance with established procedures, and if required, may cover label and band components to finish the product
  • Operate hand tools, saws, presses, and pneumatic staple and nail guns as required to complete the assembly process
  • Inspect materials and finished products to ensure compliance with standards
  • Work with various building materials, including wood and metal
